jobs.description:
Bold

Nuestra compañía fue fundada en Mayo de 2019 por un equipo de personas increíbles y con una experiencia única, el grupo de fundadores está conformado por los creadores de PayU Latam y otras empresas expertas en tecnología financiera. Estamos creando soluciones de pago y de banca para MiPymes, independientes y emprendedores en Colombia. Actualmente contamos con más de 450.000 clientes registrados en nuestra plataforma y hemos recibido más de USD $120 millones de fondos de inversión nacionales y extranjeros, somos una de las startups de más rápido crecimiento en LatAm en el sector fintech. Bold es una fintech que provee una solución de pagos a los microempresarios para recibir pagos con tarjetas débito, crédito y billeteras a través de datáfonos y links de pago. Sin embargo, la visión de Bold es más ambiciosa que ser una empresa de pagos y estamos trabajando para volvernos una plataforma de servicios financieros y tecnológicos para las pequeñas empresas en el país complementando las soluciones de pagos y banca con otros productos de software conexos a toda nuestra propuesta de valor. Nuestra misión en Bold es liberar el potencial de los emprendedores. En Bold creemos firmemente que podemos ayudar a los pequeños emprendedores a desarrollar sus negocios ofreciendo servicios financieros y tecnológicos hechos a su medida, que sean amigables y cercanos. En Bold definimos los siguientes valores como los pilares de nuestra cultura organizacional: Maestría, Pensamiento crítico, Trabajo en equipo, Sentido de urgencia, Somos abiertos y el cliente el centro de lo que hacemos. Para más información acerca de Bold visita nuestro sitio web:

El Rol

Como Technical Privacy Specialist, liderarás el programa de privacidad y protección de datos personales de Bold en Colombia y Perú desde el equipo de Seguridad de la Información. Serás responsable de convertir los riesgos y requisitos de privacidad en controles, procesos y planes de trabajo que puedan ejecutarse y medirse en toda la compañía.

Este no es un rol jurídico. El equipo Legal lidera la interpretación normativa y será tu principal aliado en los temas que requieran análisis especializado. Buscamos a una persona con criterio técnico, muy organizada y capaz de coordinar proyectos complejos con Producto, Ingeniería, Seguridad, Datos, Operaciones y las áreas de negocio. Tendrás autonomía para ordenar prioridades, destrabar dependencias y llevar cada iniciativa hasta su cierre.

Deberás:

  • Definir la estrategia, el roadmap y el modelo operativo del programa de privacidad, con objetivos, responsables, métricas, riesgos y un calendario de entregas.

  • Gestionar un portafolio de iniciativas transversales, controlar alcance, hitos, dependencias y planes de remediación, y comunicar avances y decisiones a líderes técnicos y de negocio.

  • Mantener el inventario de datos personales, los mapas de flujo, el Registro Nacional de Bases de Datos (RNBD) en Colombia y los registros aplicables en Perú.

  • Incorporar privacidad desde el diseño y por defecto en productos, aplicaciones, integraciones, flujos de pago y procesos de registro, participando desde las etapas tempranas de descubrimiento y diseño.

  • Liderar evaluaciones PIA y DPIA para nuevos productos, tratamientos, proveedores, transferencias internacionales y casos de uso de IA, y dar seguimiento a los riesgos hasta su cierre.

  • Trabajar con Legal para convertir requisitos normativos en criterios operativos y, con Ingeniería y Seguridad, definir controles de clasificación, minimización, retención, eliminación, anonimización, cifrado, registro y acceso.

  • Coordinar el ciclo completo de solicitudes y reclamos de titulares, incluidos los derechos ARCO, las PQR y las solicitudes de supresión, con trazabilidad, calidad y cumplimiento de tiempos.

  • Coordinar el frente de privacidad en incidentes y brechas de datos junto con Respuesta a Incidentes y Legal, documentando decisiones, acciones correctivas y notificaciones cuando correspondan.

  • Mantener políticas, avisos, autorizaciones, estándares y guías de tratamiento de datos, y promover prácticas consistentes en todas las áreas.

  • Atender auditorías y requerimientos de la SIC, la SFC y autoridades equivalentes; preparar evidencia; dar seguimiento a hallazgos; y apoyar marcos como PCI DSS, ISO 27001, ISO 27701 y SOC 2.

  • Diseñar entrenamientos, guías y mecanismos de acompañamiento para que los equipos apliquen la privacidad en su trabajo diario.

  • Usar automatización e IA de forma responsable para mejorar inventarios, evaluaciones, recolección de evidencia, monitoreo de controles y reportes del programa.

  • Formalizar y dar seguimiento al contrato de tratamiento con cada encargado (transmisión de datos), verificando cláusulas de alcance, transferencias internacionales, subcontratación y destino final de los datos, conforme al marco legal colombiano y peruano.

¿Qué tenemos para ti?

🤝 Contrato a término indefinido

💻 Trabajo remoto tiempo completo

👨🏽‍⚕️ Póliza/ auxilio de salud

🚀 Bono anual por cumplimiento de objetivos empresariales (acciones o dinero).

💲 Salario competitivo

📚 Apoyo económico para educación

🌎 Tecnologías y procesos de clase mundial

🏖️ Días libres adicionales a las vacaciones

👓 Bono para salud visual

❤️‍🩹 Bienestar emocional

Requirements

  • Experiencia de 5 años o más en privacidad, protección de datos, GRC, seguridad de la información o cumplimiento tecnológico, incluida la gestión de programas complejos con alcance, roadmap, riesgos, dependencias, hitos y reporte ejecutivo.

  • Conocimiento práctico del régimen de protección de datos aplicable en Colombia y Perú, incluidas la Ley 1581 de 2012, la Ley N.° 29733 y sus normas reglamentarias vigentes. No necesitas ser abogado.

  • Experiencia con inventarios de datos, RoPA, PIA y DPIA, derechos de titulares, privacidad desde el diseño, gestión de incidentes y planes de remediación.

  • Solvencia técnica para conversar con Ingeniería y Seguridad sobre flujos de datos, APIs, servicios en la nube, arquitecturas de datos, identidad y acceso, cifrado, registros, retención y eliminación. Este rol no exige desarrollar software.

  • Capacidad para convertir requisitos jurídicos o regulatorios en controles y tareas claras, explicar riesgos a distintas audiencias y construir acuerdos entre Legal, Producto, Tecnología, Datos, Operaciones y negocio.

  • Excelente relacionamiento, influencia sin autoridad formal, organización rigurosa, seguimiento constante y autonomía en un entorno de prioridades cambiantes.

  • Criterio para diseñar controles proporcionales al riesgo y a la carga operativa, sin perder trazabilidad ni calidad.

  • Formación profesional o experiencia equivalente en tecnología, seguridad, gestión de riesgos, privacidad o áreas afines.

Será un plus:

  • Experiencia en fintech, pagos, servicios financieros o entornos con alto volumen de datos.

  • Experiencia atendiendo auditorías, requerimientos de autoridades y programas asociados con PCI DSS, ISO 27001, ISO 27701 o SOC 2.

  • Experiencia con herramientas de privacidad, plataformas GRC, automatización de flujos o gobierno responsable de IA.

  • Inglés avanzado.

  • Certificaciones como CIPM, CIPP, CIPT, ISO 27701, PMP o equivalentes.

jobs.excerpt: About IP House At IP House, we empower brands, legal professionals, and rights holders to manage and protect intellectual property—both online and offline—on a truly global scale.
jobs.description:
About IP House

At IP House, we empower brands, legal professionals, and rights holders to manage and protect intellectual property—both online and offline—on a truly global scale. Through cutting-edge technology and deep cross-border expertise, we deliver scalable, end-to-end solutions for IP portfolio management, enforcement, and content and brand protection.

With over 700 experts operating across five continents, we are trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands to combat counterfeiting, piracy, and IP infringement at scale. From digital platforms to physical marketplaces, we help clients safeguard what matters most—everywhere it matters.

Overview of the Role:

Assistant Managers (AM) directly monitor, supervise and coordinate activities of the assigned team. Assistant Managers act as a liaison between clients, team staff, and management to ensure program success and client satisfaction. Assistant Managers report to the Department Manager and have supervisory responsibilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Supervise the work of team members to ensure adherence to quality standards, deadlines and established procedures, correcting errors or problem
  • Train or instruct employees in job duties or company policies and arrange/schedule all training to be provided
  • Provide employees with guidance in handling difficult or complex problems
  • Discuss job performance problems with employees to identify causes and issues in conjunction with management to resolve problems
  • Interpret and communicate work procedures and company policies to staff members
  • Review and monitor workload levels to ensure adequate and appropriate staffing levels
  • Make recommendations to management concerning issues such as staffing decisions or procedural changes
  • Train new staff members, monitor staff performance, assist with annual performance reviews, mentor and develop staff members to maximize potential
  • Communicate with colleagues, supervisors and clients in an articulate and professional manner

What You’ll Bring:

  • Demonstrates leadership experience through progressive responsibility on the LER Ireland team, including past promotions within the team. Candidates must have progressed beyond Level I and achieved Level III.
  • Has 1-2 years of people management experience, including responsibility for performance management, coaching, and team development
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, attention to detail, pattern recognition and application of analytical criteria to arrive at correct decisions
  • Ability to manage staff of varying backgrounds and effectively schedule, mentor, coach and train employees
  • Proficiency in multi-tasking with the ability to adapt to dynamic situations in order to rapidly apply process changes
  • Proficiency in organizing, planning, prioritizing, analyzing, assessment, problem-solving and time management
  • Demonstrates good judgment, exercises discretion, and maintains confidentiality
  • Demonstrates proficiency in negotiation, conflict management, and supervisory skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and client tools/applications
  • CTIPS Certification preferred

Why IP House:

IP House is redefining how the world combats illicit trade and intellectual property theft—delivering scalable, end-to-end solutions that empower global brands and rights holders through innovation, strategic expertise, and a relentless commitment to global enforcement.

Achieving this ambitious mission requires the collaboration of an exceptionally talented team. We believe our people are the foundation of everything we do—and we invest accordingly. From day one, we foster a culture rooted in continuous learning, professional growth, and shared excellence.

We also understand that meaningful work begins with a strong foundation. That’s why we offer a flexible work environment and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees and their families.

Here, you’ll have the opportunity to shape a fast-scaling organization with a strong reputation for results—and room to grow with it. Join us in safeguarding the brands, content, and innovations that shape our world.

IP House is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to fostering a respectful, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Job Description

We need someone who can diagnose an entire culinary system, fix urgent product and quality problems fast, and then build the systems — recipes, specs, training, food safety — that let quality survive growth and turnover across multiple locations.

This is a fully remote role. A dedicated on-site Head Chef already handles floor-level kitchen execution — your focus is on the systems, standards, and leadership that keep quality consistent across every location, not day-to-day kitchen presence.

What You'll Own

  • Assess the current state of products, menus, recipes, and suppliers using data, reports, and remote evidence review

  • Diagnose and direct fixes for taste, consistency, and food-safety failures — working through the on-site Head Chef and location teams

  • Build controlled recipes and process standards with clear tolerances and version control

  • Lead menu engineering — fix, reposition, or cut underperforming products

  • Establish food-safety and traceability controls, with root-cause analysis on failures

  • Recruit, train, and develop culinary leaders across locations remotely

  • Own the culinary drivers of food cost, waste, and margin


Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Significant senior culinary leadership in a complex, multi-location environment

  • Proven ability to restore product quality and build repeatable systems — not just cook well

  • Comfortable leading and directing kitchen execution remotely, through on-site leads

  • Strong understanding of food cost, yield, and labor economics

  • Food safety and quality assurance experience

  • Advanced, practical use of AI and data tools for culinary management

Bonus Points

  • Experience managing across multiple concepts, cuisines, or dayparts

  • Experience directing culinary teams remotely or across distributed locations

  • Beverage operations or dining service experience

  • Track record building training and succession pipelines for culinary teams

You'll Thrive Here If You...

  • Believe quality should survive turnover, distance, and growth — not depend on one person's memory

  • Can lead and influence kitchen teams effectively without being physically present

  • Balance exacting culinary standards with real commercial judgment

  • Want to build systems, not just run a kitchen


Benefits

Benefits

  • HMO (health insurance)

  • Paid time off (PTO)

  • Work from anywhere

  • Opportunities for promotion

  • Pay raise

You’ll advance our AWS ecosystem by driving our AWS CDK library and AWS Config Rules, enabling automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and a world‑class developer experience for teams modernizing on Amazon Web Services. In this high‑impact role, you’ll help define the future of Mutual of Omaha’s technology platform used by internal I/S teams, business partners, and ultimately our customers.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary (Levels have variable responsibilities and qualifications):
    • Engineer III: $125,000 - $145,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.

  • You promote a culture of diversity and inclusion, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.

PREFERRED:

  • Ability to challenge the authenticity and effectiveness of team processes where opportunities for improvement exist.
  • Learn quickly when facing new problems and are a relentless and versatile learner, open to change.
  • Enjoy the challenge of unfamiliar tasks and ambiguity.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

All you need for the Customer Care Representative role is:

  • Basic typing/computer experience with excellent navigational skills

Your Potential. Our Mission.

At MTM Health, you’re not just part of a team—you’re at the heart of a movement to remove community barriers nationwide. We’re all about breaking the mold with bold ideas, open conversations, and a relentless focus on what matters most: you. Here, collaboration sparks breakthroughs, learning fuels growth, and every voice shapes our future. Together, we thrive, push our limits, and work as team to help you reach your full potential.

ZRG is a global talent advisory firm rewriting the playbook on how companies hire, retain, and develop leadership talent. The role

ZRG is looking for a Director of Performance Marketing to lead and scale our demand generation engine. This is a senior, strategic role - but one that stays close to the data and the work. You'll own paid media strategy and execution across all channels, build and optimize lead generation and nurture programs, and play a pivotal role in driving cross-sell and post-hire engagement across ZRG's full portfolio of services. You'll partner closely with our Business Unit Marketing Directors and commercial teams across executive search, embedded recruiting, consulting, and interim to ensure marketing is accelerating pipeline and revenue at every stage.

You'll also lead and grow a team, including a Manager of Performance Marketing, agency partners, and external contractors, and build the systems, processes, and culture that allow this function to scale.

What you'll do

  • Paid media and lead generation
    • Own ZRG's paid media strategy and execution across all channels - paid search (PPC/SEM), paid social (LinkedIn, programmatic), content syndication, intent-based targeting, and display - with a relentless focus on cost-efficient lead and pipeline generation.

    • Partner with revenue operations and sales leadership to ensure lead handoff, attribution, and funnel visibility are accurate and actionable.

Skylight is a digital consultancy using design and technology to help government agencies deliver better public services.

The work we do matters.

At Skylight, DevOps engineers work with developers throughout the software development life cycle to ensure code can be reliably and repeatedly released on demand with a high degree of quality. They understand both software development and operations, with expertise in areas such as networking, security, test automation, and continuous integration/deployment.

Our federal health and civilian work covers the systems people rely on to get healthcare and public health information, apply for financial aid and benefits, and reach the records the government keeps on their behalf. These systems serve millions of people, carry sensitive data, and can’t afford to go down — so modernizing them means improving them while they stay available and secure.

We’re hiring DevOps engineers across this portfolio as teams form and grow. You’ll own the CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure a delivery team ships on, working alongside the engineers building on them. We’ll match you to a team based on where your experience fits best.

About SqlDBM

SqlDBM is the enterprise data modeling platform built for collaborative data teams. We give data architects, engineers, and analytics leaders a single place to design, govern, and document their data estate: from conceptual and logical models through physical schemas and the semantic layer that sits on top of them.

We work natively with the modern data stack: Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Amazon Redshift, alongside Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL; with integrations into dbt, GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Confluence, and Collibra.

The problem we solve is easy to state and expensive to ignore: in most enterprises, data is built everywhere and defined nowhere. As more of the business runs on cloud data platforms, and as AI agents increasingly depend on trustworthy metadata to be useful at all, the modeling and semantic layer has moved from a nice-to-have to a control point. That shift is why demand is accelerating, and it is why we are creating this role.

About the role

We are hiring a Head of Growth to own everything that happens before an opportunity reaches an Account Executive. You will be accountable for all pipeline: its volume, its quality, and its predictability. You will build it through two engines: a repeatable outbound and inbound motion run by our BDR team, and a partner-sourced motion that you will build and personally carry before you scale it.

This is a builder's role. The BDR function is two people today. The partner function is one person. You will inherit a product with real enterprise pull and customers who reference well; what is missing is the system that converts that pull into a forecastable stream of qualified pipeline. You will design that system, run it yourself first, and hire against it as it proves out.

You will report directly to the SVP of Sales & Customer Success and work shoulder to shoulder with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product.

What you'll do

  • Pipeline: you own the number
  • Own the company's pipeline target: sourced, qualified, and accepted
  • Build and maintain the model that connects activity to pipeline to closed revenue, so we know which levers actually move the number and which are noise.
  • Report pipeline health to the leadership team with a clear read on coverage, conversion, velocity, and where the leaks are.
  • Allocate your team's capacity deliberately across net-new logos, partner-sourced deals, and expansion in the installed base.

BDR team: build a repeatable outbound motion

  • Lead, coach, and grow the BDR team (two today), with a hiring plan tied to proven capacity and conversion rather than headcount ambition.
  • Design the outbound playbook: ICP definition, account tiering, territory and named-account coverage, persona-level messaging for data architects, heads of data platform, and analytics engineering leaders, sequence and channel mix, and the objection handling that comes with selling into technical, skeptical buyers.
  • Build the operating discipline underneath the playbook: activity standards, call and email QA, discovery frameworks, qualification criteria, and CRM hygiene so performance is coachable and results are diagnosable rather than anecdotal.
  • Own inbound execution with the same rigor as outbound: speed-to-lead standards, routing rules, lead scoring, and a follow-up cadence that means no hand-raise goes cold. Inbound is our most expensive lead source and will be treated accordingly.
  • Run the ramp: onboarding, product and domain certification, and a 1:1 and pipeline-review rhythm that makes a new BDR productive quickly.
  • Make the role a career step. BDRs you develop should become the AEs and partner managers we promote from within.

Partners: player and coach

  • Own a personal partner-sourced pipeline number while building the function around it. In the first year you will be sourcing, negotiating, and activating partner relationships yourself, with one partner team member alongside you.
  • Recruit and activate system integrators, VARs, resellers, and independent consultants. They are the practitioners who are already in the room when enterprise data modeling decisions get made.
  • Work with global and regional consultancies such as Accenture, Infosys, PwC, Deloitte, and Capgemini, along with the specialist data boutiques to stand up data modeling practices with SqlDBM at the center: joint offerings, enablement and certification paths, delivery accelerators, and named champions inside each practice.
  • Build the mechanics that make partnering real rather than ceremonial: a deal registration process partners actually use, clear rules of engagement, a referral and margin structure, co-selling motions with our AEs, joint pipeline reviews, and partner-facing enablement assets.
  • Strengthen our position inside the platform ecosystems our partners live in — Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric among them — so the partner and platform motions reinforce each other.
  • Manage the portfolio with discipline: tier partners by realistic contribution, invest disproportionately in the ones producing, and be willing to deprioritize logos that look impressive on a slide and never register a deal.

Handoff: set the AEs up to win

  • Define, in writing and jointly with the SVP of Sales, what qualifies as a Sales Accepted Lead and hold both sides of the handoff to that standard.
  • Make the handoff a real artifact: documented discovery, mapped stakeholders, articulated pain, quantified impact where possible, and a next step already scheduled. An AE should walk into a first call knowing more than the prospect expects.
  • Close the loop on rejected and stalled leads so quality compounds instead of becoming a standing argument between teams.
  • Feed the front line back into the business: partner with Marketing on messaging, content, and campaign direction grounded in what your team hears on calls every day, and bring recurring product objections to Product.

Expansion: grow what we already have

  • Work with AEs and Customer Success to identify and develop expansion inside the installed base: new teams, new business units, new platforms, and new use cases in accounts that already trust us.
  • Direct part of your team's capacity at whitespace mapping and multi-threading within existing customers, not only at net-new logos.
  • Use partners as an expansion channel. The consultancy running a migration inside one of our customers is often the fastest path to the next three teams in that account.
  • Support renewals and reference development where pipeline work and customer advocacy overlap.
  • Signed and first registered deals are in the pipeline. You have a hiring plan and a pipeline forecast the leadership team can commit to.

Qualifications

  • Required
  • 8–12 years in B2B SaaS sales, business development, or partnerships, including 3+ years leading a team that carried a pipeline or revenue number.
  • A track record of building an outbound motion rather than inheriting one. You can walk us through the playbook you wrote, the metrics before and after, and what you would do differently next time.
  • Hands-on experience developing channel or partner relationships that produced measurable sourced pipeline, ideally with system integrators, VARs, or consultancies.
  • Real comfort as a player/coach. You will be running your own partner negotiation and reviewing a BDR's cold-call recording in the same afternoon, and you should want both.
  • Fluency with technical enterprise buyers, and the credibility to hold a substantive conversation with a data architect without hand-waving.
  • Command of the operating stack: CRM discipline, sales engagement tooling, and enough analytical rigor to build and defend a pipeline model. HubSpot experience is a plus.
  • Clear, direct writing. This role produces playbooks, definitions, and enablement material that other people have to execute from.
  • Willingness to travel roughly 10% as partner practices get built in person.

Bonus points

  • Experience selling into or alongside the modern data stack — Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, dbt — or in data governance, cataloging, or data management tooling.
  • Existing relationships inside the data practices of global or regional consultancies.
  • Experience at a company in the $10M-$20M ARR range, where the systems have to be built while the number is being hit.
  • Having built a partner program where none existed before.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + performance-based incentives aligned with customer retention and expansion.
  • Opportunity to work with some of the largest, most influential data-driven organizations globally.
  • Remote-first work environment with travel opportunities for key customer engagements.
  • Work alongside industry leaders and a world-class product team at the forefront of data innovation.
  • Comprehensive plan coverage for employees and covered dependents for medical, vision, dental, life, Short-term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and 401k.
  • Strong career growth trajectory in a rapidly scaling enterprise-first SaaS company.

Compensation Range: $175,000 (base salary $125,000 + $50,000 variable compensation)

Do you crave an intellectually stimulating role that lets you apply your clinical expertise while continuing to grow and make an impact? As a Medical Director at EviCore, part of Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, you’ll leverage your background in Radiation Oncology to deliver evidence-based medical reviews that support high-quality patient care. Collaborate with healthcare providers and stay current on healthcare regulations and industry developments as you review a wide range of cases. This role offers you the opportunity to build new skills while enhancing the health and vitality of others. We're seeking a detail-oriented individual with good communication, technology, and typing skills, as well as strong clinical judgment. Drive growth in your career with our innovative team.

How you’ll make a difference:

  • You’ll start training remotely in a structured environment with support from trainers, mentors, and leadership to set you up for success.
  • Complete time-sensitive, specialized evidence-based medical case reviews for medical necessity on EviCore’s case management software.
  • Conduct physician consultation (peer-to-peer) calls with referring providers to discuss evidence–based medical necessity and appropriateness of the requested service or treatment.
  • Leverage your clinical expertise to recommend alternative services or treatments as necessary.
  • Work collaboratively with over 500 EviCore physician colleagues to help ensure patients receive proper care via evidence-based decision making.

What you’ll enjoy about working here:

  • Benefits start on day one
  • Predictable work schedules
  • 100% work from home
  • 8 Paid Holidays + 23 PTO Days
  • 401(K) with company match
  • Reimbursement for continuing medical education
  • Career growth opportunities across the enterprise
  • Networking with peers across multiple medical specialties

Requirements:

  • M.D. or D.O. with a current, active U.S. medical license and board certification (ABMS or AOA) in Radiation Oncology.
  • Eligible to acquire additional state licensure as required
  • 3 or more years of relevant clinical experience post residency/fellowship
  • Knowledge of applicable state and federal laws, Utilization Review Accreditation Commission and National Committee for Quality Assurance standards is a plus
  • Ability to commit to a set, weekly work schedule (Monday through Friday)
  • Strong computer skills: ability to work autonomously with automated processes, computer applications, and systems
  • Meet physical demands of the role including, but not limited to, typing, speaking, and listening 100% of time
  • In accordance with our HITECH Security Accreditation, company provided encrypted-workstation is required to be hard-wire connected to a modem or router. Wireless connection is not permitted.

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary of 207,800 - 346,300 USD / yearly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.

This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus plan.


At The Cigna Group, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits, with a focus on supporting your whole health. Starting on day one of your employment, you’ll be offered several health-related benefits including medical, vision, dental, and well-being and behavioral health programs. We also offer 401(k), company paid life insurance, tuition reimbursement, a minimum of 18 days of paid time off per year, paid holidays, and leaves of absence. For more details on our employee benefits programs, click here.

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

jobs.excerpt: COMPANY ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIESAbout the RoleReporting to the Influencer Marketing Manager, you’ll own and run RYZE’s affiliate program on AspireIQ end to end — recruiting affiliates, managing the platform, optimizing commission structures, and ensuring the program consistently drives revenue and surfaces high-performing creators for paid partnerships.
jobs.description:
COMPANY


ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

About the Role

Reporting to the Influencer Marketing Manager, you’ll own and run RYZE’s affiliate program on AspireIQ end to end — recruiting affiliates, managing the platform, optimizing commission structures, and ensuring the program consistently drives revenue and surfaces high-performing creators for paid partnerships.

This is a performance role. You’ll be measured on affiliate-driven revenue, program growth, and the quality of the creator pipeline you build.

What You’ll Do

  • Onboarding, and platform administration.

  • Set and manage commission structures, codes, and links, and process affiliate payouts accurately and on time.

  • Monitor program performance (clicks, conversions, revenue) and report on affiliate contribution to overall creator-driven revenue.

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of high-performing affiliates, sourcing new creators and promoting standout creators into paid tiers.

  • Ensure affiliate content and disclosures meet FTC guidelines and RYZE brand standards.

  • Monitor for fraud, coupon abuse, and policy violations, and resolve escalations.

  • Partner with finance and ops on payout reconciliation and reporting.

  • Communicate regularly with affiliates on program updates, incentives, and performance feedback to keep top performers engaged.

  • Consistently run A/B tests to optimize different areas of the affiliate funnel.

What We’re Looking For

Someone who treats affiliate marketing as a performance channel, not an admin function. You know how commission structures work, what drives affiliate motivation, and how to read program data to find what to optimize next. You’re organized enough to manage a high volume of affiliate relationships without errors in payouts or tracking, and sharp enough to know which creators to invest in and which to cut. You understand FTC requirements and take compliance seriously without it slowing you down.

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in affiliate or influencer marketing, ideally managing a program on AspireIQ or a similar affiliate platform.

  • Comfort with commission structures, payout processes, and performance metrics.

  • Extremely organized, with strong attention to detail managing a high volume of affiliate relationships.

  • Solid spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets/Excel) for tracking and reporting.

  • Clear, professional written communication.

  • A performance mindset and bias toward action.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AspireIQ specifically.

  • Familiarity with FTC disclosure requirements for affiliate and influencer content.

  • Food & beverage or wellness category experience.

  • Experience supporting a gifting or paid creator program alongside affiliate.

  • Experience managing community platforms like Google Groups, Discord, etc.

Location & Travel

Remote (US), with occasional travel for content shoots, creator events, and experiential activations.

The Sr. Manager of Front Office Solutions is responsible for the overall strategy, delivery, and day-to-day support of CAA’s Front-Office technology solutions that serve CAA’s customers and business partners. This role establishes and maintains strategic relationships with business leaders and influences product management and other IT functions to ensure alignment with company objectives, architecture, security, and long-term strategy. This individual will balance operational excellence of existing platforms with leadership in designing and delivering new, transformational digital capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Defines and drives the front-office technology strategy and roadmap, aligning with business priorities and growth objectives.
  • Works with business leaders, product management teams and IT teams to prioritize and lead delivery of new capabilities, enhancements, and operational improvements across the front-office portfolio.
  • Owns and evolves the portfolio roadmap and service capabilities, ensuring alignment to enterprise strategy and business outcomes.
  • Leads the planning, design, development, and deployment of scalable front-office solutions.

  • Drives execution across distributed internal teams and external partners to deliver high-quality technology solutions.
  • Establishes and promotes best practices in Agile, DevOps, and modern engineering methodologies.
  • Oversees the ongoing operations, support, and continuous improvement of front-office platforms to ensure reliability, performance, and user satisfaction.
  • Monitors service health, performance metrics, and adoption to ensure delivery of business value.
  • Develops and sustains strategic relationships with key technology vendors and partners.
  • Guides cross-functional teams and stakeholders to align business processes, technology capabilities, and delivery timelines.

Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across business and IT organizations.

  • Proven ability to align people, process, and technology to deliver business value at scale.
  • Strong customer-focused mindset with emphasis on user experience and service excellence.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and execution discipline.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Engineering, Management, or related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Proven leadership experience managing large-scale technology delivery and operations teams.
  • Strong experience in the Salesforce ecosystem (Sales, Service, Marketing, Experience Cloud), 3+ years.
  • Deep hands-on experience delivering and operating digital platforms (UI/UX, modern web/mobile development frameworks, portal technologies, content management platforms, knowledge bases, etc.).
  • Strong experience with Agile and DevOps delivery practices across the full software development lifecycle.
  • Experience leading distributed and cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong understanding of solution architecture, integrations, and enterprise technology ecosystems.
  • Experience working closely with business leadership and influencing product management organizations.
  • Industry experience in transportation/logistics, insurance claims, and/or supply chain systems strongly preferred

Compensation & Other Information

Job Description:

Japan HR Services Team Leader (Remote role based in Dalian/Onsite role based in Shanghai, China)

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

Role Overview

The HR Services Team Lead for Japan is a member of the Global HR Service Delivery Operations team and is accountable for the delivery of high-quality HR services for Japan.
This is a remote role based in Dalian, China, supporting HR service delivery for the Japan market.

This role provides leadership and direction for the Japan HR Services operation, ensuring consistent, compliant, and employee-centric service delivery through a combination of local and remote resources. The position serves as the primary point of accountability for HR Service Delivery in Japan, overseeing day-to-day operations while maintaining a hands-on role in service execution and issue resolution.

The HR Services Team Lead partners closely with local HR teams, regional HR Operations, Centers of Excellence (COEs), vendors, and global stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery, operational excellence, and business continuity. Beyond operational management, the role drives continuous improvement through process simplification, standardization, digitization, and automation initiatives that enhance both employee experience and operational efficiency.

The successful candidate will build strong stakeholder partnerships, foster trust and understanding of the HR Services model, and lead change initiatives that support the evolution of HR service delivery in Japan.

What Differentiates This Role

Unlike a traditional HR Operations role, this position will be based in Dalian, China but is accountable for the overall success of HR Services delivery in Japan. The role combines team leadership, operational accountability, service ownership, employee experience, and transformation leadership, with a strong emphasis on process simplification, automation, service optimization, and sustainable service delivery excellence.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As an HR Services Coordinator, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

HR Service Delivery Leadership & Team Management

  • Own overall HR Service Delivery performance for Japan, ensuring high-quality, consistent, and compliant services
  • Lead and coordinate a blended team of local and remote HR Services resources supporting Japan
  • Prioritize workloads, allocate resources, and ensure service continuity across all HR operational activities
  • Monitor service performance, identify risks and capacity challenges, and drive proactive resolution
  • Coach, support, and develop team members while fostering collaboration, accountability, and a service excellence mindset
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex employee, manager, and stakeholder issues

Service Delivery & Operations

  • Provide hands-on support for HR operations while ensuring effective execution across the wider team
  • Respond to employee and manager inquiries, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of HR-related requests
  • Oversee employee lifecycle administration, including hiring, termination, leave of absence (LOA), transfers, and return-from-leave processes
  • Manage document administration and coordination with employees, managers, vendors, and external authorities
  • Ensure accuracy and integrity of employee data maintained in Workday and other HR systems
  • Drive adherence to established service standards, controls, and compliance requirements
  • Manage relationships with external vendors, government agencies, and regulatory bodies
  • Ensure accurate preparation and issuance of employment-related certificates and documentation
  • Maintain compliance with local regulations, internal standards, and audit requirements

Benefits & Programs Administration

  • Oversee administration of pension programs (DB/DC), health insurance programs, and other country-specific HR processes
  • Oversee administration of employee benefit programs and related processes, including:
    • Company housing programs
    • Employee savings plans and group insurance
    • Relocation support and allowances
    • Various employee allowances and reimbursements
  • Ensure timely vendor coordination, payroll inputs, payments, reconciliations, and employee support
  • Drive process consistency and service quality across all benefits-related activities

Process Ownership & Operational Excellence

  • Act as the end-to-end process owner for HR Services delivery across Japan
  • Maintain visibility across all operational processes, identifying dependencies, bottlenecks, risks, and improvement opportunities
  • Drive alignment and coordination across local HR, regional HR Operations, COEs, Payroll, Finance, and external partners
  • Establish governance and operational discipline to ensure sustainable service delivery and workload management
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, knowledge repositories, and service standards

Continuous Improvement, Simplification & Automation

  • Lead initiatives to simplify, streamline, and modernize HR service delivery processes
  • Challenge existing ways of working and identify opportunities for increased efficiency, scalability, and quality
  • Drive adoption of automation, self-service solutions, digital tools, and workflow optimization

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

jobs.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Alteryx is searching for a VP, Product Management. This position is remote-friendly; collaboration with engineering, UX, and PM teams in the U.S., Australia, Prague, and India is expected.

About Alteryx:

Alteryx is the business logic layer for the intelligent enterprise. More than 8,000 customers — including Bank of America, Coca-Cola, and Siemens — depend on us to turn data into decisions, and last year they processed 774 trillion records on our platform. We are a company of more than a billion dollars in revenue.

About The Role:

AI doesn’t know how your company runs finance operations. Neither does your data platform. The context that makes AI useful inside an enterprise — the business logic, the exceptions, the way this company actually does this work — lives in Alteryx workflows, across finance, retail, supply chain, and beyond.

That context is also what makes AI credible. Enterprises stall at the same wall every time: nobody can tell whether the answer is right, why it came out that way, or who is accountable if it isn’t. Analysis has to be trusted, understandable, and auditable before an organization will let it run the business, and the workflow is where that accountability lives.

We’re now embarking on the next phase of the story: reimagining the product for an AI-first era. Analysts should be able to describe a business problem and get it solved. Their analysis and their workflows should become the backbone of the agentic systems running inside their business.

We’re looking for a Vice President of Product Management to make that real. You’ll report to the Chief Product Officer as a core member of the product leadership team, with executive sponsorship for the mandate and the latitude to shape both the organization and the strategy around what you learn.

What This Role Is Not:

This is not a caretaker job for a mature product, and it is not a year of discovery. We have a point of view on where this is going, and we’re looking for someone who will make it sharper — not someone who needs to start from a blank page. You’ll reshape the central paradigm of a product that millions of hours of existing work depend on, while that business keeps performing. If you want a clean sheet, this isn’t it.

What Success Looks Like:

We know where we want to go. We need someone to get us there quickly, and to keep the destination honest as the ground shifts. In the first year that means movement on what product can actually move — evaluation win rate, activation, time-to-first-outcome, POC conversion — and shipped proof rather than slideware. In the second it shows up in new business and in expansion within existing customers. Throughout, the current business stays healthy while it is reshaped for an AI-first, data-platform-first future. This role suits someone who arrives with a high bar, gets to conviction fast, and is measured by what reaches customers.

What You’ll Do:

  • Sharpen the Vision and Land It:Bring the original thinking that keeps our direction right as the market moves, and convert it into a sequenced plan with real tradeoffs — one engineers want to build, sellers can sell, and customers recognize as true.

  • Hold the Bar on the Experience:Be accountable for what it feels like to use Alteryx — onboarding, first-run, and the everyday analyst workflow. Set the standard with Design, and hold it when schedules get tight.

  • Grow New and Existing Business: Own the product side of competitive evaluations — first-run, time-to-first-outcome, trial and POC success — and the expansion path that turns a first workflow into an enterprise footprint. Work with Sales, SE, and Marketing on why deals go the way they do, and close the gaps.

  • Own the Business:Act as the business owner for your portfolio: shape pricing and packaging, make the case for investment, and be accountable for the commercial outcome, not just the release.

  • Know the Market and the Customer:Develop first-hand understanding of the competitive field and where buyers are actually headed. Spend real time with prospects and non-customers, not just advocates.

  • Operate on Evidence:Instrument the product and define the metrics that matter. Build a culture where hypotheses get tested rather than debated.

  • Build the Team:Lead and mentor a team of Directors and Product Managers, developing both managers and senior individual contributors, with a culture of customer obsession, evidence, and pace.

  • Build the Coalition: Partner with Design, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, SE, and CX to deliver a complete experience, not a set of features. Present to the ELT monthly and support quarterly board preparation.

You’re A Good Fit If You Have:

  • Led product management teams where the quality of the experience was the product’s advantage, and can say what you rejected to protect it.

  • Delivered results inside your first year in a senior role, in an organization that was already running.

  • Been accountable for a number and a transformation at the same time.

  • Shipped products that won competitive deals — you can point to new-logo growth or expansion you materially influenced.

  • Shipped and measured a production AI feature, and can describe what you evaluated and what you killed because it demoed well and failed in production.

  • Owned commercial outcomes for a portfolio — pricing, packaging, or the investment case.

  • Led as a leader of leaders, with credibility at executive level across functions.

You’ll Have An Edge If You Have:

  • Familiarity with the governance, lineage, and explainability expectations of regulated and data-mature enterprises.

  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms and how they integrate into analytics workflows.

  • Experience leading globally distributed teams.

Compensation:

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as your relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

The salary range for this role in the United States is $275,000 - $325,000.

In addition, you may be eligible for additional compensation, such as a bonus. Employees may also be eligible for a wide range of other benefits, including medical, retirement, financial, wellness, time off, employee discounts, and others.

Interested? Learn more and apply today at alteryx.com/careers!

If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

We are seeking a highly technical Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE) to support a U.S. Navy program through the Risk Management Framework (RMF), Authority to Operate (ATO), system hardening, vulnerability remediation, and day-to-day security engineering activities.

This is a hands-on engineering position. The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly on Linux servers, virtualization infrastructure, network infrastructure, and security monitoring platforms to implement, troubleshoot, validate, and maintain security controls.

The successful candidate will work closely with system administrators, network engineers, and cybersecurity personnel to identify security gaps and implement practical technical solutions that satisfy Navy RMF/ATO requirements.

This position is not primarily focused on strategy, program planning, configuration management, or developing project/VM plans. The focus is on technical execution and engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Perform hands-on security engineering in support of Navy RMF and ATO requirements.
  • Implement and validate technical security controls across servers, virtualization, network, and logging environments.
  • Harden systems in accordance with applicable DISA STIGs, Navy security requirements, and RMF control requirements.
  • Perform vulnerability remediation, including analysis of findings, root-cause identification, remediation, and validation.
  • Configure, secure, troubleshoot, and validate RHEL/Linux systems.
  • Support security hardening and troubleshooting of VMware environments.
  • Perform security configuration and troubleshooting of Cisco Catalyst and Cisco ACI infrastructure.
  • Support centralized security logging and monitoring using Splunk and Cribl.
  • Analyze system and security logs to troubleshoot issues and validate security requirements.
  • Support collection and validation of technical evidence required for RMF/ATO activities.
  • Translate RMF security requirements into practical technical implementations.
  • Work directly with infrastructure teams to remediate security deficiencies.
  • Automate repetitive security engineering and validation tasks where appropriate.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, systems engineering, network engineering, or information assurance.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting RMF and ATO activities within a DoD environment.
  • Strong hands-on experience with RHEL/Linux administration and security hardening.
  • Experience implementing and validating DISA STIG requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with VMware environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Catalyst switching and Cisco ACI.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk and Cribl or comparable enterprise logging technologies.
  • Strong understanding of vulnerability scanning, remediation, and security validation.
  • Strong Linux command-line and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure and security issues across operating-system, virtualization, network, and logging layers.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. Navy or DoD mission systems.
  • Experience with Navy RMF processes and ATO assessments.
  • Experience with eMASS.
  • Experience interpreting and implementing DISA STIGs across multiple technology platforms.
  • Experience with Tenable/Nessus or comparable vulnerability-scanning platforms.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting languages used for security automation.
  • Experience troubleshooting authentication, access control, auditing, encryption, and system logging requirements.
  • Experience integrating infrastructure logs into Splunk through Cribl.
  • Experience with SCAP/STIG compliance tooling.

Security Clearance

  • Active DoD Secret clearance required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any additional program-specific access requirements.

Certifications

  • Security+
  • CISSP
  • CySA+
  • Linux-related certification

Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.excerpt: Why WarriorBabe?  At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth.
jobs.description:
Why WarriorBabe?

At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth. You'll be surrounded by a vibrant team that shares your passion for fitness and helping women flourish. Together, we are on a mission to transform lives and create a community that thrives on empowerment.

Offering personalized macronutrient plans and workout programming, WarriorBabe ensures each woman's unique needs are met. With one-on-one coaching, a dedicated mobile app, and a vibrant online community, WarriorBabe provides the tools and support necessary for lasting success. Ideal for women of all ages and fitness levels, WarriorBabe adapts to ensure continuous progress and achievement of fitness goals.

Our Mission

Help 100,000 women regain their personal power and feel confident in their skin.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced HR Generalist to support and take ownership of the day-to-day HR operations across WarriorBabe and our growing business lines.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who knows how to keep HR operations organized, accurate, and moving forward. You will be a primary point of contact for employees and leaders on day-to-day HR matters while supporting payroll, benefits, compliance, HR systems, documentation, and employee processes.

We're looking for someone who is comfortable working independently, has strong knowledge of multi-state employment compliance, understands payroll and HR administration, and can proactively identify and solve problems before they become bigger issues.

You won't simply be checking boxes — you'll be trusted to own your area, solve problems, and make sure things get done.

This role will partner closely with the Director of People and Chief People Officer. The broader People leadership team will continue to own strategy, organizational development, recruiting strategy, compensation, and complex escalations, while you will play a key role in the day-to-day execution and administration that keeps the People function running smoothly.

What You'll Own

HR Operations

  • Own day-to-day HR operations and employee support
  • Serve as a trusted resource for employees and managers on HR-related questions and processes
  • Manage employee changes including promotions, transfers, compensation changes, status changes, and other personnel updates
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and documentation
  • Help develop, document, and improve HR processes and standard operating procedures
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve HR processes

Payroll

  • Own the end-to-end payroll process, ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing
  • Review payroll for accuracy, including wages, deductions, bonuses, commissions, PTO, employee changes, and other adjustments
  • Understand payroll tax requirements, liabilities, and multi-state payroll considerations
  • Partner with payroll providers and internal stakeholders to resolve payroll issues
  • Reconcile payroll and identify discrepancies before payroll is finalized
  • Maintain accurate payroll records and documentation
  • Monitor and respond to payroll-related tax notices and issues

Benefits & Leave Administration

  • Manage day-to-day benefits administration and employee support
  • Process benefit enrollments, changes, eligibility, and terminations
  • Partner with benefit providers and vendors to resolve issues
  • Administer PTO, leave, and other employee time-off programs
  • Maintain accurate benefit and leave records
  • Support annual benefits processes and open enrollment

Multi-State HR Compliance

  • Help maintain compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws across multiple states
  • Monitor changes in employment regulations and flag potential impacts
  • Manage state registrations, employment notices, tax notices, and other compliance requirements
  • Maintain required employee and workplace documentation
  • Support audits and compliance reviews
  • Partner with leadership and external advisors when specialized legal guidance is needed
  • Proactively identify potential compliance concerns and bring them forward

HR Systems & Data

  • Manage day-to-day administration of the HRIS and related People systems
  • Ensure employee data, organizational information, compensation, job information, and employment records remain accurate
  • Manage system changes, workflows, permissions, and employee updates
  • Maintain People documentation, resources, and internal HR knowledge bases
  • Use HR data to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for process improvement

Onboarding & Offboarding Administration

  • Manage the administrative side of employee onboarding and offboarding
  • Ensure new hires are properly set up in HR, payroll, benefits, and applicable systems
  • Manage employment documentation and required forms
  • Coordinate employee changes and terminations across relevant systems and vendors
  • Ensure offboarding processes are completed accurately and on time

Workers' Compensation & Retirement

  • Manage day-to-day administration related to workers' compensation
  • Support workers' compensation claims, audits, renewals, and documentation
  • Manage administrative responsibilities related to the company's 401(k) plan
  • Coordinate with plan providers and vendors to resolve employee or administrative issues
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure required processes are completed on time

What We're Looking For

You are someone who takes ownership. You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done, and you don't need to be micromanaged to keep things moving.

We're looking for someone with:

  • 3-5+ years of progressive HR experience
  • Strong understanding of multi-state employment compliance
  • Deep knowledge of payroll processing, payroll taxes, deductions, and payroll liabilities
  • Experience administering benefits, PTO/leave, workers' compensation, and retirement plans
  • Strong HRIS experience and confidence managing employee data and workflows
  • Experience managing audits, reconciliations, and compliance requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee information with discretion
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions
  • A process-oriented mindset with a desire to continuously improve how things are done
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, growing company where processes are continually evolving

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience supporting multiple companies, entities, or business lines
  • Experience in a high-growth or startup environment
  • Experience working with remote teams across multiple states
  • Experience with Rippling or a similar HRIS

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means the day-to-day People operations run smoothly and employees have a reliable, knowledgeable HR resource.

You will create confidence that:

  • Payroll is accurate and on time
  • Employee questions are answered quickly and effectively
  • Benefits and leave are administered correctly
  • HR compliance requirements are proactively managed
  • Employee records and HR systems are accurate
  • Onboarding and offboarding processes run smoothly
  • Audits, reconciliations, and administrative requirements don't fall through the cracks
  • HR processes are documented, organized, and scalable
  • Issues are identified and solved before they become bigger problems

Most importantly, you will become the person leadership can trust to say, "I've got it."

Why WarriorBabe?

You'll be joining a growing company with an ambitious mission and the opportunity to help build something from the ground up.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a perfectly established HR department and simply maintain it. We're growing quickly, expanding into new business lines, and building the infrastructure to support that growth.

You'll Have the Opportunity To:

  • Own meaningful HR responsibilities with real autonomy
  • Partner closely with People and executive leadership
  • Build and improve scalable HR processes and systems
  • Make a tangible impact on the employee experience
  • Help strengthen the People function as WarriorBabe grows
  • Grow your career and take on greater responsibility as the company evolves

If you're an experienced HR professional who loves ownership, problem-solving, compliance, and building better processes and is ready to grow your career in a meaningful way, we'd love to meet you.

Salary Range: $65,000 - $75,000

Mission Statement:

We are Black Rifle Coffee Company, a veteran-founded company serving premium, fresh-roasted coffee to people who love America. We have a love for coffee, dogs, the outdoors, America, and most importantly, our customers! We are more than a product and more than a company; we are a culture. A culture full of motivated people who roll up their sleeves and get the job done with integrity, love, innovation, and radical transparency. Join us as we take action on our commitment to provide quality coffee and give back to the veteran and first responder communities and those who support it.

Job Summary

The Key Account Manager – Grocery is responsible for driving profitable growth across a portfolio of regional grocery customers, including H-E-B, Meijer, Hy-Vee, Schnucks, Brookshire Brothers, and Rouses Markets. This role will directly own retailer relationships, annual business planning, distribution growth, trade investments, and overall account performance to deliver net revenue, market share, and gross margin objectives.

The ideal candidate has direct CPG sales experience managing major grocery retailers, with specific experience working directly with H-E-B or Meijer corporate teams strongly preferred. This individual should be comfortable independently managing a complex portfolio of accounts

Job Details

Base compensation for this role is $90,000-$110,000 annually.

Leadership and Functional Responsibilities

  • Customer Development: Directly own and develop retailer relationships across assigned accounts. Serve as the primary BRCC contact for buyers and key customer stakeholders, leading line reviews, negotiations, promotional planning, new item sell-in, and distribution initiatives.

  • Vision & Planning: Translate annual operating plans into customer-specific Joint Business Plans (JBPs) and growth strategies focused on revenue, distribution, assortment, shelf presence, and market share.

  • Fiscal Management: Own customer P&Ls and manage trade spending, pricing, promotional investments, deductions, and customer agreements to drive profitable growth.

  • Business Performance: Analyze sales, velocity, distribution, promotional performance, and customer profitability to identify opportunities and proactively address performance gaps across the portfolio.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Sales, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, and Marketing to support forecasting, retail execution, customer initiatives, and long-term account growth.

Travel Requirements

25-30% travel to support retailer meetings, line reviews, customer planning sessions, market visits, and other business needs. Some weekend travel may be required.

Education and Skill Requirements

  • Minimum 3+ years of sales or key account management experience within CPG, with direct grocery retail experience strongly preferred.

  • Direct experience working with H-E-B or Meijer corporate teams required, including buyer relationships, line reviews, annual planning, promotions, and distribution growth.

  • Demonstrated experience directly owning retailer relationships and a multi-account book of business, including revenue and customer P&L responsibility.
