jobs.excerpt: A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoaEngenheiro de Software AI-Native (Dominio em Python),para se juntar a nossa equipe dinâmica e atuar em parceria com a maior construtora da América Latina, que ao longo de sua existência, sempre esteve sintonizada com o mercado e as melhores práticas, além de priorizar sempre as necessidades de seus clientes.
jobs.description:
A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoaEngenheiro de Software AI-Native (Dominio em Python),para se juntar a nossa equipe dinâmica e atuar em parceria com a maior construtora da América Latina, que ao longo de sua existência, sempre esteve sintonizada com o mercado e as melhores práticas, além de priorizar sempre as necessidades de seus clientes.Éuma empresa que está em constante movimento, se reinventando a cada dia para oferecer soluções de moradia para todas as gerações.

Sobre o Time:

Nosso time é o motor da transformação digital e o principal responsável pela disseminação do uso de Inteligência Artificial em toda a companhia. Além da governança técnica (Python e Power BI), lideramos o desenvolvimento de soluções avançadas de GenAI e Low Code (Power Platform e n8n), entregando desde diversos assistentes conversacionais integrados ao WhatsApp até agentes autônomos executores de tarefas, além de inúmeras outras ferramentas.

Atuamos de forma transversal: recebemos demandas e desafios de todas as áreas de negócio e da TI, e nossa missão não é apenas solucionar problemas, mas sim transformar necessidades pontuais em produtos escaláveis. Gerimos uma plataforma interna de criação de assistentes virtuais e ferramentas que democratizam o uso da IA para milhares de colaboradores. Se você gosta de transformar uma dor operacional em uma solução que impacta milhares de pessoas, aqui é o seu lugar.

Principais atividades

  • Produzir software de forma AI-native: conduzir agentes e LLMs a partir de especificações, mantendo responsabilidade técnica integral pelo resultado. Você especifica, orquestra, revisa e responde pelo código. A IA executa;
  • Conduzir o ciclo de Spec-Driven Development: transformar requisitos em especificações executáveis e artefatos de contexto (ex.: /specify, /plan) que servem de contrato para o trabalho humano e para os agentes.
  • Calibrar a autonomia progressiva da IA conforme risco e maturidade do contexto: saber quando aceitar a geração autônoma e quando intervir manualmente, sem perder o controle do "o quê" e do "porquê".
  • Participar do rito de Pull Request Aumentado, revisando não apenas sintaxe, mas intencionalidade: aderência aos critérios de aceite, decisões técnicas e impacto funcional — inclusive sobre código gerado por agentes, não só por humanos.
  • Contribuir para a camada de conhecimento e os contextos reutilizáveis (skills, padrões, decisões arquiteturais, conectores/MCPs) que tornam os agentes consistentes e confiáveis no domínio da MRV.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de arquitetura e engenharia para entregar código limpo, testável e sustentável, em sistemas de diferentes características (monolitos e/ou distribuídos), com foco em valor de negócio e ritmo sustentável.
  • Contribuir com testes automatizados, observabilidade — inclusive sobre a qualidade e o custo do output de IA — e práticas que reduzam retrabalho e débito técnico.
  • Atuar em times colaborativos guiados por valor, usando metodologias ágeis e práticas como code review, pair e mob programming, compartilhando aprendizados e sendo mentorado(a) por profissionais mais experientes.

Conhecimento técnico (mandatório)

  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento de software, com domínio forte em Python e capacidade comprovada de transitar pelas demais com apoio de IA. Valorizamos experiência Fullstack.
  • Spec-Driven Development como competência central: escrever especificações não ambíguas, decompor em planos verificáveis e definir critérios de aceite que funcionem como contrato para humanos e agentes (ex.: /specify, /plan).
  • Engenharia de Contexto: construção e gestão de contexto para LLMs — instruções, restrições, exemplos, seleção de ferramentas/MCPs e controle da janela de contexto.
  • Uso de IA Generativa e ferramentas agentivas aplicado ao desenvolvimento, com responsabilidade, senso crítico e validação humana sistemática.
  • Leitura crítica de código que você não escreveu: avaliar, validar e corrigir output de IA e de terceiros com a mesma profundidade do próprio código.
  • Habilidade para escrever código de alta qualidade, bem organizado e testável, com domínio de OO e/ou bons princípios de design.
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários e/ou de integração).
  • Uso de Git para versionamento e colaboração via Pull Requests.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e fundamentos de modelagem de dados.
  • Vivência com práticas ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou XP).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prática com orquestração de agentes e MCPs/conectores (composição de ferramentas, automação de fluxos com IA).
  • Familiaridade com avaliação e observabilidade de output de IA (medir qualidade, regressões, custo de tokens) e com arquiteturas model-agnostic.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas, microsserviços ou mensageria.
  • Vivência com CI/CD, automação de build e release.
  • Conhecimento em nuvem e/ou contêineres (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experiência com frameworks de GenAI como LlamaIndex e LangChain.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de RAG, Tools e MCP.
  • Experiência com Streamlit para front-end.
  • Experiência com processos Assíncronos, Paralelos e Filas.
  • Manipulação de dados com Pandas.
  • Vivência com ferramentas Low Code (principalmente N8N).
  • Experiência com automação para SAP HANA.
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com GCP e/ou Azure DevOps.

Soft skills e comportamentos

  • Clareza de escrita e de especificação como skill de primeira ordem: no modelo AI-native, especificar bem é programar. Quem especifica mal, gera mal.
  • Pensamento crítico e ceticismo técnico: não confiar cegamente em soluções automáticas, especialmente as geradas por IA.
  • Conforto com ambiguidade e com delegar: soltar o controle do "como" mantendo o controle do "o quê" e do "porquê".
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade para buscar soluções sem depender de direcionamento constante.
  • Comunicação clara para discutir requisitos, decisões técnicas e trade-offs.
  • Colaboração e respeito ao time, valorizando o aprendizado coletivo.
  • Adaptabilidade em um ambiente de rápida evolução tecnológica.
  • Importa-se genuinamente com o sucesso do produto e do time.
  • Assume responsabilidades mesmo quando não são formalmente atribuídas.
  • Aprende com erros, celebra conquistas coletivas e se posiciona com coragem diante de decisões difíceis.

The Business Data team accelerates the adoption, innovation, and go-to-market of Zillow's B2B products serving agents, brokerages, and partners. We build scalable data products, infrastructure, and insights spanning data science, data engineering, platforms, and product analytics, partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to embed data-driven decision-making into go-to-market strategy and product development. Our current portfolio includes agent and broker analytics platforms, listing supply strategy and industry graph analytics, AI-enabled data practices, ML-driven sales segmentation and account prioritization, and rich media experiences. We are investing in this team, so this is an opportunity to join an organization growing in both size and influence.

About the role

Broker and brokerage partnerships are a strategic focus for Zillow and one of the biggest growth opportunities in residential real estate. Brokers sit at a critical distribution level, and Zillow is investing in new products and programs to unlock the full potential of these partnerships. Robust measurement and strategic guidance will power what comes next: understanding where value is created, what's working, and where to invest.

The Business Data team is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to serve as a core analytics lead for Zillow's broker data products, measurement strategy, and enterprise ROI, turning on the lights to the depth and value of broker relationships across the Zillow Group ecosystem. You will lead the design of broker-level success metrics and the causal inference frameworks that measure product, go-to-market, and business impact at the enterprise level, and build the trusted, scalable analytical foundations that turn complex data into insights decision-makers act on. The data products you build won't just inform internal decisions; they will help Zillow deliver more value to broker partners and their customers. This is a newly formed pod with significant company investment and executive visibility: few roles offer this much influence over how a strategic priority is measured, understood, and grown.

This work is highly visible to senior leadership, and your insights will directly shape how Zillow invests in one of its biggest strategic areas. For a data scientist ready to grow, this is a rare opportunity to build a high-visibility charter from the ground up, with a clear runway to expand your scope, influence senior leaders, and sharpen your craft alongside a broad data organization working across AI-enabled analytics, data products, and measurement. You will see your work show up quickly in decisions, product direction, and the value Zillow delivers to its partners.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the high-context analytics owner for broker data products and go-to-market, establishing durable methodology and metric standards

  • Independently scope and deliver end-to-end measurement and data science projects, from problem framing through methodology design, validation, and productionization

  • Lead the design of broker-level success metrics and causal inference frameworks (e.g., matching, difference-in-differences) that quantify the impact of products, features, and go-to-market initiatives at the enterprise level

  • Partner with Product Managers and go-to-market teams to design, deploy, and execute measurement roadmaps, guiding data product development from problem definition through measurement and iteration

  • Conduct analytical deep dives and opportunity sizing to inform product and go-to-market roadmaps; Provide data-driven recommendations to senior leadership, clearly communicating trade-offs, assumptions, and impact

  • Build reliable, scalable analytical pipelines, scheduled jobs, and reusable data products that scale insights and demonstrate product value to partners and customers; Leverage AI-assisted analytics workflows to scale your impact, while designing core analytical logic in deterministic, verifiable ways

  • Support externally facing product value narratives with rigorous, defensible methodology

Scope & impact

  • Pioneering Senior Data Scientist at the center of Zillow's broker data product and go-to-market strategy, with executive visibility and sponsorship

  • Owns broker measurement and data product analytics end to end, delivering solutions with limited oversight

  • Shapes the metrics, measurement approaches, and methodology standards that make broker data products trusted and actionable across the org

  • Balances speed and rigor, making sound trade-offs in measurement, analysis, and stakeholder alignment

  • Individual contributor role with no direct reports, working within a broad data organization that creates meaningful opportunities for cross-domain learning and influence

Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

You are energized by ambiguous, high-impact problems and love turning complex data into decisions people trust. You hold a high bar for analytical rigor, enjoy partnering across functions, and take pride in seeing your insights change what a business does. You appreciate the unique challenges of building and measuring B2B products and go-to-market.

Additionally, we expect you to have:

  • Strong foundation in statistics, causal inference, and experimentation (A/B testing), with high analytical rigor and demonstrated ability to design clear, durable metrics and assess product or go-to-market impact from definition through decision-making

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience partnering with Product Managers, engineers, and go-to-market teams, influencing decisions, and communicating complex findings to technical and non-technical audiences; B2B product and business strategy experience are a plus

  • Experience with product analytics at a senior level, including measurement, experimentation, clickstream and segment analysis, and influencing decisions with data; experience building end-to-end predictive ML models is a strong plus

  • Experience building reliable, scalable analytical pipelines and scheduled data jobs, or contributing to data and analytics platform development, is a plus

  • Ability to work independently in ambiguous spaces as a self-starting, end-to-end owner; data visualization experience (e.g., Tableau) is preferred but not required

About the position:

The Clinical Education – Preceptor Network Recruiter is responsible for building and expanding AMO's national clinical network by identifying, engaging, and developing partnerships with physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and healthcare organizations that support clinical education programs.

This is a highly results-driven role designed for professionals who already possess a strong foundation in clinical education, healthcare recruitment, provider relations, clinical coordination, or credentialing and are motivated to make an immediate impact. While AMO provides training on our systems, processes, and platform, successful candidates bring industry knowledge, professional judgment, and the confidence to quickly operate with a high level of independence. This role is remote, but theClinical Education – Preceptor Network Recruiter is expected to collaborate with teammatesvirtually ona regular basis to ensure team goals are met and recruited leads successfully transition into active clinical training sites and preceptor partnerships. The company alsomaintainsan office in Chicago that theRecruiter mayutilizeon an as-needed basis.

The Clinical Education – Preceptor Network Recruiter owns a strategic recruitment pipeline from initial outreach through onboarding readiness, balancing relationship-building with measurable business outcomes. Success in this role is driven by thoughtful execution—not simply outreach volume. High performers know how to prioritize opportunities, build trusted relationships, and consistently convert conversations into long-term clinical partnerships that support AMO's continued growth.

This position is best suited for professionals who thrive in an environment built on ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Individuals who enjoy solving problems, thinking strategically, and delivering measurable results will excel in this role.

 

While this position can be fully remote, we are looking for candidates to be residents of Alabama, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Michigan, New York, Ohio, or Texas.

  • Collaborate closely with Partnerships, Operations, and cross-functional teams to meet school partner needs and placement timelines
  • Communicate professionally and proactively with both external partners and internal stakeholders, leveraging professional networks such as LinkedIn, while ensuring timely follow-up and exceptional customer experience
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruitment strategies, outreach effectiveness, and internal processes while maintaining consistency with established workflows
  • Other duties as assigned

A OSF Digital está em busca de uma pessoa QA Automation Engineer para atuar em projetos de um cliente do segmento bancário, contribuindo para a qualidade, confiabilidade e segurança de aplicações que suportam funcionalidades críticas para os usuários e para o negócio.

Essa posição terá papel fundamental no desenvolvimento, na manutenção e na evolução de estratégias, frameworks e scripts de testes automatizados. A pessoa será responsável por apoiar a validação funcional e não funcional das aplicações, com atenção especial a fluxos financeiros, integrações, autenticação, autorização, processamento de transações, consistência de dados e continuidade dos serviços.

O objetivo principal será ampliar a cobertura de testes, identificar riscos antecipadamente, otimizar os processos de QA e contribuir para ciclos de entrega de software mais seguros, previsíveis e eficientes.

A pessoa ideal para essa oportunidade possui experiência sólida em automação de testes, conhecimento de metodologias e práticas de QA, familiaridade com pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas e capacidade de atuar em colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.

Responsabilidades
  • Projetar, desenvolver, manter e evoluir scripts, componentes e frameworks de testes automatizados.
  • Definir estratégias de automação considerando riscos, criticidade, frequência de execução, retorno do investimento e esforço de manutenção.
  • Implementar automação para diferentes tipos e níveis de testes, incluindo:
    • Testes funcionais;
    • Testes de regressão;
    • Testes de integração;
    • Testes de API e serviços;
    • Testes end-to-end;
    • Testes de performance, carga e estresse;
    • Testes de contrato, quando aplicável;
    • Testes de segurança em colaboração com as equipes especializadas;
    • Testes de compatibilidade e, quando aplicável, testes em aplicações mobile.
  • Validar funcionalidades críticas do negócio, como autenticação, autorização, controle de acesso, processamento de transações, limites, saldos, consistência de dados, notificações e integrações com sistemas internos e externos.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de produto, desenvolvimento, arquitetura, segurança e QA na identificação, análise e priorização de cenários de teste.

jobs.excerpt: Sobre nósSomos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia especializada em ERP de alta performance para indústrias e distribuidoras.
jobs.description:
Sobre nós

Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia especializada em ERP de alta performance para indústrias e distribuidoras. Tecnologia, inovação e evolução fazem parte da nossa rotina, mas acreditamos que uma marca forte também precisa saber transformar ideias, conceitos e soluções complexas em uma comunicação clara, relevante e visualmente marcante.

Estamos em um momento de fortalecimento da marca Korp e expansão das nossas iniciativas de Marketing B2B, com novos projetos, campanhas, eventos, produtos e ações de comunicação.

Para apoiar esse movimento, buscamos um Designer Gráfico Freelancer para construir uma parceria com a nossa área de Marketing e nos atender em projetos gráficos conforme surgirem novas demandas.

Como funcionará a parceria

Não buscamos uma contratação para uma demanda única, nem uma posição com volume fixo mensal de trabalho.

A ideia é encontrar um profissional que possa se tornar um parceiro freelancer recorrente da Korp, sendo acionado de forma pontual sempre que surgirem projetos que demandem apoio de Design.

Ou seja: as demandas serão esporádicas e sob demanda, de acordo com as necessidades e o calendário do Marketing.

Buscamos alguém em quem possamos confiar diferentes projetos ao longo do tempo, que consiga compreender nossa identidade visual, nosso mercado e nossa forma de comunicação, tornando o desenvolvimento das próximas entregas cada vez mais ágil e alinhado.

Principais tipos de projetos

O profissional poderá atuar principalmente em demandas como:

  • Criação de artes para redes sociais, campanhas digitais, anúncios, eventos, lançamentos e comunicação institucional;
  • Criação e desenvolvimento visual de Landing Pages, sendo necessária experiência com UI e construção de interfaces;
  • Criação de materiais para impressão, como folders, flyers, banners, materiais para eventos, peças comerciais e outros formatos;
  • Desdobramento e adaptação de peças para diferentes dimensões, canais e aplicações;
  • Desenvolvimento de conceitos visuais a partir de briefings preparados pelo Marketing;
  • Apoio na evolução visual de campanhas e projetos da marca sempre que necessário.

O que buscamos

Mais do que alguém que apenas execute um briefing, queremos construir uma parceria com um profissional que tenha repertório visual, criatividade e iniciativa.

É importante conseguir interpretar o objetivo de cada projeto e contribuir com soluções visuais que façam sentido para a comunicação, propondo caminhos e melhorias quando necessário.

Buscamos um profissional com:

  • Experiência prática com Design Gráfico;
  • Experiência na criação de materiais para redes sociais e comunicação digital;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento visual de Landing Pages e conhecimentos de UI;
  • Experiência com preparação de materiais destinados à impressão;
  • Domínio das principais ferramentas utilizadas para criação e desenvolvimento de peças gráficas;
  • Boa organização e capacidade de trabalhar a partir de briefings e prazos previamente alinhados;
  • Criatividade e iniciativa para propor soluções, e não apenas reproduzir referências;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e cuidado com consistência visual;
  • Facilidade para compreender e seguir uma identidade de marca.

Será considerado diferencial

  • Experiência com projetos de comunicação para empresas de tecnologia, software, SaaS, ERP ou negócios B2B;
  • Familiaridade com comunicação voltada ao mercado corporativo;
  • Experiência com criação de conceitos visuais para campanhas e lançamentos;
  • Conhecimentos de UX além da experiência com UI;
  • Capacidade de desenvolver peças para diferentes formatos mantendo consistência entre os materiais.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Evidence Solutions, Inc.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Evidence Solutions, Inc. is a nationally recognized expert witness and litigation support firm providing consulting across a wide range of civil and criminal matters. Our team partners with attorneys, insurance carriers, municipalities, corporations, and government entities to deliver credible and defensible expert analysis. 
We provide our experts with full-service support including marketing/business development, case intake and client support, billing and collections, allowing experts to focus on what they love doing best — working with the evidence.  
Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced Firearms & Ballistics Expert Witness to join our team of forensic and litigation support professionals. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in firearms examination, ballistic analysis, shooting incident reconstruction, and the application of forensic science to firearms-related cases. This role is well suited for a Firearms Examiner, Ballistics Analyst, Forensic Scientist, Law Enforcement Firearms Specialist, or Military Weapons Expert who has investigated and analyzed shooting incidents and understands the standards and methodologies governing firearms evidence. 
This position provides an opportunity to apply firearms and ballistics expertise to legal matters involving shooting incidents, firearm functionality, trajectory analysis, and weapons-related forensic investigations. 

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:
  • Conduct forensic examinations of firearms, ammunition, and ballistic evidence, including bullets, cartridge cases, and gunshot residue. 
  • Analyze shooting incidents, including trajectory analysis, distance determination, and reconstruction of events based on physical evidence. 
  • Evaluate firearm functionality, safety mechanisms, and potential defects or malfunctions. 
  • Review case materials including scene evidence, autopsy reports, police reports, and forensic lab findings to assess firearm-related events. 
  • Review and validate evidence of handling procedures including chain of custody, laboratory analysis, and testing protocols. 
  • Assess use-of-force scenarios involving firearms, including officer-involved shootings, self-defense claims, and accidental discharges. 
  • Consult with legal teams to assess firearms evidence, identify inconsistencies, and support case strategy. 
  • Prepare detailed expert reports and professional opinions based on accepted firearms examination methodologies and forensic science principles. 
  • Provide expert witness testimony in depositions and trials, translating complex concepts and firearms & ballistics findings into clear and defensible opinions
  • Stay current on developments in firearms technology, ballistic analysis techniques, forensic standards, and legal precedents related to firearms cases. 
Qualifications:
  • 15+ years of professional experience in Firearms Examination, Ballistics Analysis, Law Enforcement or Military Firearms Specialist roles, Crime Lab Forensics, or related fields.
  • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Forensic Science, Criminal Justice, Ballistics, or a related field preferred. 
  • Extensive experience in firearms examination, ballistics analysis, or forensic firearms investigations. 
  • Deep understanding of firearms and forensic standards, including toolmark identification, trajectory analysis, gunshot residue testing, and evidence comparison techniques. 
  • Experience working with laboratory testing procedures, firearms databases (e.g., NIBIN), and forensic analysis tools. 
  • Strong knowledge of firearm safety standards and shooting incident reconstruction. 
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing firearms-related evidence and presenting findings in investigative or legal settings. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex forensic concepts to attorneys, juries, and non-technical audiences. 
  • Prior expert witness or courtroom testimony experience is preferred. 
  • Relevant certifications or training in firearms examination, forensic science, or ballistics analysis are strongly preferred.

Benefits

Compensation & Structure:
  • 1099 independent contractor arrangement 
  • WFH 
  • Competitive hourly expert witness compensation 
  • Flexible case-based workload 
Why Partner with ESI
What We Offer:
  • Dedicated case management and administrative support from initial client intake to billing and collections that allows you to focus on doing what you love, delivering expert insights.  
  • Marketing and business development initiatives designed to generate new case opportunities and expand your reach and visibility in the legal industry. 
  • Peer review support and access to a multidisciplinary team of experts.  
  • Report writing support and professional development opportunities such as deposition coaching, testimony training, and continuing education in emerging human factors research.  
  • Flexible engagement structure.  
  • A collaborative environment where your expertise is valued, and your contributions directly influence case outcomes.

jobs.excerpt: A Leega é uma empresa focada no atendimento eficiente e inovador em seus clientes.
jobs.description:
A Leega é uma empresa focada no atendimento eficiente e inovador em seus clientes.

Isso não poderia ser diferente com o nosso principal combustível: as pessoas!

Nossa cultura é inspiradora e nossos valores estão presentes no dia a dia: ética e transparência, excelência de qualidade, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade econômica, social e ambiental, relações humanas e credibilidade.

>> A LEEGA É PARA TODOS, ficaremos muito felizes em ter você em nosso time. Venha fazer parte da nossa história e da construção do nosso futuro.

Cadastre-se agora mesmo em nossas vagas!

Buscamos um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior que, além de construir e operar pipelines, assuma responsabilidade arquitetural sobre a plataforma de dados: modelagem do data warehouse, padrões de ingestão, governança de camadas e decisões de performance e custo. É uma posição de execução técnica pesada — a pessoa escreve código, faz tuning de banco, revisa modelagem de terceiros e responde pela confiabilidade dos dados que alimentam painéis executivos, relatórios a clientes e obrigações regulatórias.

O ambiente é regulado, no mercado financeiro e de investimentos, onde rastreabilidade, reprodutibilidade e correção auditável dos números são requisitos de primeira ordem. A interlocução acontece com áreas como Wealth Management, Comercial, Risco, Compliance e Operações, além da atuação como referência técnica para engenheiros pleno e júnior.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de ingestão e transformação orquestrados em Apache Airflow, com padrões consistentes de retry, idempotência, alerta e SLA.
  • Desenvolver e evoluir modelos de transformação em dbt sobre o data warehouse, organizando as camadas (staging, intermediate e marts) com testes e documentação.
  • Implementar ingestões de fontes heterogêneas, como bancos transacionais, APIs de terceiros (custodiantes, distribuidores, provedores de mercado), arquivos regulatórios e planilhas operacionais.
  • Definir e defender o modelo de dados do warehouse (dimensional, Data Vault ou híbrido, com justificativa), incluindo chaves, granularidade, historização (SCD) e tratamento de correções retroativas.
  • Estabelecer e fiscalizar padrões de distribuição, ordenação e particionamento no MPP (DISTKEY, SORTKEY e compressão em Redshift, ou equivalentes em outras engines).
  • Conduzir tuning de performance e custo, com análise de planos, filas/WLM, concorrência, manutenção (VACUUM/ANALYZE), rewrite de queries e materializações.
  • Instrumentar observabilidade e controles automatizados de qualidade dos dados, cobrindo freshness, volumetria, quebras de contrato e reconciliação entre origem e destino.
  • Desenhar camadas e contratos de dados entre times, definindo fonte da verdade, quem escreve onde e o que é exposto para BI.
  • Garantir linhagem e rastreabilidade ponta a ponta, de um número no painel até a origem e a versão do código que o produziu, aplicando controles de acesso, segregação por sensibilidade e conformidade com LGPD e com as normas do setor.
  • Documentar decisões arquiteturais (ADRs), manter o dicionário de dados vivo e atuar em code review, pareamento e definição de padrões com o time.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 6+ anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, sendo pelo menos 2 anos com responsabilidade arquitetural (ter desenhado o modelo, não apenas implementado o desenho de outra pessoa).
  • Histórico comprovado de ter colocado em produção e operado uma plataforma de dados analítica, com incidentes, plantão e consequências reais.
  • SQL avançado: window functions, CTEs recursivas, leitura de plano de execução, diagnóstico de skew e de spill em disco.
  • Python aplicado a engenharia de dados, com código modular, testável e versionado (não apenas notebooks), incluindo pandas ou polars, tipagem e testes automatizados.
  • Apache Airflow em produção: autoria de DAGs, sensores, backfill, gestão de dependências e de falhas.
  • Data warehouse MPP em nuvem, preferencialmente Redshift (Snowflake, BigQuery ou Databricks são aceitos, com disposição para se aprofundar em Redshift).
  • dbt ou ferramenta equivalente de transformação versionada, com testes.
  • Modelagem dimensional (Kimball) com domínio real: fato e dimensão, granularidade, SCD tipos 1 e 2, tabelas ponte e snapshots.
  • Git e cultura de code review, com CI/CD aplicado a dados.
  • Diagnóstico de performance, sabendo explicar por que uma query está lenta e comprovar a correção com números antes e depois.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência no mercado financeiro: investimentos, wealth management, custódia, renda fixa e variável, fundos, cálculo de rentabilidade (TIR/TWR), posição e movimentação.
  • Vivência com dados regulatórios de CVM, BACEN, BSM e ANBIMA, incluindo prazos e formatos de entrega.
  • Infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e serviços AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda, IAM, Step Functions).
  • Formatos de tabela abertos (Iceberg, Delta), arquitetura lakehouse e streaming/CDC (Kafka, Debezium, Kinesis).
  • Ferramentas de qualidade e catálogo (Great Expectations, Soda, DataHub, OpenMetadata) e experiência com camada semântica e BI (Power BI, Metabase, Looker).
  • Ter conduzido uma migração relevante (legado para moderno, on-premises para nuvem ou planilha/VBA para pipeline versionado) com validação de paridade.

Competências comportamentais

  • Rigor com correção numérica: em ambiente regulado, "quase certo" é errado.
  • Comunicação escrita clara, capaz de registrar a arquitetura em documento que sobreviva à saída do autor.
  • Autonomia para investigar do painel até a origem do dado sem depender de aprovação a cada passo.
  • Postura de referência técnica, com code review, pareamento e mentoria de profissionais pleno e júnior.
  • Capacidade de traduzir demandas de negócio em desenho de dados sustentável, inclusive recusando atalhos que geram dívida técnica.
  • Honestidade na estimativa de escopo, risco e prazo no planejamento técnico.

INDISPENSÁVEL Conhecimento/Atuação em:

  • SQL avançado, com leitura de plano de execução e diagnóstico de performance
  • Apache Airflow em produção
  • Data warehouse MPP em nuvem (preferencialmente Redshift)
  • dbt ou ferramenta equivalente de transformação versionada
  • Modelagem dimensional (Kimball), com SCD e definição de granularidade

We are looking for annotators with computer vision or image labeling experience to perform 2D human pose (keypoint) annotation on thermal images within the client's Label Studio environment. You will identify people in each image and place a defined set of anatomical keypoints per person, including in cases of partial occlusion or ambiguous body positioning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review each assigned thermal image and identify the number of people present.

  • Create a separate annotation for each individual identified in the image.

  • Position each keypoint as close as possible to the true center of the corresponding body part.

  • Infer and place the expected anatomical position for keypoints that are obstructed or occluded.

  • Indicate a confidence flag when keypoint placement is uncertain due to difficult body positioning or orientation.

  • Submit completed annotations directly within the client's Label Studio instance.

  • Participate in QA/rework cycles, revising annotations as needed based on reviewer feedback.

Requirements

Required:

  • Prior experience with computer vision annotation, image labeling, or similar data annotation work.

  • Solid understanding of human anatomy sufficient to accurately place and infer keypoints, even when partially visible.

  • Sharp attention to detail and spatial reasoning, able to distinguish subtle differences in body positioning and orientation.

  • Comfort working with thermal/infrared imagery (lower contrast, less visual clarity than standard RGB images).

  • Ability to follow detailed annotation guidelines precisely and apply them consistently across large volumes of images.

  • Good judgment for ambiguous cases (occlusion, unusual poses, overlapping people) and appropriate flagging of uncertainty rather than guessing silently.

  • Familiarity with Label Studio, or willingness to quickly learn the platform.

  • Reliable, self-directed work habits.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with human pose estimation or keypoint annotation datasets (e.g., COCO keypoints format).

  • Experience working with thermal or infrared imagery.

  • Background in computer vision, robotics, or security/surveillance imaging.

Overview

Opus 2’s position as a leading provider of transcription services in the UK and globally provides a platform to use our knowledge of transcription and harness technology-enhanced methods to ensure the efficient production of high-quality transcripts through traditional transcription and using voice recognition.

With demand continuing to grow for our transcription services, we are seeking an enthusiastic Speech-to-Text Editor to join our Speech-to-Text team.

The successful candidate will work on transcripts of court hearings, public inquiries, arbitrations and tribunals, as well as meetings, interviews and telephone calls.

They will have a meticulous eye for detail, be deadline focused and highly organised. A background in editing and/or proofreading would be highly beneficial. A love of language and learning and a willingness to become immersed in different areas of the law and of legal transcription are essential.

The role is fully remote, giving you the opportunity to be involved in some of the highest profile cases globally from the comfort of your own home.

Job Overview

Working as part of the Speech-to-Text team, you will be responsible for ensuring that transcripts are produced to the requisite standard by following existing quality control guidelines and seeking continuous improvement in your editing skills.

In your first few months, you will be immersing yourself in the world of court reporting and will have the opportunity to attend virtual hearings to familiarise yourself with the flow of a hearing and with the legal jargon used by counsel and judges alike. You will receive comprehensive training and support in transcript production, enabling you to become an expert in the field. You will also receive training in editing via the Opus 2 Speech-to-Text Editing Suite and have the opportunity to contribute to its future development.

What you’ll be doing

Hearing Preparation

  • Virtually attend live court and arbitration hearings to build familiarity with legal terminology and court procedures.
  • Support hearing operations by starting recordings, monitoring audio quality, and liaising with relevant teams to resolve any audio or technical issues.
  • Review client documentation and prepare custom glossaries for new hearings as part of standard hearing preparation.

Editing & Transcript Production

  • Edit live or post-hearing Speech-to-Text output, developing accuracy, speed, and knowledge of legal terminology.
  • Work alongside experienced editors on shorter hearing segments to gain experience producing same-day transcripts. Communicate and collaborate with colleagues using Slack and other internal tools to maintain consistency across transcripts.
  • Continuously improve transcript readability, consistency, and turnaround times.

Training & Development

  • Complete comprehensive training covering both editorial and technical aspects of the role through structured feedback, documentation, and virtual or in person training sessions.
  • Develop the stamina, accuracy, and quick decision-making skills needed to handle increasingly complex and demanding editing work.

Progression & Greater Responsibility

  • Take increasing ownership of hearing preparation, glossary creation, and hearing management for your team.
  • Identify and address inconsistencies across transcript production while coordinating with team members.
  • Progress to working within smaller editorial teams, contributing to all stages of transcript production, including real-time editing, editing transcript feeds, team leadership responsibilities, and finalising transcripts for client distribution.
  • Maintain delivery of high-quality transcripts accurately and efficiently under tight deadlines.

Requirements

What we're looking for in you

Personal Qualities:

  • Self-motivated;
  • Enthusiastic;
  • Flexible;
  • Team working;
  • Ability to maintain focus during prolonged periods of editing

Command of Written & Spoken English:

  • Extremely high standard to meet exacting service standards;
  • The ability to proofread;
  • Proficient in researching;
  • High attention to detail
  • Communication and interact productively with colleagues and clients;

IT and administrative skills:

  • Confident with the use of Microsoft Office; specifically, Word and Outlook;
  • Open to learning new systems using internally developed software;
  • Effective communication, written and oral, of any technical issues to the office;
  • Typing speed of 50wpm min (from audio).

Other:

  • Previous transcription, editing or proofreading experience.
  • A degree is preferred but not required; equivalent practical experience is equally valued.

Benefits

Our achievements are underpinned by our unique culture and our people are our biggest asset. Working at Opus 2, you’ll get:

  • 26 days annual holidays and flexible working.
  • Private Health Insurance.

  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Calm and Mindfulness sessions.
  • A day of leave to volunteer for charity and an active CSR team raising money towards a company charity.
  • Regular company social events.

The Center for Healthy Living, an Axia Women's Health care center, is hiring a full-time Nurse Practitioner - Menopause Care and Wellness.

This specialized Nurse Practitioner provides specialized, evidence-based virtual care for patients with menopause-related concerns, including sexual health, bone health, sleep, and other aspects of midlife women’s health. The role serves both self-referred patients and those referred by Axia OB/GYN providers, providing focused evaluation, treatment, education, and follow-up. This position complements care provided in Axia’s in-person practices by serving as a specialty resource for patients requiring additional expertise or focused management, while maintaining communication with the referring provider and supporting continuity of care with the patient’s established OB/GYN as the primary coordinator of their overall gynecologic and menopause care.

Specialty Menopause Care

  • Provide comprehensive virtual evaluation, diagnosis, treatment, education, and follow-up for patients experiencing menopause-related symptoms and concerns.
  • Serve as a clinical resource for menopause-related conditions and symptom domains, including sexual health and wellness, osteoporosis and bone health, sleep, and other long-term consequences or sequelae of menopause.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans that may include hormone therapy, non-hormonal therapies, lifestyle interventions, patient education, and appropriate referrals.
  • Provide care for both self-referred patients and patients referred by Axia OB/GYN providers.
  • Communicate relevant clinical findings, recommendations, and treatment plans to referring OB/GYN, when applicable, following patient visits.
  • Support continuity and coordination of care with the patient’s established OB/GYN provider and other members of the care team.
  • Maintain current knowledge of evidence-based menopause care and specialty-specific guidelines, including recommendations from the Menopause Society and other relevant professional organizations.

General Menopause Care

  • Provide comprehensive menopause symptom management for patients referred by Axia OB/GYN providers who may benefit from additional virtual menopause expertise or support.
  • Evaluate and manage common menopause-related concerns, including vasomotor symptoms, mood changes, weight and metabolic concerns, cognitive symptoms, and other manifestations of menopause, within the APP’s scope of practice.
  • Collaborate with referring OB/GYN provider when patients present with complex symptoms or require care beyond the scope of the virtual menopause program.
  • Identify and appropriately refer non-menopause-related medical concerns to patient’s OB/GYN, primary care provider, or other appropriate specialist rather than managing conditions outside the scope of the program.
  • Participate in quality review of virtual care outcomes, clinical metrics, and patient experience data.

Program Development & Network Support

  • Serve as an active member of the Menopause Clinician Workgroup, providing clinical expertise, feedback, and thought leadership.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of clinical protocols, workflows, patient education, and provider resources.
  • Develop educational materials and resources related to complex menopause symptom management that can be shared across the Axia network.
  • Support provider education and awareness of available virtual menopause and sexual wellness services.
  • Collaborate with the Menopause Medical Director and broader clinical team to identify opportunities for clinical quality improvement and program development.

Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated clinical expertise in menopause management, including hormone replacement therapy (HRT), non-hormonal treatment options, and management of complex patients.
  • Specialized knowledge and experience in menopause-related concerns, particularly sexual health and wellness, bone health/osteoporosis, sleep, and other midlife women’s health issues.
  • Strong clinical judgement and ability to independently evaluate and manage patients through virtual care.
  • Comfortable delivering care across telehealth modalities and effectively engaging patients in a virtual environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when coordinating care with referring OB/GYNs and other clinicians.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain additional state licensure as required to support Axia’s virtual care model.
  • Commitment to evidence-based, patients-centered care and continuous clinical learning.

Required Education & Experience:

jobs.excerpt: This position has a full salary range of $68,500 - $108,000 per year with eligibility for commission.
jobs.description:
This position has a full salary range of $68,500 - $108,000 per year with eligibility for commission. Starting salary is based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, geographic location and experience. The target hiring range for this role is $68,500 - $85,000.

Candidates for this role must live in a major metropolitan area.

Role Overview:

The Business Development Executive will drive new revenue for Dirty Hands by selling our merchandising services to natural CPG brands. This is a hunting role. You will build your own pipeline, run discovery conversations that uncover what a brand actually needs, and move those opportunities from proposal to close.

Above all, this is an outbound role. That means creating a steady flow of your own opportunities through cold outreach, networking, store-checks, and events. The brands you close will be the ones you went out and found.

The services you sell help natural CPG brands win on the shelf. Dirty Hands is a known and respected name in the space, backed by real relationships at the store level, so you are reaching out with credibility behind you rather than starting cold every time. Success is measured on one thing, revenue closed. A healthy pipeline is how you get there, but what counts is what gets signed. This role is a strong fit if you have a track record of creating your own opportunities and carrying them through to the close.

This is a remote role. Regular team and company meetings keep everyone aligned, but you will need to be self-motivated about staying connected the rest of the time. It suits someone who has sold this way before and knows how to stay productive without an office around them.

What You’ll Own:

Prospecting & Pipeline Generation

  • Build and sustain a self-sourced pipeline through cold outreach, email, networking, store-checks, and industry events, without waiting for leads to be handed over.
  • Conduct market research to find emerging brands and untapped opportunities that fit Dirty Hands.
  • Represent Dirty Hands at trade shows and networking events, building relationships that convert into qualified opportunities.
  • Use store-level data and shelf photos captured by our field teams, along with SPINS data, to surface opportunities and show prospective brands what is happening with their products at retail.

Discovery & Selling

  • Lead discovery conversations that uncover a brand's goals, gaps, and buying criteria before proposing a solution.
  • Translate what you learn in discovery into tailored pitches and case studies that show the value of Dirty Hands' merchandising services.
  • Deliver sales presentations, pulling in data, case studies, and internal experts when they strengthen the pitch.

Follow-up, Proposals & Closing

  • Own the full deal cycle from first meeting through proposal, negotiation, and signed contract.
  • Develop and present proposals that clearly connect Dirty Hands' services to the outcomes a brand is trying to reach.
  • Drive consistent follow-up so opportunities keep moving and do not stall between stages.
  • Negotiate and close agreements that work for both the brand and Dirty Hands.

Expansion & Internal Partnership

  • Grow existing accounts by spotting new opportunities and turning strong relationships into new revenue.
  • Coordinate with strategy and merchandising leadership, pulling them in to shape offers and keeping them informed as deals develop.
  • Contribute to lead generation campaigns and pass what you are seeing in the market back to the team.

Pipeline Management & Reporting

  • Keep opportunities accurate and current in our CRM so the pipeline and forecast reflect reality.
  • Report on sales activity and progress against targets on a regular cadence.
  • Stay current on industry trends, retailer programs, competitor offerings, and Dirty Hands' internal programs to refine how you sell.

What We’re Looking For:

Three areas matter most for this role: prospecting and creating your own opportunities, running discovery and selling, and moving deals through follow-up, proposals, and close. Strength across all three is what we look for first, so be ready to show real, specific experience in each.

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a business development or sales role. Experience within the natural CPG industry at a brand, broker, or merchandiser is a plus.
  • A track record of prospecting and creating your own opportunities, not just working inbound or assigned leads.
  • Demonstrated success in discovery and selling, turning what you learn about a brand into a pitch that lands.
  • A proven record of carrying deals through follow-up, proposals, and to a signed close, consistently against a target.
  • Experience selling services or solutions, not only products, into CPG brands is strongly preferred.
  • Prior experience selling in a remote, self-directed role is strongly preferred. This is not a first remote job; you should already know how to run your own pipeline and stay disciplined without in-person structure.
  • An existing network of brand or retailer relationships in natural CPG is a strong plus.

Core Strengths

  • Self-motivated and resilient, able to keep building your own pipeline through the grind and the rejection that outbound selling involves.
  • A genuine listener who uncovers what a brand actually needs before pitching a solution.
  • Persistent through follow-up and negotiation, keeping deals moving without letting relationships go cold.
  • Clear and persuasive with the people who own the decision, from a founder or CEO to a VP of sales, and able to make the financial case when a CFO is in the room.
  • Disciplined about where you spend your time, and organized enough to run several opportunities at once without dropping any.

Technical Skills

  • Comfortable working in a CRM to manage your pipeline, track activity, and report on progress. We use HubSpot; experience with it is a plus.
  • Able to work with syndicated and store-level data, including SPINS, and turn it into a clear, persuasive case for a brand.
  • Confident building polished pitches and proposals that hold up in front of brand decision-makers.
  • Proficient in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.

Travel & Physical Requirements

  • Willingness to travel up to 12 weeks per year to attend trade shows, client meetings, time in the field with our merchandising teams, and other in-person events.
  • Able to work in a seated position for extended periods of time.

Benefits:

  • Competitive pay with eligibility for yearly merit-based wage increases.
  • Eligibility for quarterly bonus based on performance (up to 10%).
  • Comprehensive benefits package including partially company-paid medical insurance, and fully company-paid dental, vision, life and disability insurance.
  • FREE First Stop Health: virtual care and mental health coverage.
  • Three weeks of paid time off per year. In addition to paid time off, 9 paid holidays and one additional floating holiday.
  • Mileage reimbursement plan.
  • 401k plan.
  • Use of company-owned devices to complete assigned tasks.
  • An exceptional company culture with opportunities for engagement and growth.

About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

About the role

The Commercial Auto Excess Casualty Adjuster (with the attorney background) plays a critical role in managing high-severity commercial auto liability claims that may exceed primary policy limits. At Reserv, this specialist leverages cutting-edge automation, structured data, and modern claims systems to drive optimal outcomes while focusing on the most complex, high-impact aspects of claim handling. The role requires deep technical expertise, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate within a fast-moving, technology-driven environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • You will investigate, evaluate, and resolve complex commercial auto liability claims involving excess layers of coverage, catastrophic injuries, multi-vehicle accidents, and high-exposure scenarios.
  • This role will conduct advanced coverage analysis, including policy interpretation, endorsements, exclusions, and multi-jurisdictional considerations.
  • Issue coverage position letters, including reservations of rights and denials, in alignment with regulatory and internal standards.
  • Oversee litigation, partnering with defense counsel to evaluate strategy, monitor case progression, and ensure cost-effective, data-driven decision-making.
  • This adjuster will leverage Reserv's AI-powered tools to review claim summaries, severity predictions, and structured data insights to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
  • Evaluate primary carrier handling and determine when excess involvement is triggered, ensuring timely and appropriate intervention.
  • Collaborate with MGAs, carriers, brokers, and internal teams, providing clear communication and maintaining Reserv's high-touch, white-glove service standards.
  • Document all claim activity within Reserv's modern claims platform, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with internal and external requirements.
  • You will participate in audits, trend analysis, and feedback loops to support continuous improvement and inform underwriting insights.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of commercial auto liability or casualty claims experience, preferably with excess or high-severity files.
  • J.D. from an accredited law school and an active license in good standing in at least one U.S. state is needed
  • Strong knowledge of coverage analysis, litigation management, and complex liability evaluation.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex issues into clear, actionable insights.
  • Comfort working in a technology-driven environment with modern systems and data-rich workflows.
  • Active insurance adjuster's license by way of a designated home state; home state license required if home state license is available
  • Willing to obtain all licenses within 60 days, including completing state required testing

PREFERRED SKILLS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • AIC, CPCU, SCLA, or similar designations.
  • Experience with MGAs, TPAs, or non-admitted/excess & surplus lines.
  • Familiarity with AI-enhanced claims tools or modern claims platforms (a strong plus at Reserv).

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

jobs.description:
Role Summary

MarketMan builds restaurant management software for SMB and mid-market restaurant operators. Our sales team sells it directly to the people who run those businesses, and we win by understanding the operational and financial pain behind each one.

We're hiring a full-cycle Account Executive whose primary motion is outbound. You'll own every revenue opportunity across inbound, outbound, and partner channels, but the job is built on pipeline you create yourself: you self-source the majority of it. Inbound is a supplement, not the job.

The bar is a minimum of 100 outbound activities per day across calls, emails, social touches, and sequences. We publish that number because it's the prospecting discipline that fills your pipeline and feeds your quota, and we inspect outbound production every week. You carry two measured expectations: a new-business quota and a self-sourced pipeline target.

Please note: you must reside in one of the following states to qualify for this role - AZ, CT, FL, GA, ID, IN, KS, MI, MO, NC, NH, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA

Read This Before You Apply

This is a high-volume outbound seat. If you need warm inbound leads handed to you, or a defined book of business to work, you'll be miserable here, and it's better for both of us that you know that before applying. If you've built pipeline from cold, hit quota doing it, and can show the numbers, keep reading.

What You Will Own

  • The majority of your own pipeline, generated through 100+ daily outbound activities across calls, email, and LinkedIn.
  • A new-business quota with a 100% attainment expectation. You'll close restaurant operators in the 1–3 location range and progress at least 3 opportunities per day.
  • The full sales cycle: value-based discovery that surfaces operational and financial pain, tailored demos (an average of 2 per day, inbound plus outbound combined), objection handling, and negotiation through to signature.
  • A clean Salesforce pipeline. Next steps and close dates updated in real time, every deal on a scheduled next step within 72 hours, forecast accuracy within 10%.
  • Pipeline coverage of 3.0–3.5x entering each month, and a clear view of where the gaps are.
  • Working relationships with Marketing, Partner Managers, and the SDR/BDR team that move deals forward, while your number never depends on them.

What You Will Bring

Must-haves:

  • Proven outbound production, with numbers: activity volume, self-sourced pipeline created, and quota attainment you can walk us through.
  • Full-cycle closing skills, from first discovery call through negotiation and signature.
  • Salesforce (or similar CRM) fluency and the hygiene habits to keep it accurate in real time.
  • A track record in an outbound-heavy sales model.
  • High accountability. You own your metrics, your recaps, and your results without being chased.

Nice-to-haves:

  • SaaS sales experience in SMB or hospitality tech.
  • Familiarity with restaurant technology such as POS, accounting, or restaurant management software.
  • Time in a hybrid outbound/inbound or BDR-to-AE model.

How We Operate

You'll sell out of Salesforce, follow MarketMan's standardized sales process, and uphold our discounting rules. Each day ends with a short recap covering wins, losses, pipeline movement, and next steps, and you'll bring pipeline insights to team syncs. Success looks like consistent monthly quota attainment, pipeline created from both channels, and win rates that improve because your discovery does.

Compensation

Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission tied to quota.

jobs.description:
Enterprise is a national nonprofit that exists to make a good home possible for the millions of families without one. We support community development organizations on the ground, aggregate and invest capital for impact, advance housing policy at every level of government, and build and manage communities ourselves. Since 1982, we have invested $92.0 billion and created 1.1 million homes across all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands – all to make home and community places of pride, power and belonging.

Join us at enterprisecommunity.org

Working at Enterprise

At Enterprise, you’ll be part of a diverse, committed team making a difference every day. You will collaborate with some of the smartest minds and biggest hearts in our field. You’ll be empowered to drive systems change and take bold steps to advance racial equity. And you will find a career home where you’re valued and supported in your growth journey.

Enterprise offers career opportunities in our offices across the country with an exceptional benefits package.

Job Description Summary

Enterprise Housing Credit Investments is seeking an experienced individual with Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) structuring and underwriting experience to serve as a Senior Manager in our LIHTC Structuring Services group. In this role, you will play a central part in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of how Enterprise structures its Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) investments.

We are looking for someone with deep LIHTC expertise, exceptional analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate across multiple departments and external partners. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy solving complex financial and structuring challenges, we’d love to meet you.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Review and refine financial models to ensure alignment with Enterprise modeling standards, including investor capital account and minimum gain analysis, evaluating entity structures, and confirming development cost classification.
  • Support underwriters and analysts by developing specialized model schedules, including those related to effective interest, OID, and other tax structuring conventions.
  • Partner with FIRM and Investor Relations to provide accurate, investor-ready financial information and return analyses.
  • Ensure consistency between project-level financial data and investor-facing financial models.
  • Assist with initial equity funding at transaction closings.
  • Review post-closing documentation—including Form 8609s, cost certifications, lease-up schedules, and tax returns—to update financial models.
  • Participate in tax credit adjuster calculations and provide final review as needed.
  • Implement model updates reflecting tax credit adjusters and structural changes.
  • Contribute to the training and onboarding of new analysts and underwriters.
  • Work cross-functionally on special projects requiring tax and structuring expertise.
  • Coordinate with external counsel on transaction closing schedules and structuring considerations.
  • Support Asset Management group in evaluating the impact of post-closing structural or financial changes.
  • Serve as a key feedback resource for both initial deal structuring and post-closing modifications.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting (with a preference for Tax Accounting), Finance, or related field; a Master’s degree is a preference.
  • 10+ years of experience with LIHTC and knowledge of other federal tax credit programs (historic, solar, new markets); familiarity with state credit programs is a plus.
  • Extensive understanding of tax structuring issues in LIHTC transactions.
  • 10+ years of advanced Excel modeling experience, including modeling for tax-incentivized real estate deals.
  • Knowledge of real estate ownership structures and entity classifications.
  • General understanding of accounting treatment for construction costs.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable working across multiple departments.
  • High attention to detail, ability to work independently, and confidence navigating fast-paced, deadline-driven workflows.
  • Willingness to participate as a presenter in team or company training sessions.

Salary Transparency

You will be joining a team of talented professionals motivated by serving the community and addressing the need for affordable housing.

Enterprise offers a comprehensive total rewards package for you and your family. The pay range for this position is $105,000 - $120,000. The salary range represents the low and high end of what may be paid for this position. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range, and compensation decisions may be influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Total Rewards at Enterprise

This range is just one component of our total rewards package, which also includes annual performance bonuses and generous paid leave programs.

Our benefits form a major part of the total rewards package. These include dental, health, and vision care plans, as well as family-building benefits such as adoption and surrogacy support. Enterprise supports flexible work arrangements to promote work-life balance and offers health advocacy, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and mental health benefits. We round out our package with financial education, wellness programs, and auto-enrollment in the company’s 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions.

Finally, you will have access to learning and development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement for job-related courses and certifications. Thank you for your interest in joining the Enterprise team and contributing to our mission to serve others.

What You Will Do:

The Loan Review Advisor will support the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) Office of Credit Risk Management (OCRM) by performing detailed reviews of 7(a) and 504 loan files as part of SBA’s lender oversight and risk management activities. The role involves reviewing loan files across origination, servicing, liquidation, and targeted partial review scopes to assess compliance with SBA Loan Program Requirements as defined in 13 CFR Part 120 and applicable SBA Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). The reviewer will analyze loan documentation, identify compliance issues or deficiencies, and document findings in structured work papers and loan file review reports.

The Loan Review Senior Consultant will inventory and analyze loan files, extract and evaluate data from SBA data systems and lender-provided documentation, and identify correctable and uncorrectable exceptions. The role includes working directly with SBA Lenders, under SBA direction, to clarify documentation, resolve preliminary deficiencies when possible, and ensure lenders understand identified risks and requirements. Reviewers will prepare clear, well-supported written summaries and draft and final loan file review reports that outline condition, criteria, cause, effect, and corrective action for identified issues.

The Opportunity

Alliance Solutions Group is a leading Sage Intacct partner for the construction industry and a fast-growing, PE-backed professional services organization. As Alliance continues to scale, we are investing in the leadership, infrastructure, and insights needed to support our next stage of growth.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Finance to serve as a strategic business partner to our leadership team and help shape how we plan, measure, and make decisions across the business. This role sits at the intersection of financial planning, business intelligence, and business strategy—translating financial and operational data into clear insights that help leaders understand performance, evaluate opportunities, and make informed decisions.

The right leader will bring an Alliance-first mindset and a strong understanding of how Finance can enable the broader business. They will partner closely with leaders across the organization, bring a thoughtful financial perspective to strategic conversations, and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance and create value. Success in this role requires someone who can move comfortably between the details and the bigger picture—building strong financial discipline while helping Alliance scale with confidence.

This is a fully remote role with quarterly travel for Leadership offsites and report directly to the CEO and sit on the Executive Leadership team.

Read more about the Alliance Team in our People Behind the Build Blog Series.

What You’ll Own

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the leadership team, bringing a financial and business perspective to company planning, investment decisions, organizational priorities, and growth initiatives.
  • Act as the financial business partner to department leaders, developing a deep understanding of their operations, challenges, and opportunities. Translate financial and operational data into actionable insights that help leaders make stronger, faster decisions.
  • Work closely with the Head of People & Organizational Effectiveness on workforce and organizational planning, including headcount strategy, organizational design, role changes, and resource allocation. Together, connect the financial and people implications of organizational decisions to ensure investments support both business performance and long-term scalability.
  • Bring financial rigor to strategic initiatives and new opportunities. Build business cases, model scenarios, assess ROI and risk, and clearly articulate tradeoffs so leadership can make informed decisions about where and how Alliance invests for growth.

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Own the company’s financial planning and forecasting framework, including the annual budget, quarterly forecasts, long-range planning, and monthly performance reporting. Ensure leadership has a clear and forward-looking view of financial performance, risks, and opportunities.
  • Build financial models and business cases that inform strategic decisions, including investments, new offerings, organizational changes, headcount planning, and other growth initiatives. Translate complex scenarios into clear financial implications and actionable recommendations.
  • Own performance against key financial and commercial targets, including EBITDA, partner incentives, recurring revenue, and other strategic metrics. Identify emerging risks and opportunities early and proactively bring recommendations to leadership.
  • Connect financial planning to the broader strategic plan, ensuring budgets and forecasts reflect the company’s priorities, growth expectations, resource needs, and evolving business model.
  • Partner with the CEO on board and investor reporting, developing clear financial narratives and materials that communicate performance, outlook, key drivers, and strategic priorities..

Controller & Order Processing Oversight

  • Lead, develop and partner with the Controller and broader Finance team, establishing strong operating rhythms, controls, reporting standards, and accountability across the function. Ensure accurate, timely financial reporting and continuously improve the efficiency and scalability of Finance operations.
  • Oversee the financial components of the order-to-revenue lifecycle, ensuring accurate deal booking, billing readiness, provisioning coordination, and strong handoffs across Sales, Finance, and Delivery as the company’s offerings and deal structures become more complex.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Finance systems, processes, and automation, identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, strengthen data integrity, reduce manual effort, and build infrastructure that can scale with the business.

Revenue & Business Intelligence

  • Own revenue and commercial analytics at the strategic level, providing leadership with clear visibility into pipeline health, bookings, revenue performance, renewals, retention, and churn. Go beyond reporting what happened to identifying why it happened and what we should do next.
  • Lead deeper analysis of the drivers behind company performance, including customer and product segmentation, retention and churn trends, expansion opportunities, service-line economics, and other areas that can unlock profitable growth.
  • Support pricing, packaging, and investment decisions by developing financial models that evaluate economics, scalability, ROI, and potential business impact.
  • Partner closely with Sales leadership on forecasting and pipeline analytics, strengthening the connection between commercial activity and financial outcomes and improving the predictability of future performance.

What You Bring

Qualifications

  • 7–12+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, strategic finance, or finance leadership, ideally within a PE-backed, high-growth, or professional services environment but required.
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities, with the ability to independently build and evaluate multi-year forecasts, investment and ROI models, pricing scenarios, and complex business cases.
  • Strategic and commercial mindset that extends beyond Finance. You understand how the pieces of a business connect and can translate financial performance, operational dynamics, and market opportunities into thoughtful recommendations for growth.
  • Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to distill complex financial information into clear, compelling insights and recommendations for senior leadership, investors, and board-level audiences.
  • Proven leadership capability, with experience developing high-performing teams, setting clear expectations, and creating accountability while empowering others to own their work. You lead with sound judgment, humility, and self-awareness.
  • Strong ownership and a bias toward action. You are energized by building and evolving functions, proactively identifying opportunities, and creating structure where needed. You are comfortable operating in a growing organization where priorities evolve and leaders are expected to help shape the path forward.

Nice-to-Haves
