jobs.excerpt: Shape the future of defense with MANTECH!  Join a team dedicated to safeguarding our nation through advanced tech and innovative solutions.
jobs.description:
Shape the future of defense with MANTECH! Join a team dedicated to safeguarding our nation through advanced tech and innovative solutions. Since 1968, we’ve been a trusted partner to the Department of Defense, delivering cutting-edge projects that make a real impact. Dive into exciting opportunities in Cybersecurity, IT, Data Analytics and more. Propel your career forward and be part of something extraordinary. Your journey starts now—protect and innovate with MANTECH!

Job Description

MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Logistics Diminishing Supplies Specialist to join our team in Lakehurst, NJ. This position is a remoteposition.

The Logistics Specialist will leverage their strong technical background and knowledge to support the Aircraft Launch and Recovery Equipment (ALRE) Department, providing general Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) and supply chain expertise for the Electromagnetic Aircraft Launch System (EMALS) and Advanced Arresting Gear (AAG) programs. This role supports ship configuration management, lifecycle logistics, and provisioning analysis to ensure fleet readiness.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Reviewing DoD ILS data, provisioning details, and spare parts availability while conducting diminishing manufacturing sources and material shortages (DMSMS) tracking

  • Maintaining comprehensive spreadsheets and tracking databases containing critical vendor data, lead times, end-of-life cycles, and required quantities for lifetime buys

  • Reviewing Bills of Materials (BOM) and participating in critical stakeholder meetings to research, analyze, and manage entries into the ships' Allowance Parts Listings (APL)

  • Supporting APMLs and DAPMLs by execution of assigned lifecycle logistics tasks, process tracking, and budget preparation activities

  • Attending all assigned EMALS, AAG, and ALRE meetings as a logistics subject matter expert to communicate requirements across the military and government chain of command

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with 3+ years of experience in DoD systems lifecycle logistics support; an additional five 5+ years of relevant DOD logistics support for entire life cycle related to DOD systems experience may be substituted in lieu of degree

  • Experience reviewing Bills of Materials (BOM) and Allowance Parts Listings (APL) to identify parts for diminishing supplies analysis and engineering change proposals (ECP)

  • Experience with DoD ILS, provisioning, supply chain management, and configuration management processes and databases

  • Experience working across teams to communicate lifecycle data and track logistics requirements for complex systems

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Aircraft Launch and Recovery Equipment (ALRE) programs or Navy logistics automation tools

  • Experience attending Systems Engineering Technical Review (SETR) events and evaluating ECPs for spare parts candidates

  • Self-starter with excellent people skills able to source alternate vendors and maintain data tracking logs for critical lifetime buys

Clearance Requirements:

  • Must be a US Citizen and possess a current or active Secret Security Clearance

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%.

  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office and physically navigate aircraft carriers, flight decks, compartments, and stairwells.

  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations and verbal or email correspondences.

  • Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.


The projected compensation range for this position is $58,000.00-$95,900.00. There are differentiating factors that can impact a final salary/hourly rate, including, but not limited to, Contract Wage Determination, relevant work experience, skills and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location (For Remote Opportunities), education and certifications as well as Federal Government Contract Labor categories. In addition, MANTECH invests in its employees beyond just compensation. MANTECH’s benefits offerings include, dependent upon position, Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, short-term and long-term Disability, Retirement and Savings, Learning and Development opportunities, wellness programs as well as other optional benefit elections.

MANTECH considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to disability or veteran status or any other status protected under any federal, state, or local law or regulation.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position with MANTECH, please email us at and provide your name and contact information.

The Senior Manager, Corporate IT serves as the senior technical leader for the Corporate IT organization, reporting directly to the Director of IT. This role is responsible for driving the technical execution, operational excellence, and continuous modernization of Corporate IT services across Infrastructure, End User Computing, Identity & Access Management, Enterprise Applications, and Service Management.

This is a highly hands-on leadership role focused on technology rather than day-to-day personnel management. The Senior Manager partners with the Service Desk, Systems, Enterprise Applications, and IAM team to provide technical direction, establish engineering standards, remove technical roadblocks, and ensure reliable delivery of enterprise technology services.

The successful candidate is expected to lead complex technical initiatives, architect enterprise solutions, drive automation, improve operational maturity, and serve as the highest technical escalation point within Corporate IT. This individual will help shape the organization's technology roadmap while enabling the Director of IT to focus on strategic planning, financial management, governance, mergers and acquisitions, and executive engagement.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES & KEY PERFORMANCE OUTCOMES

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the senior technical authority across Corporate IT.

  • Provide architectural guidance for Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, endpoint management, networking, identity, enterprise applications, and cloud services.

  • Review and approve technical designs, infrastructure changes, and operational standards.

  • Mentor technical leads and senior engineers while fostering engineering excellence across the organization.

  • Act as the primary technical advisor to the Director of IT.

Infrastructure & Cloud Operations

  • Lead the modernization of Microsoft 365 and Azure environments.

  • Oversee endpoint management, device lifecycle, and enterprise mobility solutions.

  • Ensure high availability, resiliency, scalability, and security of Corporate IT infrastructure.

Identity & Security

  • Support implementation of Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and identity automation.

Enterprise Applications

  • Provide technical leadership for enterprise integrations, APIs, authentication, and platform architecture.

Operational Excellence

  • Drive operational maturity across Corporate IT.

  • Establish technical standards, documentation, and governance processes.

  • Lead major incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews.

  • Identify opportunities to improve service quality, reliability, and operational efficiency.

Automation & AI

  • Lead enterprise automation initiatives utilizing PowerShell, Power Platform, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, and AI technologies.

  • Reduce manual processes through automation and workflow optimization.

  • Champion the adoption of AI-enabled IT operations and productivity tools.

Project & Program Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional technology initiatives from planning through implementation.

  • Coordinate technical delivery across Service Desk, Systems, IAM, and Enterprise Applications.

  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies.

  • Support technology integration activities related to acquisitions and organizational growth.

Vendor & Technology Management

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve business outcomes.

Key Impact Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Reduction in recurring incidents through root cause elimination.

  • Increased automation of operational and administrative processes.

  • Successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives on schedule and within scope.

  • Adoption of enterprise technology standards and best practices.

  • Reduced technical debt through modernization efforts.

  • Improved operational efficiency across Corporate IT.

  • Strong collaboration across Service Desk, Systems, Enterprise Applications, and IAM.

  • High customer satisfaction and service reliability.

  • Development of technical capabilities within Corporate IT teams.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS platforms, including Workday, Salesforce, NetSuite, Jira Service Management, and Atlassian products.

Do you want to be part of a TEAM who delivers Eco-Friendly Environments that Transform Lives? Then you are in the right place…start the application process today!

Summary of Position Functions

The Manager of Area Sales is responsible for leading the sales strategy, revenue growth, market development, and sales performance across an assigned multi-state territory. This position has the overall responsibility for achieving annual sales objectives, developing and executing territory growth strategies, maintaining a strong and predictable sales pipeline, and ensuring sales activities support the Company’s revenue and profitability goals.

The Manager of Area Sales leads, coaches, and develops a team of sales professionals while maintaining direct involvement in strategic accounts, major pursuits, and key customer relationships. The position works collaboratively with operational, engineering, estimating, finance, marketing, and executive leadership to identify market opportunities, develop competitive solutions, improve win rates, and ensure successful transition of awarded opportunities from sales to execution.

Essential Position Functions

Enterprise Sales and Commercial Growth Strategy

  • Owns sales strategy, revenue performance, and market growth for the assigned muti-state territory.
  • Develops and executes annual and multi-year territory sales plans aligned with Company growth, revenue, profitability, and strategic objectives.
  • Establishes annual sales targets and translates territory objectives into measurable individual and team goals.
  • Identifies market trends, competitive threats, customer needs, and emerging opportunities and adjusts sales strategies accordingly.
  • Develops strategies to increase market penetration, expand existing customer relationships, enter new markets, and generate recurring business.
  • Evaluates territory performance against established objectives and implements corrective action when revenue, pipeline, margin, or other performance expectations are at risk.
  • Partners with executive leadership in developing territory growth priorities, resource requirements, and strategic initiatives.

Pipeline Management, Forecasting, and Sales Performance

  • Maintains a healthy, diversified, and appropriately weighted sales pipeline sufficient to support current and future revenue objectives.
  • Establishes and monitors sales KPIs, including pipeline development, opportunity progression, win rates, sales cycle, forecast accuracy, bookings, and other applicable performance measures.
  • Provides timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual sales forecasts to executive leadership.
  • Conducts regular pipeline and opportunity reviews to assess probability, timing, competitive position, next steps, and barriers to closing.
  • Ensures sales opportunities, customer activities, forecasts, and relevant account information are accurately and consistently maintained within the Company's CRM system.
  • Uses sales and market data to identify performance trends and develops action plans to address gaps.
  • Drives accountability for consistent execution of the Company's sales processes and standards.

Sales Team Leadership and Development

  • Leads, coaches, mentors, and develops sales professionals throughout the assigned territory.
  • Establishes clear individual and team performance expectations aligned with territory objectives.
  • Conducts regular one-on-one meetings, pipeline reviews, sales coaching sessions, and performance evaluations.
  • Coaches team members on prospecting, account development, opportunity qualification, customer engagement, presentations, negotiations, and closing strategies.
  • Identifies individual development needs and establishes appropriate coaching and professional-development plans.
  • Recognizes high performance and addresses performance deficiencies in a timely and consistent manner.
  • Participates in workforce planning, recruiting, interviewing, selection, onboarding, and retention of sales talent.
  • Promotes collaboration, accountability, ethical sales practices, and a high-performance sales culture across the territory.

Strategic Accounts and Business Development

  • Personally develops and maintains relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, and senior-level decision-makers.
  • Identifies and pursues major commercial, industrial, institutional, municipal, utility, and other strategic opportunities appropriate to the Company's business.
  • Develops relationships with facility owners, executives, utilities, contractors, engineering firms, consultants, channel partners, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Develops strategic account plans designed to strengthen customer relationships, increase customer retention, and identify additional revenue opportunities.
  • Supports sales professionals on complex or high-value pursuits, including customer strategy, executive engagement, presentations, negotiations, and closing activities.
  • Represents the Company at customer meetings, industry associations, conferences, trade shows, networking events, and other business-development activities as appropriate.
  • Monitors competitive activity and develops strategies to strengthen the Company's market position.

Opportunity Strategy and Commercial Management

  • Provides leadership and oversight for major sales opportunities from initial qualification through contract award and transition to operations.
  • Evaluates opportunities based on strategic fit, customer need, competitive position, probability of success, revenue potential, profitability, resource requirements, and risk.
  • Partners with estimating, engineering, operations, finance, legal, and other internal stakeholders to develop competitive and financially responsible customer solutions.
  • Participates in pricing, proposal, and pursuit strategy for significant opportunities.
  • Supports contract negotiations and works with appropriate internal resources to address commercial terms, customer requirements, and business risks.
  • Maintains appropriate focus on both revenue growth and the quality and profitability of sales.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serves as a key liaison between the sales organization and operations, engineering, estimating, finance, marketing, and executive leadership.
  • Ensures effective communication and coordination throughout the sales process.
  • Facilitates effective handoff of awarded opportunities from sales to project execution teams.
  • Communicates customer expectations, commitments, scope considerations, and other relevant information to internal stakeholders.
  • Works collaboratively to resolve issues that could affect customer relationships, opportunity progression, or future business.
  • Provides market and customer feedback to leadership to support strategic planning, service development, and organizational decision-making.

Customer and Market Leadership

  • Develops a strong understanding of the assigned territory, including customer segments, competitors, market conditions, regulatory considerations, and industry trends.
  • Maintains awareness of factors affecting customer capital planning, energy and infrastructure investments, procurement strategies, and purchasing decisions.
  • Serves as an executive-level representative of the Company with key customers and strategic partners.
  • Builds long-term customer relationships based on credibility, responsiveness, and an understanding of customer business objectives.
  • Supports customer retention and expansion strategies and assists in resolving significant customer concerns when appropriate.
  • Note: The statements contained herein describe the essential functions of this position but should not be an all-inclusive listing of work requirements. Individuals may perform other duties as assigned including work in other areas to cover absences or relief to equalize peak work periods or otherwise balance the workload.

Non-Essential Position Functions

  • Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Directly supervises employees in the Sales department and may provide leadership and direction to other employees involved in sales pursuits and business-development activities. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with Veregy’s policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints, and resolving problems.

Education and Qualifications

To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Construction Management, Energy Management, or a related field preferred; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of seven (7) years of progressively responsible sales, business development, account management, or related commercial experience, preferably within energy services, energy efficiency, construction, engineering, building systems, infrastructure, or related industry.

  • Proven track record of achieving significant sales or revenue targets and developing a sustainable pipeline of qualified opportunities.
  • Experience managing complex, consultative, and/or solution-based sales involving multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining relationships with executive-level customers and key decision-makers.
  • Experience with strategic account planning, territory management, pipeline management, sales forecasting, and opportunity qualification.
  • Experience leading major sales pursuits, including customer discovery, solution development, proposal strategy, presentations, negotiations, and closing activities.
  • Experience working collaboratively with operational, technical, estimating, finance, legal, and executive teams to develop and close complex opportunities.
  • Experience using CRM systems to manage opportunities, sales activity, pipeline, forecasting, and performance metrics.
  • Experience within commercial, industrial, K-12, higher education, healthcare, state and local government, municipal, utility, or other institutional markets preferred.
  • Experience with energy performance contracting, design-build, energy efficiency, renewable energy, distributed energy, facility modernization, or related solutions is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Computer software proficiency including Microsoft Project, Viewpoint, RS Means, Trimble Estimating and / or other job-related hardware and software applications that may be required.
  • Ability to work independently and efficiently manage time / workload.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret financial reports, business, professional, and technical documents.
  • Ability to effectively respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers and staff.
  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
  • Ability to write presentations, articles, routine reports, proposals, and correspondence.
  • Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts and percentages.

At Oxygen Conservation, geospatial data isn’t background infrastructure – it shapes everything we do, one acquisition, one Biodiversity Net Gain project and one data collection app at a time. As we scale, we’re creating a new Geospatial Analyst role to power the mapping and data work behind our Natural Capital projects, our acquisitions pipeline, and our own internal software products. You’ll learn directly from Lara Salam, our GIS and Data Visualisation Lead, who’s built our entire GIS function from scratch, and grow your career at the pace we’re growing ours.

About You

We're looking for someone who’s eager to learn, grow, and take their technical skills and career to the next level – with a strong analytical mindset, a genuine curiosity about data, and an appetite for using AI to work smarter. Ideally, you’ll bring the following:

Environment

  • Passionate Explorer: Fuelled by a genuine passion for environmental conservation and making a tangible impact on the landscapes we protect.

  • Spatial Data Practitioner: Hands-on experience analysing, visualising, and managing spatial datasets, ideally within the ArcGIS Platform.

Impact

  • Data-Driven: Sharp attention to detail and a high standard for data quality in everything you touch.

  • Clear Communicator: Able to turn complex data into clear insights and visualisations, whether it’s a beautiful map, an informative dashboard, or a well-structured dataset.

Adventure

  • AI-Enabled Experimenter: Genuinely interested in using AI tools (think Claude Code) to write Python, automate workflows, and speed up your own work. No computer science background required, just curiosity and a willingness to have a go.

  • Practical Problem Solver: When the obvious approach doesn’t work, you try another, and another. You think outside the box rather than getting stuck.

Together

  • Commitment to Growth: A passion for lifelong learning and continuous personal development, growing alongside a team that invests in you.

  • Kindness and Approachability: And of course, you have to be really kind! Sharing snacks on long journeys or a packed lunch whilst out in the rain is mandatory!

We’re imagining this role for someone early in their GIS career, whether you’re finishing education, changing direction, or taking another route into the field. With direct coaching from Lara, we’ll support your growth and development. We believe in recruiting exceptional people and building a genuinely diverse team from across the country, with a broad range of lived and learned experiences. So, if you have some or all of the skills above, are full of enthusiasm, passionate about learning, and ready to work hard to Scale Conservation, apply now!

About the Role

As our Geospatial Analyst, you’ll be the engine room behind our Natural Capital projects and our growing suite of internal GIS tools. As Lara leads our geospatial strategy and internal software products, you’ll deliver hands-on GIS work that keeps our projects moving forward, with her coaching and mentoring you every step of the way. Once in the role, you’ll be joining a small, high-performing team that genuinely cares about you and your growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Natural Capital Mapping: Build and maintain the mapping and data behind our Biodiversity Net Gain, biodiversity credit and other Natural Capital projects, from baseline surveys through to vision maps, ready for planning and delivery.

  • New Frontiers: Get stuck into new areas of Natural Capital as we expand (think soil carbon and beyond), finding and building the datasets and maps that these emerging project types need.

  • Acquisitions Support: Source, prepare and quality-check the spatial data behind our acquisitions, from estate-level detail to country and regional-level searches, and help us automate more of this workflow through our internal tools.

  • Tools, Automation & Data Curation: Support the maintenance of our ArcGIS web and mobile apps, StoryMaps and dashboards, help streamline the manual and repetitive parts of our GIS workflows, and turn messy external data into clean, styled, ready-to-use datasets.

About us

Oxygen Conservation was founded in 2021 with a clear mission: Scaling Conservation. We're building the UK's first genuine natural capital portfolio, acquiring large landscapes, restoring them at scale, and creating investable natural capital products including premium carbon credits, biodiversity net gain units, renewable energy partnerships, and ecotourism experiences.

In just four years, we've grown to a valuation of around £400m, with 50,000+ acres owned and over half a million acres connected for nature. By 2030, we aim to have £1 billion of natural capital assets under management, enabling us to protect and restore 250,000 acres of land for people and wildlife.

Oxygen Capital is the investment and finance division of Oxygen Conservation, focused on raising capital, developing natural capital opportunities, and supporting the commercial growth of large-scale conservation. Oxygen Intelligence is our data and analytical infrastructure division, providing the insight, measurement, and proprietary tools that underpin our wider platform. While each division has a distinct external focus, all teams sit within the wider Oxygen Conservation platform and work closely together to deliver our mission of scaling conservation.

We move fast, hold ourselves to high standards, and genuinely believe that what we're building matters. If that sounds like the kind of place you do your best work, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Information

Term: Full-time, permanent.

Location: Remote (some travel to estates or other meetings expected).

Salary: £28,000

Closing date: 21st August

How to Apply: Visit our website and share your GIS work or a portfolio you’re proud of to support your application.

Vi söker en Säkerhetsansvarig och SoS-planerare – järnväg.

Tjänsten är på deltid.

Uppdrag

Säkerhetsansvarig och SoS-planerare – järnväg

Vi söker en konsult för en mindre, flexibel deltidsinsats inom ett järnvägsrelaterat uppdrag. Rollen innebär att stödja uppdragsledning och fältpersonal i frågor som rör riskhantering samt trafik- och elsäkerhet.

Arbetsuppgifter

Uppdraget uppskattas till cirka 10–20 timmar per år, med störst behov vid uppstart och därefter mindre, behovsstyrda insatser. Arbetet kan huvudsakligen utföras på distans. Omfattningen är preliminär och kan variera beroende på antal platsbesök och säkerhetsfrågor.

Om oss

Centios övergripande mål är att vara ett konsultbolag som erbjuder smarta och hållbara lösningar som utvecklar samhället på ett positivt sätt.

Våra medarbetare erbjuds villkor som är anpassade för individen. Det innebär att arbetstider, arbetsomfattning, arbetsplats och kompetensutveckling så långt som möjligt anpassas utifrån medarbetarens behov.

Bland våra medarbetare hittar du engagerad personer som brinner för samhällsutveckling. Vi jobbar i små grupper där du kan bidra med dina erfarenheter samtidigt som du får ta del av andras kunskap och erfarenhet.

För oss är det viktigt med välmående och att hitta en sund balans mellan arbete och fritid. Därför har vi en nollvision mot stress och sätter trivsel och hälsa främst.

Läs gärna mer om oss på centio.se.

Vänligen skicka ditt CV på svenska.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

jobs.title: Front End Developer (Hybrid or Remote)
jobs.excerpt: *This role is open to remote based candidates based in Canada with a preference for PST (hybrid) / EST (remote)* We're looking for a Front End Developer to join our team as we enter our next stage of growth.
jobs.description:
*This role is open to remote based candidates based in Canada with a preference for PST (hybrid) / EST (remote)*

We're looking for a Front End Developer to join our team as we enter our next stage of growth. You'll play a central role in how we craft the best-in-class user interfaces and experiences behind our SaaS products, building fast, accessible, and polished UX on our modern, cloud-native stack. You'll work on developing the components, patterns, and tools that help our teams deliver high quality experiences efficiently and consistently. This role is about tackling challenging front-end problems, caring about the details users feel, and applying best practices in modern front-end development to deliver pixel perfect UI.

Who we are

At Traction Rec, community is at the heart of everything we do. We empower nonprofit organizations like YMCAs, Jewish Community Centers (JCCs), Boys & Girls Clubs of America (BGCA), and Salvation Army Kroc Centers to strengthen their communities through great technology built on the Salesforce platform. By enabling these organizations to deliver their services more efficiently, we help them focus on creating meaningful connections and driving positive change where it matters most.

We believe that business is a powerful force for good. As part of this belief, we’ve committed to the Pledge 1% for the Planet, dedicating 1% of our time, product, profit, or equity to supporting environmental and community causes. This commitment reflects our dedication to creating a positive impact that extends beyond technology.

Our passion for community and innovation has earned us recognition, including:

  • Salesforce Nonprofit Sales Partner of the Year and ISV Partner of the Year
  • Globe & Mail's Top Growing Companies of 2024 and 2025
  • Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 winner 2024
  • Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 winner 2024 and 2025

At Traction Rec, we live our values: Community, Authenticity, Impact, Fun, and Growth. As a Living Wage Certified employer in British Columbia, we are dedicated to supporting not just the communities we serve but also the people who make it all happen—our team.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to join a company that puts community first, we’d love to have you on this journey with us. Together, let’s create stronger, healthier, and more connected communities.

Skills

Traction Rec’rs come from a variety of backgrounds, and we are eager to find people that are from diverse backgrounds. For this role, you might have:

  • Computer Science Degree or equivalent experience
  • 2 years+ professional experience building and shipping front-end applications
  • Strong understanding of component based JavaScript and TypeScript frameworks such as React, including component architecture
  • Understanding of fundamental design principles behind scalable applications
  • Solid grasp of state management (component, global, and visual state)
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working in a highly collaborative development team
  • Fluency with modern CSS and its different approaches
  • Understanding of accessibility, semantic HTML and WCAG compliance
  • Highly motivated with the ability to work and make decisions independently
  • Experience with trunk based development and continuous delivery in cloud environments like AWS and Vercel a plus
  • Bonus points if you've automated processes with AI and used AI coding agents in your workflow to ship high quality UI built by AI

Salesforce ISV experience not required - if you have strong fundamental product developer experience in other industries, and would be eager to lean into something new, we’ll be happy to teach you the platform specifics.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code across our cloud-native stack and Salesforce
  • Oversee proposed solutions to problems and ensure the implemented software will meet business objectives well into the future
  • Translate designs into polished, reusable UI and contribute to our shared component library
  • Own front-end quality: performance, accessibility, and cross-browser consistency
  • Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to these problems
  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues as part of tier 3 support
  • Design and ship new features across our existing and emerging products
  • Participate in monthly “spike days” where we all pair up and build whatever we want

Compensation

At Traction Rec, we are committed to a fair, market-based and equitable compensation structure. Our market data is refreshed on an annual basis to reflect the most current market conditions.

The starting salary band for this role is $80,000-$95,000. Starting salaries will vary within this range based on experience, skill level, and internal equity related to the role.

Please note that the range details above reflect the base pay only and does not include our competitive bonus program and benefits that we offer.

Our Approach to AI

At Traction Rec, we’re big fans of AI and we embrace it as a tool that helps us work smarter and more creatively. It may even have helped with this job description. That said, our recruiting process is 100% human. From resume review to interviews to job offers, every step is led by real people who care about real people. No bots making hiring decisions here.

If you’re interested, so are we! Send your resume our way, and let’s chat.

At Traction Rec, we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve, and we actively seek and welcome candidates from all backgrounds. Our hiring process is designed to be fair, welcoming, and respectful to all candidates, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, ability, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that diversity brings unique perspectives and experiences that can enhance our team and drive innovation, and we are committed to providing equal opportunity and support to all candidates. We encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to the interview process and join us in building a diverse and inclusive culture at Traction Rec.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and marginalized groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Please note that employment is contingent on the successful completion of background and reference checks.

jobs.description:
AML Compliance Officer - Belgium (Work From Home)

As an AML Compliance Officer, you will support Western Union Agents' efforts in implementing Anti-Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, and Anti-Fraud policies and procedures. Also, you will evaluate how Western Union Agents incorporate compliance requirements and standards through conducting activity analysis, compliance reviews, and training sessions. If required, you will follow up with Agents to ensure compliance program gaps are eliminated and identified findings are remediated.

Role Responsibilities

  • Performing onsite and/or offsite AML/CTF/Anti-Fraud Compliance program reviews of new, and existing Agents of Western Union, and its affiliates.
  • Providing support and training to Western Union Agents to implement an effective AML/CTF and anti-fraud Compliance program.
  • Evaluating controls both internally and with our agent partners through analysis and supporting them in delivering compliance programs.
  • Escalating compliance-related risk matters diligently and in a timely manner.
  • Assisting your team in the overall development of AML programs, especially related to end-to-end process tasks and initiatives.
  • Assisting department management with project-related activities and/or additional tasks based on business needs.
  • Implementing policies and procedures and working closely with the global agent oversight and regional compliance teams which will help you achieve consistency.
  • Submitting daily reports to the government portal.

Role Requirements

  • You will have relevant experience within the AML or Compliance field.
  • Fluency in English and French
  • Dutch languages preferable
  • In addition, we require you to have experience communicating with clients/customers (preferably face-to-face and/or via phone) and the ability to manage challenging situations.
  • Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to understand laws and regulations related to AML/CTF and Anti-Fraud policies and procedures.
  • Traveling flexibility up to 50%, adjusted based on business needs.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills (oral and written).
  • Ability to work independently and have strong time management skills.
  • Proficiency with all common Office programs such as: MS Excel, Word, Outlook (but not limited to). Understanding of appropriate regional and global Money Services Business (MSB) regulatory requirements, the Bank Secrecy Act, and their effect on our business will make you stand out.

Work Shifts

Western Union values in-person collaboration, problem solving, and ideation whenever possible. We believe this fosters common ways of working and supports how we execute initiatives for our customers. However, due to the nature of this role, there is no specific office location where the employee is expected to report. The employee must align with their manager on other expected in-person collaboration opportunities.

Benefits

You will also have access to short-term incentives, multiple health insurance options, accident and lifeinsurance, and access to best-in-class development platforms, to name a few. Please see the benefits below specific to your country.If applicable,additionalrole-specific benefits will be mentioned during your interview process or in an offer of employment.

Your Belgium-specific benefits include:

  • Life/Medical Cover
  • Pension Plan
  • Luncheon Vouchers

About Us

At Cast & Crew, we’ve empowered creativity and supported the global entertainment industry for decades. Together with our family of brands - Backstage, CAPS, Checks & Balances, Final Draft, Media Services, Sargent-Disc, and The TEAM Companies – we operate as a combined entertainment technology and services provider offering industry standard screenwriting accounting software, digital payroll products, data & reporting, and a host of creative tools. The industry continues to move faster than ever, and the need for our expertise, our technology, and our people has never been greater. We are a production’s best ally every step of the way. #OneCastOneCrew

Position Overview

We're looking for a Director of Software Engineering to lead multiple engineering teams within our Onboarding and Timekeeping product line — one of the most active and strategically important areas of the business. This is a role for a leader, not just a manager. You'll cultivate ownership and decision-making at the team level, develop strong engineering anchors, and create an environment where your teams don't wait for direction — they are empowered to move.

You'll own the engineering execution of a robust product roadmap that includes mobile applications in a rapid growth phase, drive deep collaboration with Product and QA, and connect your teams into the broader engineering organization through a Spotify-inspired model of Squads, Tribes, Chapters, and Guilds. You'll also champion our initiative to embed AI meaningfully into how we build software.

We're in the middle of a cultural shift — moving faster, owning outcomes, celebrating wins, and holding each other to a high bar. We work hard and play hard. This role requires someone who can get up to speed quickly, lead with empathy from day one, and immediately begin delivering impact.

Core Responsibilities

Servant Leadership & Team Development

  • Build a culture of distributed ownership — push decision-making down to the team level and develop strong team anchors who lead with confidence

  • Coach and grow engineering managers, QA leads, and senior engineers into well-rounded technical leaders

  • Embody the distinction between leadership and management: inspire, develop, and get out of the way

  • Champion a work hard, play hard team culture — high standards, fast feedback, and genuine celebration of wins

Spotify Model: Squads, Tribes, Chapters & Guilds

Our engineering organization is structured around the Spotify model, and this leader plays an active role in making it real — not just understanding it on paper.

  • Lead and align multiple Squads — autonomous, cross-functional teams each owning a slice of the Onboarding and Timekeeping product line — ensuring they have the clarity, resources, and psychological safety to self-organize and deliver

  • Operate as a Tribe leader across these Squads, driving coherence, shared mission, and cross-team coordination within the product line

  • Actively develop Chapters — communities of engineers who share a discipline (e.g., mobile, backend, QA) — ensuring members grow in craft, adopt consistent practices, and carry excellence across Squad boundaries

  • Grow and support Guilds as voluntary communities of interest that spread knowledge and innovation across the broader engineering organization

  • Use this structure not as org-chart formality, but as the engine for building well-rounded, continuously improving team members

Mobile Applications & Rapid Growth

  • Guide engineering strategy and execution for mobile applications that are in an active rapid growth phase — balancing speed, quality, and scalability

  • Partner with mobile chapter leads and senior engineers to establish strong mobile engineering practices, CI/CD pipelines, and quality standards

  • Anticipate the unique challenges of scaling a mobile product: release cadence, device fragmentation, app store pipelines, and performance at scale

  • Attract and develop mobile engineering talent to match the growth trajectory of the product

Product Delivery & Quality

  • Own engineering delivery against a demanding roadmap — shorten delivery timelines, improve delivery quality, and build the practices that make both sustainable

  • Set clear commitments, surface risks early, and consistently ship with quality

  • Involve QA leads as first-class collaborators in planning, not an afterthought at the end

  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Product to refine priorities, scope tradeoffs, and translate business goals into engineering plans

Cross-Product Collaboration

  • Navigate a complex integration landscape — your teams touch and are touched by multiple other product lines; you ensure those relationships are healthy, proactive, and unblocking

  • Drive alignment and coordination across internal product teams and with peer engineering leaders in other product lines

  • Represent your teams well in cross-functional forums and escalate and resolve dependencies with urgency

AI-Driven SDLC

  • Own the strategy and execution of our AI-Driven SDLC initiative — define how AI tooling is adopted, measured, and continuously improved across your teams

  • Establish metrics that demonstrate real gains in velocity and quality, not just adoption theater

  • Stay ahead of the tooling landscape and bring informed, opinionated recommendations to the organization

Technical Direction

  • Maintain strong technical engagement — able to get into architecture decisions, unblock teams, and give meaningful feedback on system design and engineering quality

  • Partner with architects and senior engineers to ensure decisions align with long-term platform goals

  • Drive engineering quality through observability, incident response, code standards, and post-mortems

Key Qualifications

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with 4+ years in engineering leadership managing managers

  • Strong technical background — you can engage credibly on system design, architecture tradeoffs, and engineering quality

  • A proven philosophy of developing leaders, not just managing reports — you know the difference and live it

  • Experience leading or scaling mobile application engineering, ideally in a high-growth context

  • Track record of shortening delivery timelines and improving quality through process, culture, and tooling — not heroics

  • Hands-on familiarity with the Spotify model (Squads, Tribes, Chapters, Guilds) and experience operating within or building toward it

  • Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration instincts — especially with Product and QA

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tooling and enthusiasm for applying it to improve team productivity

  • Excellent communicator; comfortable at the executive level and equally comfortable listening at the team level

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in workforce management, payroll, timekeeping, or HR tech domains

  • Experience managing teams with heavy external integration complexity

  • Familiarity with engineering metrics frameworks (DORA, SPACE, etc.)

  • Prior experience driving a meaningful cultural transformation

Special Work Conditions

26WD100492, Principal Data Analyst

Autodesk has invested in data-driven decision-making, optimizing our platform’s business, product, and cost. We are looking for a Principal Data Analyst to serve as a senior individual contributor and trusted thought partner to Product, Engineering, Strategy, Research, and business leaders. You will define how success is measured, uncover high-value opportunities, lead rigorous experimentation, and build trusted analytical products and AI assisted workflows that turn complex data into better decisions at scale.

This role combines deep product analytics judgment, strong SQL/Python capability, software engineering discipline, and practical fluency with modern AI tools. You will operate comfortably in ambiguity, influence product direction, and create reusable systems that increase the leverage of teams across the organization.

If you are excited about empowering teams and influencing the organization with insights that drive success, this is the role for you!

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product managers and cross-functional teams to identify, define, and address business problems and opportunities through data analysis

  • Use your analytical skills to derive actionable insights from large and complex datasets and communicate findings in a clear and concise manner to technical and non-technical audiences

26WD100492, Analyste principal des données

Autodesk s’est engagé dans une démarche de prise de décision fondée sur les données, visant à optimiser les activités, les produits et les coûts de notre plateforme. Les cinq prochaines années vont transformer notre façon de travailler, avec une explosion du volume de données et une généralisation de l’IA et du ML afin d’apporter encore plus de valeur à nos clients. ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day. Sound simple? We strive to keep it that way! And our latest innovation, SmartSites, offers state-of-the-art websites for school districts, enhancing their online presence and accessibility.

Nearly 1 in 4 students nationwide are chronically absent, making chronic absenteeism one of the highest-stakes challenges districts face. Attendance affects funding, academic outcomes, and long-term student success.

ParentSquare Attendance Plus is our answer: a proactive, relationship-driven solution built directly into the platform districts already use, giving attendance teams tiered data insights, family outreach, and intervention tracking in one place. Since launching, Attendance Plus has earned industry recognition, including Tech & Learning's Best of 2025, and has become one of the fastest-growing lines in the ParentSquare platform.

You'll own positioning and messaging for the entire attendance line, translate the needs of attendance clerks, counselors, and district administrators into a narrative that resonates through the whole buying committee, and make the call on which capabilities deserve a full go-to-market push versus a quiet rollout. You'll be accountable not just for launches but also for helping to grow Attendance Plus as a business.

In This Role You'll:

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer - Remote (Americas time zones)
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Why this role existsSell2Rent is a fast-growing residential real estate platform specializing in sale-leaseback transactions.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Why this role exists

Sell2Rent is a fast-growing residential real estate platform specializing in sale-leaseback transactions. We help homeowners unlock their home equity without moving, while connecting properties with single-family rental investors. We operate in 30+ states and have closed 200+ transactions.

Technology is a key driver of our growth. We’ve built a proprietary operating platform, AI agents for lead qualification and outreach, an investor-matching layer, and a lead engine that supports our sales process.

We’re looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) who sees technology as a growth and revenue engine — not just an engineering function. You’ll work closely with Sales, and Marketing, to use AI, automation, data, and product to generate more qualified leads, improve conversion, accelerate the sales cycle, and close more transactions.

You’ll inherit real, revenue-generating technology, a talented team, and the opportunity to create the technology strategy that will help Sell2Rent scale faster and sell more.

If you’re excited about using technology to drive measurable business results, this is your opportunity to make a major impact.

What you'll own

Technology strategy.You set the direction: architecture, build-vs-buy, which platforms we standardize on, where AI is a genuine advantage and where it's a distraction. You'll be the person in the room who knows what's actually possible and what it costs.

The engineering organization.You lead a distributed team of roughly ten across engineering and data, all of them in Latin America. You'll grow it, structure it, and set the bar.

Scaling the platform.Our twelve-month mandate is to ship the roadmap and scale what we've built — completing the migration off legacy systems, hardening the platform, and getting to a place where the business can grow transaction volume without engineering becoming the bottleneck.

The AI layer.Agents handle a meaningful share of our qualification, outreach, and internal operations today. Deciding how far that goes — and building it so it's a durable advantage rather than a demo — is one of the most interesting problems here.

Resilience and continuity.Security, access governance, vendor management, monitoring, documentation, and the discipline that ensures no single person is ever again the only one who knows how something works. We've learned this lesson the expensive way and we're not repeating it.

Executive partnership.You sit on the Executive Committee. You'll work directly with the CEO and the sales, marketing, and operations leaders — translating what the business needs into what gets built, and telling us honestly when what we're asking for is a bad idea.


Requirements

Who we're looking for

  • 15+ years in technology, with progressive leadership responsibility and time as a CTO, VP of Engineering, or Head of Technology.

  • You've scaled a team and a system before.Not just managed one — took something from working-but-fragile to reliable-at-volume, and grew the org that did it.

  • You are technical enough to be trusted, but your job is not to write the code.You should be able to read our architecture, challenge a design decision, and evaluate a vendor on the merits. We have engineers to build. We need someone who can direct them and know when the answer is wrong.

  • Real depth in AI-driven architecture, cloud infrastructure (we run on GCP), APIs, integrations, and data. Depth, not enthusiasm — you can tell us what LLM-based agents actually break on in production.

  • You find blind spots.Much of the value in your first six months is telling us what we don't know we're missing — in our architecture, our tooling, our security posture, and our process.

  • You lead people well.Our team is remote, distributed, and international. Keeping engineers motivated, growing, and clear on what matters is a large part of this job.

  • Startup-fluent.You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and making decisions before all the information arrives.

  • Business-minded.You can connect a technical investment to revenue and defend it to a CEO who will ask.

Helpful, not required:real estate, proptech, or fintech experience; running a US-based company with a LatAm engineering team; Spanish.

How this role fits with product

Our CEO owns product direction and will continue to for the foreseeable future, working closely with the commercial leadership team. You own technology, architecture, and execution. You'll have real influence on what we build and strong input on sequencing — but the product roadmap is not yours to set, and we're not planning to hand it over.

We're stating this plainly because the previous version of this role blended both, and the wrong expectation here makes an otherwise great partnership fail. If owning a product is what you're looking for in your next role, this isn't it.

What success looks like

By 90 days— you know where every system, credential, vendor, and dependency lives, and so does someone besides you. You've told us the three things about our architecture that worry you most. The team knows who they report to, what they're building, and why it matters.

By 6 months— the platform migration is on a credible path, engineering has a real operating cadence, and technology decisions are being made deliberately rather than reactively. You've made at least one hire that raises the bar.

By 12 months— we've shipped the roadmap, the platform handles significantly more volume without more people, and our AI capability is a genuine competitive advantage rather than a set of internal tools. Nothing critical depends on any single individual, including you.


Benefits

Details

  • Location:Remote, with meaningful overlap with US Eastern and Latin America.

  • Compensation:Competitive base plus meaningful equity. We'll be direct about the range early in the process.

  • Team:~10 in technology and data; company-wide, a lean and fast-moving organization.

Our process

  1. Intro call with the CEO — 45 minutes, mutual fit.

  2. Technical and architectural conversation — we'll walk you through what we've actually built and get your honest read on it.

  3. Meet the engineering team and two executive peers.

  4. A working session on a real problem we're facing. Paid, if it requires meaningful preparation.

  5. References and offer.

We move quickly and we'll tell you where you stand at every step.

Sell2Rent is an equal opportunity employer.

Job Summary:

We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Product team.
You will be the connective tissue between business needs and product execution, translating stakeholder requirements into clear, actionable specifications that enable our Development, Design, and Quality Assurance teams to deliver valuable product outcomes.
Working closely with Product Managers, you will bring structure, clarity, and momentum to product delivery, freeing Product Managers to focus on strategy, discovery and product direction.
AI will be an important part of how you work. You will use Claude and other AI tools to accelerate high-volume activities such as drafting requirements, synthesizing feedback, identifying gaps, generating test scenarios, and preparing release documentation. You will direct the tools, critically evaluate their outputs, and remain fully accountable for everything shared with Development teams and stakeholders.
Make your impact with a rapidly growing marine software business.

Job Description:

You Will

  • Elicit, document, analyze, and validate business requirements through stakeholder interviews, working sessions, research, and product discovery activities.
    - Use Claude and other AI tools to accelerate first-draft documentation while independently reviewing, refining, and validating all outputs.
    - Translate business and customer needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and measurable acceptance criteria.
    - Maintain a groomed backlog with PM partnership; use Claude for gap detection before tickets reach development.
    - Document current-state and future-state workflows, business rules, system behaviour, and product interactions to create alignment before development begins.
    - Act as trusted point of contact for scope, timelines, and delivery status; facilitate working sessions across business, product, and development.
    - Communicate changes, decisions, and rationale clearly - no one should be surprised.
    - Develop test scenarios for QA/UAT using Claude-generated drafts from acceptance criteria; track delivery against those criteria and escalate gaps.
    - Analyze product usage, support tickets, and stakeholder feedback to inform prioritization; build lightweight reporting for stakeholders and leadership.
    - Coordinate release notes using AI; partner with product marketing to enable internal teams before new capabilities ship.

You Bring

  • Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Product Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or in a similar role within a software or technology environment.
    - Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft 365.
    - Practical experience using Claude or comparable generative AI tools in a professional environment.
    - The ability to write effective prompts, evaluate AI-generated content, recognize inaccurate or incomplete outputs, and edit artifacts to a high professional standard.
    - Solid PDLC understanding; ability to read data via Excel, SQL, or BI platforms; comfortable in technical discussions without being a developer.
    - A solid understanding of how software products are built and how feature decisions connect to business outcomes (revenue, retention, operational efficiency).
    - Exceptional written and verbal communication - increasingly means editing AI-generated artifacts to a high standard.
    - Strong facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to align teams that may have different priorities or perspectives.
    - Experience working simultaneously across Product Management, Development, Design, Quality Assurance, and business stakeholders.
    - The confidence to respectfully challenge stakeholder requests, uncover the underlying need, and determine whether the proposed solution is addressing the right problem.
    - A critical mindset and the ability to apply the same level of scrutiny to AI-generated outputs as you would to any other source of information.
    - The ability to work effectively through ambiguity while remaining organized, proactive, and focused on outcomes.

A CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, or equivalent certification would be an asset. Demonstrated experience using Claude or other generative AI tools within a professional product or technology environment is valued alongside traditional qualifications.

Who You Are

You are goal-oriented, self-motivated, curious, and a clear communicator.

You take ownership of your work from initial conversation through delivery and validation. You approach ambiguity with curiosity and rigour, ask thoughtful questions, and are not afraid to challenge assumptions when doing so will lead to a better outcome.

You use AI confidently and responsibly - not as a replacement for judgment, but as a tool to work faster and more effectively. You know how to direct, assess, edit, and quality-check AI-generated content rather than treating the first output as finished work.

jobs.description:
Role is open to candidates based in Africa only.

Amid increasing disruptions to global supply chains and shifts in the global aid financing landscape, the Senior Supply Chain Advisor (SSCA) will provide strategic leadership to help ensure reliable access to safe abortion commodities, contraceptives, and gender-based violence management supplies across development and humanitarian contexts. This role will strengthen supply availability through formal health systems and self-care pathways by establishing and enhancing global technical tools, processes, monitoring mechanisms, and partnerships that contribute to a sustainable abortion ecosystem. Effective supply chain management is a critical pillar for building resilient, responsive, and equitable pathways to care.

Summary of Responsibilities

The SSCA serve as subject matter expert for global health supply chain technical issues, in areas such as quantification, forecasting, procurement, storage and distribution and inventory management, logistics management information systems (LMIS), health systems strengthening, budgeting and financial management, driving and analyzing supply chain performance, and program effectiveness.

The role is expected to translate technical expertise into practical tools, country support, and partnership strategies that reduce supply interruptions and improve visibility, availability, and responsible use of reproductive health commodities.

Organizational Leadership and Strategy:

  • Lead the Ipas supply chain management approach across the network by ensuring that evidence and best practice inform strategies and efforts to sustain the availability of abortion and contraception drugs across the different pathways to care.

Program, technical, and functional responsibilities:

  • Provide technical leadership and support to strengthen sexual and reproductive health commodity supply chains at global, regional, and country levels across the pathways to care
  • Support countries to assess gaps in reproductive health commodity systems and implement corrective actions.
  • Improve forecasting, quantification, procurement, warehousing, distribution, transportation, quality assurance, and logistics management information systems for abortion and contraception commodities.
  • Design and optimize supply chain strategies, tools, and frameworks for SRH commodities in partnership with country programs, governments, and partners to speed up product flow.
  • Build national capacity through training, mentoring, curricula development, and knowledge transfer for supply chain staff and stakeholders.
  • Strengthen partnerships with national, regional, and international experts, institutions, and partner organizations to advance RH supply chain systems.
  • Promote evidence-based approaches, lessons learned, innovation, and increase data visibility and use for continuous improvement of supply chain performance and operations.
  • Establish quality assurance, sustainability assessment, monitoring, evaluation frameworks, and KPIs to track supply chain performance globally.
  • Mitigate supply chain disruptions through risk management, contingency planning, supplier diversification, and compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Foster innovation in procurement, market shaping, inventory management, distribution, and technology-enabled global stock management, including in crisis-affected settings.
  • Contribute to the regional advocacy efforts to integrate abortion commodities in essential medicine lists (EML), including supporting the registration and marketing authorization of abortion commodities.
  • Capitalize on private sector supply chain capacity and knowledge for innovative packaging, distribution, and user experience documentation.
  • Lead monitoring and evidence synthesis on the safety and quality of abortion commodities used locally in order to contribute to external collective efforts of pharmacovigilance.

Resource mobilization:

  • Contribute to project design, proposal development, and opportunity prospecting for supply chain strengthening initiatives.
  • Participate in donor and partner calls to ensure supply chain needs, priorities, and progress are effectively represented across the Ipas network.
  • Assist procurement and contracting team with product quality assurance assessments and vendor certification vetting.
  • Coordinate and support financial review of global supply chain strengthening initiatives and projects

Communications & representation:

  • Lead efforts to highlight, advance, and advocate for abortion supply planning priorities by engaging supply chain coalitions and working groups, international NGOs, multilateral partners—including UN agencies, the World Bank Group, WHO—and donors to collaborate on and inform global abortion supply planning.
  • Contribute to evidence generation and knowledge sharing on reproductive health supply chains across countries, regional networks, technical forums, and international conferences.

Position Requirements

  • Deep commitment to sexual and reproductive health and rights, especially abortion and contraception access
  • Significant experience in key areas of supply chain system assessment approaches and tools, forecasting and quantification methods and tools, procurement processes, inventory control and distribution systems, and management information systems.
  • Experience working with private sector partners, including pharmacies, community distribution systems, and digital health platforms.
  • Professional-level fluency in English
  • Proven ability to lead and motivate teams and foster a positive work environment through supportive supervision, effective communication, shared leadership, and modeling of organizational core values.
  • Demonstrated capacity and commitment to sound stewardship of funds, including strong skills in work planning, budgeting, financial monitoring, and data-driven problem solving.
  • Proven ability to build positive working relationships with diverse internal teams and external partners.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and sound judgment skills, with the ability to identify and resolve policy and operational constraints.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent knowledge of and experience working with country and/or regional health system entities.

Education

Advanced degree (master’s or equivalent) in public health, supply chain management, logistics, health system strengthening, pharmacy, or related medical field

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in global health supply chain management, with a strong focus on reproductive health commodity supply chains.
  • Strong quantitative analysis and forecasting skills, cross-cultural diplomacy, and experience working in low-resource or humanitarian settings.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical assistance to global health programs.
  • Demonstrated experience in global health commodity supply chain management.
  • Knowledge of technical issues related to global health commodity procurement.
  • Demonstrated ability in strategic planning, program management, and implementation in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Experience working on sustainable commodity access programs.
  • Experience facilitating training and providing technical assistance to country teams, including through remote support

Working environment:

Ipas is a globally networked organization committed to shared leadership and local ownership. 67% of our leadership are women, and our teams are grounded in local expertise and lived experience. Equity is not an add-on — it drives how we design programs and how we work as an organization.
  • This position is fully remote, subject to change based on business need.
  • Flexibility to meet virtually in different time zones required.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% of the time internationally, including in crisis settings

Salary grade for this role is S2. Compensation for this position will be determined on the hiring country's prevailing market rate in addition to Ipas's own pay philosophy and other factors, such as the employee's experience level and expertise.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on WHO pre-qualification process with WHO-Listed Authorities, National Regulatory Authorities, and private sector.
  • Excellent knowledge of Logistics Management Information Systems, including e-LMIS, DHIS2, VAN, and Power BI.
  • Proficiency with at least one Ipas working language, such as French, Portuguese, or Spanish.

Ipas is strongly committed to providing a work environment that is free from all forms of harassment, discrimination, and inequity. We recruit, employ, train, promote, and compensate our personnel without regard to race, age, sex, religion, national origin, color, creed, ancestry, citizenship, caste, ethnicity, regional identity, tribal identity, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, gender identity, transgender status, sexual orientation, or any other personal characteristic protected by law or outlined by Ipas policy. Job Title: Senior Clinical Research Manager

Job Location: Remote (US)

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

The Senior Clinical Research Manager oversees clinical monitoring activities and the CRA team's performance to ensure they comply with ICH-GCP, local regulations, and company SOPs, and maintain quality across clinical trials. As a line manager, this role leads a team to achieve organizational goals and ensure high performance by providing guidance, support, and development opportunities while promoting a positive team culture.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • •Team Resource Allocation & Performance
  • Allocate CRA resources and perform ongoing resource assessments to ensure a balanced workload for quality monitoring and to meet study deliverables.
  • Ensure CRAs have the required level of monitoring knowledge and skills to successfully perform required activities with high quality to meet study deliverables.
  • Is responsible for managing and addressing CRA performance and quality indicators in accordance with ICH-GCP, SOPs and local regulations.
  • Strengthen site relationships to enhance performance and uphold the company’s trial delivery reputation.

Quality and Compliance

  • Review monitoring quality and resolve issues to ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines, ICH-GCP Guidelines, and Good Clinical Practices.
  • Effective September 01, 2025
  • Support study/site milestone delivery in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Responsible for execution of assessment visits and accompanied visits (where required) to assess ongoing CRA monitoring competency, identifying issues and developing resolution strategies.
  • Contribute to process optimization initiatives and manage risk escalation and resolution.
  • Support site audits/inspections/Site Compliance Visits (SCV) and ensure corrective action and follow-up for identified issues

Expense Review and Management

  • Review and approve expenses related to CRA activities to ensure alignment with applicable policies and financially best local practices.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving and efficiency while maintaining quality and compliance standards.

Mentoring

  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior Clinical Research Managers (CRMs), supporting their professional growth and development if required.
  • Facilitate learning opportunities and provide valuable insights and feedback to help upskill and promote consistency within the wider team.

Leadership of Taskforce and Initiatives

  • Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives and task forces aimed at improving clinical operations processes and outcomes, driving projects from inception to completion in alignment with organizational goals and in collaboration with cross-functional teams

Supervisory Responsibilities:

•Recruitment and Onboarding: Performs recruiting and hiring activities, along with onboarding new team members to ensure alignment with team objectives and culture.
•Task Assignment: Assign tasks based on individual strengths and team objectives, ensuring optimal productivity.
•Support and Resource Provision: Support team members by providing necessary resources to help them effectively perform their roles.
•Communication and Collaboration: Encourage open communication and collaboration within the team and with other functions, including a point of contact for issue escalation and feedback where required.
•Performance Evaluation: Conduct regular performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback to promote continuous improvement.
•Mentoring and Development: Lead and mentor team members, fostering an environment of growth and development.
•Issue Resolution: Address any personnel issues promptly and fairly to maintain a positive work environment.

Effective September 01, 2025

•Career Development Support: Support team members in identifying and pursuing professional development opportunities.
Computer Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
Other Qualifications:
•Fluent in written and verbal English
•Minimum 7 years of industry experience in the pharmaceutical or CRO or relevant field
•Minimum 4 years of People management or project management experience in progressive clinical research within the biotech, pharmaceutical sector, CRO industry or relevant field is preferred
•Thorough understanding of the drug development process, including expert knowledge of international standards (ICH GCP) and health authority requirements
•Understanding of all aspects of monitoring and trial execution, with previous experience as a CRA preferred
•Excellent interpersonal skills, strong organizational and effective written and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated team leadership experience.
•Experience in Oncology is highly recommended.

Travel: Be adaptable to business trips as required per business need; require valid driver’s license in applicable countries

Education Required:

Bachelor’s degree or higher in a scientific or healthcare discipline, and advanced degrees preferred.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation.
