jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for a hands-on AWS threat hunter with strong technical and analytical skills, genuine curiosity about cloud attack techniques, experience hunting for evidence of adversarial activity, and the ability to develop defensive capabilities to counter them. The ideal candidate will have 3-5 years of hands-on threat hunting experience in cloud environments, preferably AWS.

You will work with complex, high-profile organizations across the globe, conducting threat hunting in cloud environments to identify active and historical threats, reviewing cloud control plane configurations, and providing technical recommendations to reduce adversary opportunity in target environments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Utilize the Falcon platform and threat intelligence to analyze cloud logs and identify historical and active threats.

  • Baseline and review cloud security configurations, looking for anomalies associated with threat activity.

  • Develop queries and scripts to work with large volumes of data, including correlating data across multiple sources and identifying outliers that may be indicative of threat activity.

  • Identify identity and control plane configurations that may expose cloud environments to threats and unauthorized access.

  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of client projects, including project management, communication, status updates, and task assignment.

  • Produce high-quality written and verbal reports, presentations, recommendations, and findings for key stakeholders, including customer management, regulators, and legal counsel.

What You’ll Need:

Technical Skills:

  • An in-depth understanding of cloud adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs), including attack path chaining and enriching data with threat intelligence.

  • An in-depth understanding of the AWS platform, including the following domains: logging, identity, networking, workload security, data security, and multi-account management practices.

  • A solid grasp of AWS security architecture patterns, including log management architecture and automation patterns leveraging AWS-native services.

  • A strong knowledge of security configuration and architecture of CI/CD pipelines

  • A strong ability to write modular scripts and software tools in Python or Go to work with AWS services and Falcon APs.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Communication Skills:

  • A strong ability to verbally communicate technical concepts and findings in plain English to technical and non-technical audiences, including CISO-level stakeholders.

  • Excellent technical writing skills and ability to produce high-quality written reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and CrowdStrike clients.

  • Attention to details, time management, delegation. This is a consulting role and excellent organizational skills are non-negotiable.

We care about what you know and what you can do, not the specific path you took to get here. Strong candidates will have built real depth in cloud platforms and security over time - whether through years in dedicated security roles, a background in cloud engineering or DevOps that shifted toward threat hunting, or any other route that got them to the same place. What matters is that the knowledge is solid and the skills are demonstrable.

This role may require the candidate to periodically undergo and pass alcohol and/or drug test(s) during the course of employment.

Job Description

The Technology Architecture Lead is responsible for designing, building, and governing a scalable, AI-enabled platform for developing, managing, and maintaining training and enablement content. This role serves as the technical architect for SharePoint-based ecosystems and associated AI capabilities, ensuring content is structured, discoverable, governed, and continuously optimized across global commercial and learning organizations.

The role bridges information architecture, platform design, and applied AI to create a modern content system that improves speed to market, content quality, reuse, and compliance. Working closely with enablement, L&D, IT, and business stakeholders, the architect translates content strategy and governance requirements into a sustainable technical solution.

Key Responsibilities

Platform & Information Architecture

  • Design and own the end-to-end architecture for SharePoint-based training and enablement content platforms.

  • Define site structures, taxonomies, metadata models, permissions, and lifecycle management standards to support global content needs.

  • Ensure the platform supports scalability, usability, and consistent user experience across regions and teams.

AI-Enabled Content Systems

  • Apply AI capabilities (e.g., content tagging, search optimization, summarization, recommendations, and content quality insights) to improve how training content is created, curated, and consumed.

  • Partner with internal teams and vendors to integrate AI services with SharePoint and related content systems.

  • Translate business needs into practical AI use cases that improve content effectiveness and governance.

Content Governance & Standards

  • Establish and enforce governance frameworks for content creation, review, approval, versioning, and retirement.

  • Define technical guardrails and workflows that support compliance, accuracy, and consistency of training materials.

  • Partner with enablement and L&D leaders to align platform design with instructional and commercial standards.

Implementation & Integration

  • Lead technical implementation and configuration of SharePoint sites, workflows, and integrations with adjacent systems (e.g., LMS, CRM, enablement platforms).

  • Collaborate with IT to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and data management requirements.

Bluum is seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Contract Coordinator to support the pursuit of new contract opportunities, and the administration, coordination, and ongoing reporting of the company’s existing contract portfolio. Primary Responsibilities

  • Documentation & Record Management: Maintain accurate and organized compliance files, records, certifications, and supporting documentation. Ensure information is current, complete, appropriately stored, and readily available for internal or external review.

  • Policy & Procedure Support: Assist with the development, documentation, implementation, and maintenance of compliance-related policies, procedures, templates, checklists, and standard operating procedures.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Finance, and Operations to communicate contract compliance requirements and deadlines, obtain necessary information, resolve issues, and support consistent processes throughout the organization.
  • Reporting & Tracking: Maintain compliance trackers and prepare reports to monitor deadlines, spend or utilization against contract value, renewal and expiration dates, outstanding requirements, documentation status, and other key compliance activities. Distribute reporting to internal stakeholders and, where required, to customers.

For 25 years, DrFirst has empowered providers and patients to achieve better health through intelligent medication management. We improve healthcare workflows and help patients start and stay on therapy with end-to-end solutions that enhance prescription access, affordability, and adherence. Our solutions help 100 million patients a year and are used by more than 420,000 prescribers, 71,000 pharmacies, 270 EHRs and health information systems, and over 2,000 hospitals in the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a successful Healthcare IT company experiencing significant growth. Here you’ll get to work with some of the smartest and most interesting people around, solving unique and complex challenges in healthcare on a scale matched by few companies. If you get excited about stretching yourself in new ways, developing yourself to your fullest potential, and care about working with smart colleagues, we want to talk to you!

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative problem solver who tackles puzzles for breakfast and scales the solution by dinner. As a Senior Data Scientist you will join a group of data scientists and data analysts to lead and contribute to AI and ML initiatives that push the boundaries of what is possible in healthcare. The team reports directly to the President of the Provider Solutions division, and you should expect to work with and present to executive management often.

This is a senior individual contributor role, not a people management position. The other data scientists do not report to you. You lead through influence by setting technical direction on projects, coaching and raising the bar for your peers, and setting the example on the hardest problems. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in natural language processing (NLP), hands on experience with large language models (LLMs), and fluency with event driven data pipelines. Software engineering experience is a plus because you will work closely with our engineers.

What you will work on

  • Own AI, ML, and NLP initiatives end to end, from problem framing through model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and long term maintenance in production.
  • Apply LLMs to automate complex, high volume workflows. Partner with software architects and engineering to deliver solutions that meet strict platform latency and throughput requirements across millions of transactions, balancing accuracy, response time, and inference cost through model selection, caching, and prompt design.
  • Define what good looks like. Build evaluation datasets and automated eval pipelines for LLM and ML systems, measure quality and error rates on clinical and financial content, and catch regressions when prompts, models, or data change.
  • Build and own the data foundations behind these models, including production grade pipelines and feature datasets sourced from our PostgreSQL transactional systems and Redshift warehouse, with attention to data quality, lineage, and reliability.
  • Partner with clinicians, pharmacists, and other domain experts to define ground truth, adjudicate edge cases, and validate that model behavior holds up against real clinical workflows.
  • Ensure solutions are accurate, robust, and compliant with healthcare regulations including HIPAA, with appropriate handling of PHI and monitoring for bias, safety, and performance drift.
  • Act as the technical lead on projects. Set direction, define approach, establish best practices, and influence technical strategy on complex, high ambiguity problems.
  • Coach and mentor data scientists through pairing, design and code reviews, and constructive feedback. Contribute to hiring by interviewing and helping raise the technical bar of the team.
  • Communicate complex analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences, including executive management, through clear presentations, reports, and visualizations.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, and NLP, with a track record of delivering models into production.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Pipeline development and orchestration. Hands on experience building ELT and ETL workflows with tools such as dbt, Airflow, and AWS data services (Glue, DMS, Lambda, S3), with attention to incremental loads, idempotency, data quality testing, and documentation and lineage.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including tested, modular, production quality Python, Git based workflows and code review, containerization (Docker), and CI/CD.
  • Experience productionizing and monitoring models on AWS, including model registry, CI/CD for ML, versioning, and post deployment monitoring, with tools such as SageMaker and MLflow.
  • Experience building and evaluating LLM powered applications, for example Claude via Amazon Bedrock, including prompt design, retrieval and RAG pipelines, and systematic evaluation of output quality.
  • Proven ability to scope ambiguous problems and deliver solutions end to end with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects and coach or mentor other data scientists, guiding technical decisions and elevating team output.
  • Excellent problem solving and communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the healthcare or insurance industry.
  • Healthcare data literacy across FHIR, HL7v2, and X12, and clinical vocabularies including RxNorm, NDC, ICD-10, and SNOMED.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining production data pipelines. This includes modeling data for an analytical warehouse (Amazon Redshift or a comparable columnar MPP platform), extracting from transactional systems (PostgreSQL), and writing performant SQL against large tables, including the ability to read a query plan and fix a slow query rather than escalate it.
  • Comfortable packaging and deploying work in containers (Docker) and deploying models to cloud managed serving infrastructure such as SageMaker endpoints, ECS, or Lambda. Familiarity with Kubernetes is a plus.

Physical Requirements

  • 10% Remote travel to client sites, conferences, or internal team meetings

Job Title: CRM Integration Architect

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a CRM Integration Architect to design and govern integrations between Salesforce and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on integration architecture, middleware selection, API strategy, and event-driven patterns that connect Salesforce reliably with ERP, data, marketing, and operational systems. The ideal candidate has architected Salesforce integration solutions at meaningful scale and brings deep familiarity with both Salesforce-native and enterprise middleware approaches. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the end-to-end integration architecture for Salesforce ecosystems spanning Sales, Service, Marketing, and Industry Clouds.
  • Select and apply appropriate integration patterns including request-reply, fire-and-forget, batch, and event-driven approaches.
  • Design integrations using Salesforce-native capabilities (Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Connect, Composite APIs) alongside enterprise middleware such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Lead integration design reviews and approve technical designs across Salesforce programs.
  • Define API strategy, contract management, and versioning standards for Salesforce-related integrations.
  • Architect data synchronization patterns for high-volume integrations with ERP, billing, and operational systems.
  • Design identity and access patterns for Salesforce integrations including OAuth flows and connected app management.
  • Establish error handling, retry, and dead-letter strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Drive performance, scalability, and governor-limit management for integration-heavy Salesforce implementations, designing patterns that stay safely within platform limits even as transaction volumes grow over time.
  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure integrations meet enterprise security requirements.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Collaborate closely with vendors to evaluate and onboard integration platforms, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Stay current with Salesforce integration capabilities and broader iPaaS evolution.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of Salesforce experience, with significant time on complex integrations.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major iPaaS such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns and enterprise application architecture.
  • Experience designing data synchronization strategies with ERP and operational systems.
  • Strong understanding of identity, OAuth, and integration security.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Salesforce Certified Integration Architect credential.
  • Track record of leading large Salesforce integration programs.
Preferred Qualifications
  • MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect.
  • Experience with event-driven integration platforms (Kafka, Solace, Confluent).
  • Familiarity with Industry Clouds and their data-integration nuances.
  • Exposure to high-volume integration scenarios (10M+ records/day).
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite ERP systems.

The Opportunity

Cint seeks an Integration Consultant for our Demand Integrations Team, reporting directly into our regional lead. This is a junior role, supporting the individual regional teams and their customers while having the responsibility for a small, individual portfolio of customers.

The Demand Integrations team's mission is to deliver deep technical expertise and custom software engineering solutions to develop automated workflows for partners via API integrations.

As Integration Consultant in the Demand Integrations team, you will support a set of existing customers and the onboarding of new customers. Cint’s goal is to ensure a quick and successful onboarding within a month. You will also be responsible to monitor the health of integrations for various customers and flag any concerning statistics.

Important metrics for every Integration Consultant are the health of the customer’s integration, the growth of the customer and the speed to launch for every new customer.

The Integration Consultants works closely with Customer Success Team and the Account Management. On the technical side, we provide feedback to our internal tech and product teams about customer feedback and their needs.

Candidates with a can-do attitude and a proactive, hands-on approach, who like to problem solve, embrace and thrive with change and who work well in a team environment will thrive in this team.

Enthusiastic team players will quickly be able to make their mark in our fast-paced and stimulating environment where creativity, personal growth and initiative are encouraged and supported.

This position is focused on our customers in the APAC region and therefore requires the candidate to support and be flexible with these time zones.

Remote working is fully supported as the team is operating globally with various locations (and remotely).

The Team

The Demand Integrations team is part of the overall Customer Experience Org. We work closely with all departments, acting as facilitators between our internal sales and customer success teams and the external customers and their tech teams.

We also close the loop between our internal tech and product teams with customer feedback and feature requests to ensure customer voices are heard.

The Demand Integrations team supports customers globally. Team members are located in various US and European cities as well as in India. Our team supports three main areas: Cint’s Marketplaces, Measurement and Data solutions, and Optimization & Health.

What You Will Do

  • Help build and manage relationships with customers in our allocated portfolio to drive the health and growth of your customer’s integrations

  • Gain an understanding of your customer’s internal structures, key stakeholders and their business and needs

  • Provide technical guidance to customers during all phases of their integration life cycle

  • Collaborate with the other account team members to update them on progress, plan and implement measures to grow your customers

  • Analyse your customers’ integration performance on a regular basis to proactively recommend improvements internally and to your customers

  • Investigate and resolve customer issues in a timely and professional fashion

  • Develop a full understanding the industries in which Cint and your customers operate

  • Ability to understand different and unique customer business models and how an integration with Cint will benefit them

  • Practice superior time management self-discipline to work independently from home

What We Are Looking For

  • Technical experience relating to APIs, API implementation, platform-to-platform integrations

  • Ability to focus on large amounts of data daily

  • Proven stakeholder management experience, with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders across different teams and levels
  • Strong experience managing stakeholder expectations, handling competing priorities, communicating progress and risks, and driving issues through to resolution

  • Ability to quickly learn and implement new technologies and APIs by following technical documentation.

  • Enjoys solving problems and prefers analytical methods

  • Strong communicator and flexible team player

  • Ability to convey complicated ideas to non-technical stakeholders

  • Tech-savvy, with proficiency in using MS-Office products - key features expertise:

    • Excel V-lookups, Pivot tables with filtering/formulas/etc, de-duplications checks

  • Extremely thorough and detail-oriented in both communication and analysis

  • Curiosity and drive to learn new technologies and systems

  • Must be able to work in an evolving, fast-paced environment and demonstrate the ability to effectively manage multiple tasks simultaneously

  • Confident in speaking and writing in English

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Bachelor’s degree. (Business administration, information technology, Market Research, computer science, information technology, engineering or related discipline preferred)

  • Familiarity with internet protocols and API frameworks, as well as at least one programming language

  • Experience with SQL, Postman, Power BI, JIRA, or Salesforce is a plus

  • Experience with Grafana and/or similar systems

  • Experience with AI

  • Awareness of modern software development methodologies, with emphasis on application architecture and API infrastructure

  • Additional Language skills beyond English

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)

Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed AI Architect (GenAI, AWS)
jobs.excerpt: About the role:Provectus is a Premier AWS partner and an Anthropic Strategic Partner at the forefront of applied AI, helping enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements.
jobs.description:
About the role:

    Provectus is a Premier AWS partner and an Anthropic Strategic Partner at the forefront of applied AI, helping enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide and are obsessed with reimagining how they operate and compete.

    Our work centers on two verticals — Financial Services & Insurance and Healthcare & Life Sciences — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture.

    We embed engineers and leaders inside client operations as Forward Deployed Architects (FDA) and Forward Deployed Executives (FDX) — people who learn the work, ship the system, and own the outcome. Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Bluprints.

    You will do the customer’s job before you automate it.

    Most AI engagements fail the same way: someone gathers requirements, someone writes a PRD, and a team ships a workflow nobody uses. We think the requirements-gathering step is the bug. So we remove it.

    A Forward Deployed AI Engineer at Provectus spends the first weeks of an engagement in the operator’s seat — as the underwriter, the analyst, the RCM specialist, the claims clinician, whoever actually does the work we’ve been asked to change. You do the job. You learn the constraints from the inside, the ones nobody writes down. Then you sit at a table with that operator and a Forward Deployed Executive and rebuild the function from first principles — and you are the one who builds it.

    Three things define how you work:

  • Embedded, not engaged. You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it.
  • Real tasks, not scope. You are not fenced into a siloed deliverable. You go where the operating problem is.
  • Autonomous. Embedded is not staff-augmented. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket.

    • You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. That loop is the difference between an outcome and an invoice.

    You’ll be measured on whether the Business Unit’s number moved — not on hours, not on scope delivered.

    This is a role for engineers who have led before — as a founder, a CTO, a staff engineer — and who want to stay in the code while owning the outcome. On most days you’ll be the most senior technical person in the room, and you’ll still be the one shipping.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands-on today and intend to stay that way.
  • You will take the operator’s seat. You are genuinely willing to spend weeks doing someone else’s job — claims processing, underwriting, revenue-cycle work — before you write a line of code. Engineers who need to stay in the IDE should not apply.
  • You learn domains fast. Demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly enough to argue with the people who do it for a living.
  • Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works.
  • You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack.
  • Cloud-native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus): containers, Kubernetes/ECS, IaC, CI/CD, and the operational reality of a system someone else inherits.
  • Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job.
  • Solid AI/ML foundations — you understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes, not just call the API.
  • Strong hands-on prodcution experience with Claude Code/Cowork.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

    • Nice to have:

  • Prior experience as a founder, CTO, or engineering leader who has chosen to return to individual contribution.
  • Real depth in one of our blueprint industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare, asset management.
  • Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery.
  • Data platform depth: data lakes, warehouses, streaming and real-time analytics, data mesh and data contracts, governance and data quality.
  • MLOps and classical ML: PyTorch, SageMaker, MLflow.
  • Fine-tuning, distillation, or inference/serving optimization.
  • Graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
  • IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform.
  • Open-source contributions or public writing on applied AI.

What you’ll do:

    Take the seat

    • Do the operator’s job for two to four weeks at the start of an engagement. Learn the function from inside, not from a requirements doc.
    • Reach working fluency in a new domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset flow — in weeks, not quarters.
    • Sit with the operator and the Forward Deployed Executive and redesign the function from first principles. Discovery, user research, and PRD-writing collapse into one team that re-imagines its own job. You are all three roles.

      • Build

      • Ship production GenAI systems into the customer’s environment — LLM applications, agentic workflows, retrieval and structured-extraction pipelines, and the services around them. Running software, not recommendations.
      • Build the evaluation harness before you build the feature. When the engagement is bound to a business KPI, “it looked good in testing” is not an answer. Define what working means, instrument it, and let the evals drive the design.
      • Write production code across the stack — backend services, data pipelines, and the AI layer. Python and TypeScript are our centre of gravity; we choose tools to fit the customer, not the résumé.
      • Take systems to production on AWS (GCP/Azure where the customer requires it): containerized, observable, and maintainable after we leave.
      • Start from the blueprint, and feed the blueprint. What you learn in the field becomes the baseline the next engagement starts from.

        • Own the outcome

        • Work in a pair with a Forward Deployed Executive who carries the Business Unit’s KPIs. Your work is measured against the same number.
        • Drive adoption. A system the BU routes around has not shipped. Change management is part of the engineering job here, not a phase after it.
        • Be credible with the customer’s engineers, their operators, and their executives — and be willing to disagree with all three.
        • Shape what we commit to before we commit to it. You’ll have the standing to do it, because you’re the one who will build it.

What We Offer:

  • Frontier delivery work across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare
  • The chance to shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment
  • A forward-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside Principal Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers
  • A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them
  • Remote-friendly culture
  • High-impact role with direct visibility to leadership.
  • Strong earning potential with performance-based bonuses.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and cloud solutions.
  • B2B contract model.
  • PTO policy, paid local public holidays.
  • Medical insurance coverage
  • Generous budget for educational opportunities.

How we hire:

    1. Intro conversation — the role, your background, what you want to be doing.
    2. Two live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor. You may use an LLM assistant (ChatGPT, Claude) — how you work now includes these tools. Autocomplete/agentic coding tools are off for these sessions.
    3. The redesign session. We hand you an unfamiliar business function and the constraints of the person who performs it. You have to understand the job well enough to rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. No LLMs for this one.
    4. Team and practice conversation.

The Right Fit Has

Why Join BJAK

  • Define resiliency patterns (health modeling, DLQs, autoscaling) and observability strategies (distributed tracing, structured logging, dashboards).
  • Ensure security-by-design principles, including TLS everywhere, OIDC/JWT authentication, least-privilege IAM, and encryption policies.

  • Lead development of Golang-based services for high-throughput APIs, webhooks, and background processing with robust concurrency and context management.
  • Implement structured logging, error handling, and observability across all services.
  • Design and optimize data models for relational stores (PostgreSQL or equivalent) while enforcing encryption and backup strategies.
  • Implement ORM-based persistence layers using GORM, PrismaORM, or TypeORM for maintainable and secure data access.
  • Architect messaging workflows with queues, event buses, and orchestration frameworks for reliable, at-least-once delivery.
  • Mentor engineers and foster a culture of technical excellence aligned with business objectives.

  • Proficiency in at least one major cloud provider (AWS/GCP/Azure); experience with serverless (Lambda/Functions), container orchestration (ECS/Fargate, Kubernetes), and IaC (CDK/Terraform).

  • Experience with distributed tracing (X-Ray/OpenTelemetry), structured logging, and metrics/alerting pipelines; familiarity with SQS/EventBridge or equivalents (Pub/Sub, Service Bus), DLQs, and workflow engines.
  • Experience with automated pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with GraphQL federation and schema governance.
  • Familiarity with multi-cloud strategies and cost optimization.
  • Background in high-volume data processing and event-driven architecture.

We are currently looking for a Criminal Enforcement Coordinator to join our Criminal Enforcement Unit Function within the Safety & Surveillance group.

This is a permanent full-time opportunity. The role is a home-based role but will require occasional travel to 10 South Colonnade, Canary Wharf London, E14 4PU or South Mimms, Hertfordshire. Please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas.

Who are we?

The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) enhance and improve the health of millions of people every day through the effective regulation of medicines and medical devices, underpinned by science and research.

The Criminal Enforcement Unit (CEU) is the dedicated law enforcement function of the MHRA. Its strategic aim is to reduce and eliminate offences involving medicines and medical devices, protecting public health and maintaining confidence in the UK's regulatory framework.

The Unit investigates serious and organised crime linked to the illegal manufacture, importation and supply of medicines and medical devices, using intelligence-led approaches to identify threats and target those who seek to profit from criminality. We work closely with law enforcement, government, regulatory and international partners to protect the public and safeguard the integrity of the UK's medicines and medical devices supply chains.

The Unit comprises a highly skilled multidisciplinary workforce with experience drawn from policing, Regional Organised Crime Units, the National Crime Agency, intelligence, regulatory enforcement and other specialist disciplines. The CEU consists of seven teams, each reporting to a Grade 7 Senior Manager. These teams are aligned to one of two Commands: Intelligence and Innovation, and Investigation and Disruption. Each is led by a Head of Command, who reports directly to the Deputy Director of Criminal Enforcement.

Working in the CEU offers the opportunity to contribute directly to protecting public health, tackling crime, and making a tangible impact on the safety of patients and the wider public.

What’s the role?

The Criminal Enforcement Coordinator role is a EO grade working within the Bureau and Online team. Their core responsibilities are to:

  • Support activities that prevent, disrupt and reduce medicines and medical devices-related offending.

  • Deliver work to a high professional standard and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

  • Work effectively with colleagues across the Criminal Enforcement Unit and wider Agency to achieve shared objectives.

  • Lead or contribute to projects and initiatives that improve operational effectiveness and organisational performance.

  • Adapt to changing priorities and support different areas of work as required.

Key responsibilities:

jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Principal Architect to lead the design and delivery of complex, multi-domain systems spanning cloud, data, and AI. This role is ideal for a deeply experienced engineer who owns the hardest architectural challenges, sets technical direction, and serves as the senior technical voice on the engagements they support.

In this role, you will operate as the senior technical authority on a cross-functional team, defining architecture across cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and AI/ML workloads. You’ll partner closely with leadership and clients on technical strategy, mentor experienced engineers, and own high-stakes decisions that shape the long-term success of the systems you build.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Define technical strategy and lead architectural design across cloud, data, and AI/ML systems for end-to-end engagements
  • Architect scalable cloud-native solutions, including multi-cloud and hybrid strategies (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes)
  • Design data architectures including warehouses, data lakes, and pipelines for batch and streaming workloads (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Spark, Kafka)
  • Design AI/ML systems including model serving, MLOps pipelines, feature stores, and LLM-based applications (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow, Hugging Face)
  • Define infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and DevOps standards across engagements (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions)
  • Drive performance, scalability, cost, and reliability optimization across deployed systems
  • Ensure architecture meets security, governance, and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Lead cloud migrations and platform modernization initiatives
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Cursor, and other modern AI assistants to ship higher-quality work at pace

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with senior leadership and clients as the principal technical voice on strategy and direction
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders alike
  • Engage closely with engineering, data, AI, and product teams to align architecture with broader business priorities
  • Develop and maintain architecture documentation, standards, and guidelines

Leadership & Influence

  • Define and champion architectural standards and best practices on the engagements you support
  • Mentor experienced engineers and architects, helping them grow their technical judgment and impact
  • Own the most difficult architectural and integration challenges, serving as the senior technical decision-maker
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend tools, frameworks, and patterns that improve architecture over time

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in technical leadership roles
  • Deep expertise in cloud platforms and cloud-native architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Strong background in microservices, serverless, containers, and event-driven systems (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, Lambda, EventBridge)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code and CI/CD (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, GitHub Actions)
  • Strong data architecture expertise across relational, NoSQL, and big data systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, Spark, Kafka)
  • Hands-on experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, dbt)
  • Strong experience designing AI/ML systems for production, including LLMs, MLOps, and model serving (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow)
  • Solid understanding of networking, security, identity, and access management in cloud environments
  • Experience with governance, compliance, and observability frameworks
  • Strong software engineering skills (Python, APIs, containerization)
  • Track record of senior technical leadership and mentoring experienced engineers
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate technical depth across audiences
  • Demonstrable usage of AI-forward tools such as Claude and Cursor
  • Multi-cloud architecture experience, AI ethics or responsible AI experience, or enterprise architecture certifications (e.g., TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP) is a plus

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Experience designing AI/ML solutions that integrate with SAP EAM data structures (e.g., Equipment Masters, Work Orders, or Notifications) via SAP BTP or cloud-native APIs.

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

jobs.excerpt: The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.
jobs.description:
The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary

The Director, Data & AI Platform Engineering leads the engineering strategy, development, delivery, and operational excellence of the enterprise Data & AI Platform. This role combines enterprise technology leadership with the development of high-performing engineering teams spanning data engineering, software engineering, AI/ML platform engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, DataOps, MLOps, and LLMOps.

Working closely with Product, Architecture, Governance, Security, Risk, Enterprise Delivery, Analytics & BI, and AI Product teams, the Director delivers a governed, reusable, self-service platform foundation. This leader is responsible for engineering execution across Foundational Data & AI Products, Integration & Runtime, and the Shared Substrate, with capabilities designed to be defined once, governed once, and consumed by many.

Key Responsibilities:

Engineering Leadership and Team Development

Lead and develop multidisciplinary engineering teams while building a culture of ownership, collaboration, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

  • Coach engineering managers, technical leads, architects, and senior engineers; build succession plans and strengthen leadership capacity.

  • Lead workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, capability development, and talent retention.

  • Establish clear accountability and decision-making across distributed teams and engineering disciplines.

Platform Engineering Strategy and Delivery

Set and execute the engineering strategy for the shared Data & AI Platform in partnership with platform product leadership and architecture.

  • Deliver platform-managed capabilities across Foundational Data & AI Products, Integration & Runtime, and Shared Substrate.

  • Guide engineering investment in canonical data products, the governed context foundation, model and tool gateways, registries, agent runtime, APIs, lakehouse, catalog, compute, storage, and golden-path automation.

  • Balance near-term delivery with platform sustainability, reuse, scalability, and the thin-platform boundary.

Operational Excellence and Governance

Ensure platform services are reliable, secure, observable, supportable, and operated to published service objectives.

  • Establish engineering standards for architecture, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, observability, incident response, resilience, documentation, and operational readiness.

  • Partner with Governance, Security, Risk, and Architecture so policy is technically enforced while architecture pattern-setting remains distinct from policy ownership.

  • Use delivery, reliability, quality, contract-conformance, adoption, and consumer-feedback measures to drive continuous improvement.

Enterprise Partnership and Execution

Build strong partnerships across business, data, AI, product, architecture, governance, and enterprise technology organizations.

  • Communicate engineering priorities, delivery progress, operational health, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to senior stakeholders.

  • Enable self-service golden paths so consumers can build compliant solutions without embedding or waiting on the platform team.

  • Manage capacity, vendors, dependencies, and organizational scaling in alignment with the platform roadmap.

Skills and Background You’ll Need

Education: A Bachelor’s degree is required.

Experience: Minimum 8 – 10 years’ experience within IT and 3+ years’ experience managing IT employees

  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale data, technology, platform, product, or analytics organizations and developing high-performing teams.

  • Strong strategic planning, prioritization, communication, stakeholder partnership, and organizational change leadership skills.

  • Experience operating in a regulated environment with governance, security, privacy, audit, risk, and access-control expectations.

Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate

  • Driving Success: Demonstrates energy and persistence when tackling complex challenges and views difficult problems as opportunities to create value.

  • Winning Together: Builds trust and strong working relationships across teams, values diverse perspectives, and fosters collaboration to achieve shared objectives.

  • Strategic Visioning: Considers future scenarios, opportunities, and risks to develop thoughtful recommendations that align with the company's long-term strategic objectives.

Why Join The Standard?

We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect:

  • A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions

  • An annual incentive bonus plan

  • Generous paid time off including 11 holidays, 2 wellness days, and 8 volunteer hours annually — PTO increases with tenure

  • A supportive, responsive management approach and opportunities for career growth and advancement

  • Paid parental leave and adoption/surrogacy assistance

  • An employee giving program that double matches your donations to eligible nonprofits and schools

In addition to the competitive salary range below, our employee-focused benefits support work-life balance. Learn more about working at The Standard.

Apply Today

Visit GoldMatchHealth.com to submit your application and resume for consideration by our hiring manager. Our team is ready to assist you in taking the next step in your radiology career. jobs.title: Onboarding Analyst, Customer Success
jobs.excerpt: Construction is the second-largest industry in the world—nearly 4x the size of SaaS—yet it still operates without the automated feedback loops that modern software teams rely on.
jobs.description:
Construction is the second-largest industry in the world—nearly 4x the size of SaaS—yet it still operates without the automated feedback loops that modern software teams rely on. Without real-time observability, issues are detected too late, contributing to over $3 Trillion in annual global waste.
Doxel brings computer vision and AI to construction, giving teams real-time visibility into progress, risk, and execution. From hospitals to data centers, and from field leaders to executive teams, Doxel is used every day to support better decisions and faster delivery. Our platform is trusted by industry leaders including Shell, Genentech, HCA Healthcare, Kaiser, Turner, and Layton.
Doxel’s automated progress tracking solution keeps teams aligned with hard facts that leave no ambiguity on where the project is today, where it will be tomorrow and what decisions need to be made to land it on schedule and on budget. This enables our customers to deliver projects, on average, 11% ahead of schedule with up to 16% savings on monthly cash flow.
Backed by Insight Partners and Andreessen Horowitz and with a rapidly growing team of engineers, scientists, construction veterans, and Enterprise go-to-market teams, we're driven to help our customers win.
Join us as we continue our journey to transform the $15T Construction Industry!

The Role

You’ll be the engine that keeps customer onboardings moving. Working directly under Doxel’s senior Enterprise Implementation Manager, you’ll own the coordination layer of implementation: knowing exactly what each onboarding needs, tracking it across the internal teams who supply it, and chasing down the gaps before they slip. When a project stalls because a file is missing or a stakeholder went quiet, you’re the person who catches it first.

This is a hands-on, detail-heavy role for someone who takes pride in making sure nothing falls through the cracks. You’ll start by supporting your manager’s accounts and, as you prove you can reliably drive onboardings to completion, you’ll earn increasing direct ownership of customer relationships and accounts of your own.

If you like seeing the impact of your work in days, not quarters, and you want a clear path to grow into a full implementation role, this is that opportunity.

This role is based remotely on the East Coast, with flexibility to overlap with EMEA hours.

Your Day to Day

  • Own the requirements for each onboarding in your portfolio — know what “done” looks like and track every open item against it
  • Coordinate across the internal teams who supply pieces of each implementation, holding them accountable for deliverables on time
  • Request, arrange, validate, and prepare onboarding files to ensure timely, accurate delivery
  • Track status across multiple concurrent onboardings and surface what’s outstanding, stuck, or at risk before it becomes a problem
  • Flag risks early to your manager with the context needed to act — and propose a path forward, not just the problem
  • Liaise between department stakeholders to keep everyone aligned on project status
  • Support customer-facing communication on assigned accounts, growing into direct ownership as you build trust and judgment
  • Communicate clearly and concisely in writing — email and async updates are the primary way work gets done
  • Spot friction in how onboardings run and bring observations forward to help improve the process

What Success Looks Like

  • Earn increasing ownership of customer-facing accounts as you demonstrate judgment and reliability in driving onboardings to completion
  • Spot friction in how onboardings run and bring recommendations forward to improve the process for the organization
  • Manage multiple concurrent onboardings and customer projects

What You Bring

  • 2+ years in SaaS environment
  • 2+ years in Operations, Support, Project Coordination, Analytics, or similar — with a history of tracking and driving measurable improvements
  • Comfortable holding many threads at once — you can coordinate several workstreams that each depend on other people without losing track of any
  • Process and structure-driven, with a real method for tracking dependencies
  • Curious and quick to learn — you ask good questions, seek to understand the “why,” and pick up new tools and processes quickly
  • Meticulously organized with excellent written communication skills
  • Coachable and self-aware — you take direction well, learn why the system works, and bring your own perspective once you have the context
  • Proactive and self-motivated, you’re a beacon of positivity and enthusiasm
  • High aptitude and willingness to continually learn new technologies
  • Adaptable to ever-evolving processes, with strong personal initiative to execute
  • Comfortable supporting US and EMEA times
  • Travel to our mandatory quarterly business reviews (QBRs) 4X per year and additional travel as needed

Preferred Experience

  • A background or exposure to commercial construction, engineering, and/or design is a big plus
  • Experience supporting SaaS implementations or customer onboarding
  • Familiarity with project coordination, CRM, or customer success tooling
  • Experience with Planhat or other similar CSPs

Benefits & Company Culture

  • Competitive Base Salary + Equity Package
  • Remote first culture (for most roles)
  • Comprehensive Health Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Home Office Stipend
  • Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet
  • Flexible PTO, generous company holiday policy
Doxel is an equal opportunity employer and actively seeks diversity at our company. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

jobs.description:
About Amini

Amini is building the sovereign, AI-native distributed infrastructure stack for the Global South, giving governments and enterprises the data, compute, and connectivity they need to own and govern their digital future, rather than depend on outside platforms. We already work with governments across the southern hemisphere, and our work has been recognised by TIME100 AI, MIT Solve, and the World Economic Forum. We help our partners and customers put AI to work in ways that drive real growth, and make sure that opportunity is shared more equally across the Global South.

Our core values, Collaboration, Trust, Integrity, Humility, and Passion, are at the heart of everything we do. In practice, that means defaulting to sharing credit and information openly, being honest about what we don't yet know, and choosing to admit a mistake early rather than protect an ego.

Our team is small, highly skilled, and non-hierarchical. We recognise the transformational nature of our work, but we stay humble and ego-free about it. We believe in fully using our skills and experience, sharing ideas openly, and making a collective impact, one we intend to grow from the governments and communities we already work with today into a much broader influence on the AI industry and lives across the Global South.

We're 3 years old and at a genuinely pivotal stage. We're a small team, but scaling quickly. Having spent our early years finding real product-market fit, we're now moving into a phase with substantial commercial opportunity ahead of us. Capturing it well isn't just about hiring more people: it's about putting the structure, SOPs, and systems in place that let us consistently deliver exceptional quality products and services to our customers, and ultimately create lasting impact across the Global South. Having proven our model in Barbados, we're now entering a critical scaling phase, moving from project-based delivery to a repeatable, reliable process for deploying across multiple jurisdictions simultaneously.

The role

As PMO Lead, you will be the delivery spine for each country: the single owner of the deployment plan from contract signature through go-live. Without this role, every deployment runs on senior leadership's personal bandwidth. Your job is to change that.

Critically, you are also the person the customer deals with day to day during deployment, managing their expectations, keeping them informed, and making sure the programme feels well-run from their side, not just ours.

You will work at the intersection of our customers, Amini's internal delivery functions (Engineering, Tech, Product,Customer Success), and Commercial, translating a signed contract into a live, working deployment, and then into a repeatable playbook for the next country.

Responsibilities

Delivery Ownership

  • Own the deployment plan end to end for each new country, from contract signature through go-live
  • Act as the single point of accountability for delivery timelines, risks, and status
  • Own the handover points between stages (e.g., contract sign to deployment, deployment to steady-state support) and make sure nothing falls through the cracks

Customer Programme Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for the government customer throughout the deployment, running status updates, managing expectations, and resolving issues before they become escalations
  • Manage scope and changes with the customer directly: knowing what's in the original agreement, what's a reasonable accommodation, and when something needs to be escalated commercially
  • Report deployment status and milestones clearly to both leadership and the customer, on a regular cadence

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate across functions involved in delivery (Engineering/RUN, Hardware, Forward Deployed Engineers, Customer Success) to keep each deployment on track
  • Flag risks and blockers early, with enough lead time for leadership to act
  • Partner with the regional commercial teams (e.g., Caribbean, Africa) to ensure a smooth handover from contract signature into delivery

Process & Playbook Building

  • Build a standard, repeatable delivery playbook so each new country launch gets faster and lower-risk than the last
  • Establish tracking and reporting processes where none currently exist
  • Contribute to Amini's broader shift from heroic individual effort to scalable, distributed execution

What You Will Have: Essential

  • Extensive experience in a programme/project management or delivery management role, ideally owning end-to-end delivery for external customers (not just internal projects)
  • Direct experience managing customer-facing programmes: comfortable being the face of a delivery team to a client, not just coordinating internally
  • Comfortable being the accountable owner for a plan that depends on other functions' work, without formal authority over those teams
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, able to manage expectations and communicate confidently with government or enterprise client stakeholders
  • Strong organisational skills, able to build tracking and reporting processes from scratch
  • Experience working across time zones and with distributed, cross-functional teams
  • Calm under pressure: early deployments will surface things the plan didn't anticipate

What You Will Have: Highly Desirable

  • Experience in infrastructure, telecom, or hardware-adjacent deployments (physical, in-country rollouts rather than pure software launches)
  • Experience supporting government or public-sector customers through onboarding/go-live
  • Experience with sovereign cloud, data residency, or digital public infrastructure (DPI) programmes
  • PMP, PRINCE2, or similar certification
  • Prior work in Global South markets

About DrFirst

For 25 years, DrFirst has empowered providers and patients to achieve better health through intelligent medication management. We improve healthcare workflows and help patients start and stay on therapy with end-to-end solutions that enhance prescription access, affordability, and adherence. Our solutions help 100 million patients a year and are used by more than 420,000 prescribers, 71,000 pharmacies, 270 EHRs and health information systems, and over 2,000 hospitals in the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a successful Healthcare IT company experiencing significant growth. Here you'll get to work with some of the smartest and most interesting people around, solving unique and complex challenges in healthcare on a scale matched by few companies. If you get excited about stretching yourself in new ways, developing yourself to your fullest potential, and care about working with smart colleagues, we want to talk to you!

Position Overview

Backline is DrFirst’s clinical communication, collaboration, and workflow orchestration platform. We are transforming how healthcare teams coordinate care, moving beyond basic clinical communication into intelligent workflow execution and AI-powered clinical assistance. Our mission is to make communication errors, documentation burden, and workflow friction relics of the past. We operate as a small, entrepreneurial business unit within DrFirst, which means you will not be a cog in a machine. You will have a seat at the table, direct impact on what we build and sell, and the opportunity to grow as we grow.

We are looking for someone who wants to own the part of healthcare software that decides whether it actually works: everything after go-live. This is a portfolio role for someone who likes clients and likes systems in equal measure. You will own a group of customer accounts from go-live through renewal and growth. You will get them to real clinical value, keep them there, expand what they use, and turn the best of them into references and referrals.

You will join a team that operates like a startup inside a larger company. Everyone wears multiple hats, we move fast, and we use AI across every part of how we work. You do not need a Customer Success title. Clinical informatics, implementation, EHR support, and hospital operations all translate. We care more about instincts and curiosity than about the length of a resume.

What You Will Learn and How You Will Grow

This role sits at the center of the business. With mentorship from experienced leaders across operations, product, and marketing, you will build skills in clinical workflow design, account growth and renewal strategy in healthcare SaaS, customer health measurement, advocacy and reference development, AI-powered workflow design, and executive communication with clinical and IT leadership. High performers in this role will have a clear path to senior or leadership positions as the business scales.

What you will work on

Customer Onboarding and Activation

  • Partner with Implementations to take new clients from deployment to a working clinical workflow, ensuring each account reaches real adoption, not just a go-live date.
  • Define what success looks like for each customer and hold stakeholders on both sides accountable for getting there.

Adoption, Expansion, and Renewal

  • Track opportunities and account activity in Salesforce and contribute to pipeline and renewal reporting.

Advocacy and Reference Development

  • Capture client outcomes and help turn them into case studies, reference stories, and proof points that help the team sell.
  • Develop reference relationships and generate warm introductions and peer referrals from customers who had a genuinely good experience.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on content, webinars, and campaigns grounded in real client experience.

Product and Clinical Intelligence

  • Serve as the clinical and operational lens on your accounts for Product, Sales, and Marketing, translating what you hear into something the team can act on.
  • Bring recurring customer feedback into roadmap and positioning conversations so what we build reflects what healthcare organizations actually need.
  • Help develop clinical use cases and ROI narratives that demonstrate Backline’s value in language healthcare leaders understand.

AI-Powered Productivity

  • Use AI tools daily for account research, pre-call preparation, QBR content, renewal proposals, and spotting adoption trends in usage data.
  • Build and refine AI workflows that surface signals from transcripts, tickets, and usage data so you stay ahead of issues and opportunities.
  • Stay curious and current on AI developments in healthcare and business productivity, and bring new ideas and tools to the team.
  • Help identify where AI can improve how the team works across onboarding, reporting, and customer engagement.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Nursing, Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent clinical credential or practical experience.
  • Client-facing experience where you were accountable for an outcome you did not fully control. You should know what it feels like to own something.

Programmatic Trader (m/f/d)

Berlin, Bangalore, Remote

Hello👋I am Willian, Trading and Analytics Lead at Kayzen, and I am now looking for a Programmatic Trader to join our team 🙌

About Kayzen

Kayzen is a mobile demand-side platform (DSP) dedicated to democratizing programmatic advertising. We enable leading apps, agencies, media buyers, and brands to run programmatic customer acquisition, retargeting, and brand performance campaigns through our self-serve and managed service options. Built on the three core pillars of performance, transparency, and control, Kayzen powers the world’s best mobile marketing teams with bespoke solutions that fuel business growth and deliver a competitive advantage. With an unprecedented scale of 300B+ daily ad requests from 1.6B+ unique users worldwide, we serve up to 1B+ ads per day in 180 countries. Kayzen is accessible through our APIs and user interface.

The Team

The Trading team is responsible for creating growth through the management and optimization of mobile performance advertising campaigns for clients utilizing the managed service offering. The goal of the team is to deliver on the client's objectives through established or new trading best practices and communicate account status regularly and effectively with their CSM counterparts.

Why this role

This is a hands-on trading role where you'll manage mobile programmatic campaigns across verticals like gaming, fintech, and betting, optimizing toward CPA/ROAS targets while learning to scale efficiently. You'll work closely with senior traders and cross-functional partners, gaining exposure to advanced analytics, LLM-powered workflows, and trading strategies that go well beyond what most desks offer at this level. If you're analytical, curious about automation, and want to accelerate your programmatic career, this is the role for you.

What you’ll do

Trading excellence

  • Manage day-to-day campaign optimization across a set of advertisers; monitor and hit KPI targets (CPA, ROAS, retention) with guidance from senior traders.
  • Execute supply-side and audience optimization tactics including publisher management, bid adjustments, and dayparting across ad formats (banner, video, native, CTV).
  • Run A/B tests on bids, budgets, creatives, and geos as part of broader testing roadmaps; document results and contribute learnings to the Trading Playbook.
  • Monitor pacing and budget allocation daily, flagging risks and under-delivery proactively.
  • Build a working understanding of mobile attribution (postback flows, attribution windows, MMP integrations) and how attribution models affect how we measure and optimize campaign performance.

Analytics & automation

  • Use SQL to pull and analyze campaign data from internal databases; build comfort with joins, CTEs, and window functions over time.
  • Learn to leverage LLMs (GPT/Claude) for recurring analyses, data briefs, and performance diagnostics, this is a core part of how our team works.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of dashboards and reporting tools used by the trading team.
  • Develop your analytical instincts: learn to ask the right questions, understand what's driving performance, and use available tools (SQL, AI, BI tools) to find answers.

Cross-functional impact

  • Work with CSMs to understand client goals and communicate campaign status clearly.
  • Support QBR preparation and client-facing deliverables alongside senior traders.
  • Collaborate with Product Support to troubleshoot delivery issues and with Supply on inventory quality questions.

Since I am based in Argentina and other key product and customer success team members are located mostly across EMEA and India, we are open to a remote setup of this position. For optimal overlap with customers’ time zones and internal teams your main working location should preferably be close to the CET time zone.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of programmatic ad buying, ad operations, or adjacent adtech experience.
  • Familiarity with MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular) and attribution concepts; hands-on experience preferred.
  • Analytical mindset; basic SQL ability or a demonstrated willingness to learn quickly.
  • Curiosity about AI and automation — you don't need to be an expert, but you should be excited to use LLMs as part of your daily workflow.
  • Nice-to-have: Any exposure to Python, CTV/OTT, or mobile in-app DSP platforms.
  • Solution-oriented with a bias toward action.
  • Clear communicator who's comfortable asking questions and collaborating across teams.

What do we offer?

  • Competitive compensation with a performance-based component
  • Exceptional career growth and learning possibilities — you'll be mentored by experienced traders and exposed to advanced workflows (LLMs, ClickHouse, audience strategy) earlier than at most organizations
  • A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs who bring massive change to the Adtech market
  • A high degree of responsibility and independence
  • Direct, day-to-day work with the management
  • A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Germany, India, Argentina, Ukraine, Spain, the UK and many more countries
  • A flexible work-from-home arrangement
  • A 500-dollar home-office setup budget
  • A 1000-dollar annual learning and development budget
