jobs.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

Job Description

Sprinklr is seeking a dynamic and people‑centric Director of Solution Consulting to lead a regional team of Solutions Consultants (SCs). This role focuses on developing talent, supporting strategic opportunities, ensuring high‑quality customer engagements, and partnering cross‑functionally to deliver customer value.

As a Director, you will coach SCs in their day‑to‑day activities, support key deals, and ensure that the team is equipped with the right skills, messaging, and technical depth to represent the Sprinklr Unified‑CXM platform. You will serve as a trusted partner to Sales, Product, Post‑Sales, and Marketing, ensuring strong alignment and consistent execution across the go‑to‑market motion.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Solutions Consultants, supporting career growth, skills development, and onboarding.

  • Conduct regular coaching sessions, field observations, and performance feedback.

  • Ensure SCs are proficient in relevant industry use cases, Sprinklr capabilities, and new product enhancements.

  • Support hiring efforts to build a diverse, high‑performing SC team.

Deal Support & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with sales teams to qualify, shape, and support customer opportunities.

  • Serve as a strategic solutions advisor on high‑priority deals, guiding SCs on discovery, solution design, demos, and value articulation.

  • Help teams position the value of unified customer experience management and Sprinklr’s differentiated platform capabilities.

  • Act as a solutions sponsor for select accounts when additional executive presence is needed.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with the Director of Solution Consulting to drive regional GTM strategy and operational excellence.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to ensure alignment on messaging, positioning, and solution strategies.

  • Provide structured feedback to product managers and engineering teams based on field learnings, customer requirements, and competitive insights.

  • Participate in product interlock processes to support product roadmap discussions and feature prioritization.

Operational Excellence & Enablement

  • Support team readiness by organizing training sessions, sharing best practices, and developing reusable assets.

  • Help improve SC processes, playbooks, and methodologies to drive consistency and impact.

  • Contribute to SC onboarding and enablement programs, ensuring a strong, efficient experience for new hires.

  • Initiate and support projects that enhance the SC organization’s capabilities, tools, or workflows.

Thought Leadership & Market Awareness

  • Maintain awareness of emerging trends in AI, conversational technologies, unified customer experience management, and social, marketing, and service technologies.

  • Coach SCs on how to translate these trends into customer‑relevant insights and solution narratives.

  • Represent the SC team at internal sessions, regional events, and customer workshops as needed.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6–10+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, or a similar presales role in an enterprise software environment.

  • 5+ years of people management experience

  • Strong track record of supporting enterprise deals and delivering value‑driven customer engagements.

  • Strong leadership and coaching skills with the ability to mentor and develop technical talent.

  • Experience with complex system design, enterprise architecture fundamentals, and integrations.

  • Familiarity with AI concepts, data architecture, APIs, and modern SaaS platform technologies.

  • Excellent presentation, communication, and storytelling skills.

  • Ability to influence cross‑functional teams and collaborate in a matrixed environment.

  • Experience facilitating or contributing to discovery workshops, solution design sessions, or human‑centric design approaches (preferred but not required).

What Success Looks Like

  • A high‑performing, engaged SC team that consistently delivers quality customer engagements.

  • Strong alignment with Sales and Product, resulting in clearer messaging, higher win rates, and improved customer outcomes.

  • Scalable processes, tools, and best practices adopted across the region.

  • Team members who grow their skills, confidence, and career paths under your leadership.

Please note: We are unable to consider applicants who require visa sponsorship or work authorization support for this role. Candidates must have current and unrestricted work authorization in the country where the role is based.

We focus on our mission: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

  • Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

  • Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.

  • Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

We believe in our product: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

$161,000 - $269,000

jobs.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

ROLE OVERVIEW
The Intake Coordinator plays a vital role in assisting new patients to establish care with a LifeStance provider. This position is responsible for scheduling initial assessments, collecting necessary demographic, verifying insurance eligibility, and managing referrals and clinical history to appropriately match patients with the most suitable providers. The Intake Coordinator facilitates the initial stages of client engagement and must possess excellent interpersonal skills.

HOURLY PAY: $19.50- 21.50 Hourly

LOCATION: Remote

Shift by time zone:

8:30am - 5:00pm PST

9:30a- 6:00p MST

10:30am - 7pm CST

11:30am-8:00pm EST

RESPONSIBILITIES
Intake Department Interactions:

  • Efficiently handle communications via phone (inbound and outbound), email, voicemail, faxes, and chat.

  • Identify and communicate patient trends and feedback, including scheduling barriers to Intake.

  • Interact with Practice Operations team as necessary to ensure proper patient matching.

New Patient Assistance:

  • Conduct thorough intake assessments to understand patient needs and match them with the most appropriate provider.

  • Schedule initial appointments promptly and accurately with detail outlining patients’ needs including talk therapy and/or medication management.

  • Collect patient insurance information and run eligibility ensuring in-network benefits for matched provider.

  • Obtain and verify patient clinical history, demographic details, insurance information, and eligibility.

  • Collect credit card for file and maintain compliance.

  • Assist new patients with portal setup and new patient paperwork.

  • Process and manage referral paperwork efficiently.

Other:

  • Ensure all patient interactions and transactions are accurately documented in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system.

  • Proactively contact referral source, patient, and/or provider office to obtain additional information that is required to complete verification of benefits and/or prior authorizations.

  • Contact existing patients to initiate new services based on internal and external referrals.

  • Assist new patient with any questions regarding new patient appointments or referrals.

  • Professionally and calmly assist with incoming emergency calls as appropriate and follow crisis call protocols.

  • Perform additional tasks and responsibilities as assigned by management to support the overall efficiency of the intake department.

  • Adhere to all relevant policies, regulations, and compliance standards throughout the intake process including HIPAA and PCI.

COMPENTENCIES & SKILLS

  • Adaptability: Quickly learn and adapt to the intake department’s processes and technology, including Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, appointment scheduling tools, and contact center systems.

  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with patients, providers, and referral sources.

  • Organizational Skills: Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

  • Customer Service: A patient-centric approach with a strong commitment to providing exceptional customer service. empathy and compassion.

  • Problem-Solving: Ability to handle complex situations and make informed decisions to resolve issues efficiently.

  • Detailed Oriented: Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and completeness in all tasks.

  • Team Player: Collaborative attitude with the ability to work well in a team-oriented environment.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree preferred.

  • 2+ years of experience in a contact center environment and/or healthcare environment.

  • Strong computer proficiency with knowledge of Microsoft Office, Internet, and Email.

  • Prior experience working with Electronic Health Record systems (EHRs), preferred.

  • Clear understanding of insurance-related terminology.

  • Fluent in English, required and a professional working proficiency, in Spanish may be required.

  • Quiet, distraction free, dedicated HIPAA compliant workspace in your remote office with high-speed hard-wired internet access.

  • Must be able to multi-task and prioritize work in a fast-paced work environment.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

LifeStance provides the compensation range and benefits that it in good faith believes it might pay and/or offer for this position. LifeStance reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, or federal law.

LifeStance is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are fully committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all our employees. Learn more about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at LifeStance.

LifeStance Health complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. Inquiries regarding applications, resumes and applicant status should not be sent to this email address as they will not be reviewed or responded to. To apply for a position, please use our official careers page.

jobs.title: Record Your Daily Routine & Get Paid - AI Training
jobs.excerpt: This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job.
jobs.description:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world

jobs.description:
Enterprise ServiceNow Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Enterprise ServiceNow Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Enterprise ServiceNow Architect to define and lead the architecture of our enterprise data platform, spanning ingestion, storage, processing, governance, and consumption layers. The role drives the strategic direction of data infrastructure, sets standards for data modeling and lifecycle management, and partners with data engineering, analytics, ML, and business stakeholders to deliver a coherent, scalable data foundation. The ideal candidate combines deep technical mastery of modern data platforms with strong architectural judgment, and has led data-platform programs of meaningful scope and complexity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the target-state architecture of the enterprise data platform, including ingestion, storage, processing, and consumption layers.
  • Establish standards for data modeling, schema evolution, partitioning, file formats, and storage organization.
  • Architect lakehouse, warehouse, and streaming patterns leveraging technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi.
  • Design end-to-end data pipelines that balance latency, cost, reliability, and maintainability across batch and streaming workloads.
  • Lead the integration of governance, lineage, and catalog tools such as Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Unity Catalog, or DataHub.
  • Define security architecture including row- and column-level controls, masking, encryption, and identity-aware access patterns.
  • Partner with ML, BI, and product teams to ensure platform capabilities align with downstream consumption needs.
  • Establish data contract and data product principles to drive ownership, quality, and decoupling between producers and consumers.
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide guidance on pipeline and warehouse design proposals across teams.
  • Drive cost optimization and capacity planning across the data platform estate.
  • Design disaster recovery, multi-region, and high-availability strategies for critical data assets.
  • Mentor data engineers and architects on platform standards and emerging best practices.
  • Produce architecture artifacts including context diagrams, decision records, and reference patterns.
  • Stay current with data platform research, vendor offerings, and open-source ecosystem developments.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in data engineering, with significant time in architecture roles.
  • Deep expertise across at least two major data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift.
  • Strong understanding of lakehouse architectures, modern table formats, and streaming systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Spark, Flink, or Kafka at production scale.
  • Strong data modeling expertise across dimensional, normalized, and data-vault patterns.
  • Experience implementing governance, lineage, and catalog capabilities.
  • Solid grasp of cloud platforms, networking, identity, and cost optimization.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Track record of leading large data platform initiatives across teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with data mesh or data product architectures.
  • Familiarity with semantic layers such as dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, or LookML.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with strict data residency or audit requirements.
  • Cloud or platform certifications (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Public talks or writing on data architecture.

jobs.title: Senior Freelance Consultant, AI Safety
jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote Engagement type: Consultancy, project-based.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Engagement type: Consultancy, project-based. Starting ASAP.

Moonshot is seeking a Senior Freelance Consultant to support the delivery of our AI Safety portfolio. This is a hands on, technical engagement focused on red teaming, adversarial evaluation, and methodological development across harm categories including pathways to violence, extremism, child sexual exploitation, abuse and grooming (CSEA), mental health and crisis, and risks affecting children and teenagers.

The consultant will work closely with Moonshot's AI Safety team to design and execute evaluation frameworks, test scenarios, and scoring criteria, translating violence prevention, safeguarding, and behavioural risk expertise into structured, testable outputs suitable for technical and policy audiences.

This role does not include client relationship management, team leadership, or business development responsibilities. The focus is on the technical and methodological work itself, and all work must be delivered within a clear ethical framework, in compliance with contractual, legal, data protection, and ethics obligations.

What the work involves

Engagements vary, but may involve:

  • Red teaming and adversarial evaluation of AI systems against defined harm categories.
  • Reviewing model responses against harm and risk criteria and providing expert judgement.
  • Bringing subject matter expertise to a specific harm area, such as grooming and CSEA, radicalisation pathways, crisis signalling, or teen online safety.
  • Supporting the design of evaluation frameworks that translate real world harm knowledge into structured, testable criteria.
  • Contributing to the design of intervention logic that connects at risk users to appropriate support.
  • Drafting methodology or findings suitable for technical and government audiences.

Requirements

Essential:

  • Experience in trust and safety, online harms, or a closely related field such as violence prevention, safeguarding, or public health, with the ability to apply that knowledge to AI systems.
  • Demonstrated experience designing research, evaluation frameworks, or interventions for harm categories such as violent extremism, CSEA, self-harm and crisis, or targeted violence.
  • The ability to translate real world knowledge of how a harm works into a way of testing whether an AI system handles it safely.
  • Comfort and demonstrated resilience working with highly sensitive or graphic content (violence, extremist material, crisis content), with awareness of wellbeing practices for this kind of work.
  • Strong written communication, able to produce credible, non promotional material for technical and government audiences.
  • Sound judgement working with ambiguity and sensitive material.
  • Availability for a close to full time commitment over approximately 6 weeks.
  • Willingness to undertake relevant security clearance procedures if required by the engagement.

Desirable, genuine depth in one or more of the following:

  • Model safety, red teaming, or adversarial evaluation of LLMs or other AI systems.
  • Understanding of LLM architecture, safety tooling, or trust and safety policy.
  • Child safety evaluation, teen safety product work, or grooming and CSEA detection.
  • Intervention or diversion programme design that can transfer to AI mediated interventions.
  • Government or regulatory engagement, such as briefing officials or supporting policy submissions.
  • An academic or applied background in radicalisation studies, forensic psychology, or violence risk assessment.
  • Taxonomy or classifier development, including how testing data feeds a classifier.

Benefits

As a consultant, you will have:

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Opportunity to work on diverse, impactful projects.
  • Competitive consultancy rates.
  • Remote working options available.

We welcome expressions of interest across a range of experience levels, from established specialists to people earlier in their careers who bring real depth in a relevant area.

Send us your CV and a short statement of interest, no more than one page. Your statement should set out the experience you'd bring from the areas above, and the harm categories or methods you have the most depth in.

jobs.excerpt: The Department Head provides strategic and operational leadership for the academic department, guiding its faculty, programs, and initiatives toward excellence while shaping the department’s vision and fostering a shared understanding of faculty success through leading efforts in faculty workload planning, scheduling, and performance.
jobs.description:
The Department Head provides strategic and operational leadership for the academic department, guiding its faculty, programs, and initiatives toward excellence while shaping the department’s vision and fostering a shared understanding of faculty success through leading efforts in faculty workload planning, scheduling, and performance. The position's main accountability is faculty success while also contributing to student and curriculum success. In collaboration with faculty and administrative teams, the Department Head ensures effective scheduling, facilitates faculty contracts, addresses faculty concerns, and supports continuous growth and faculty development.


Department Heads are in 12-month, ranked, career-track (not eligible for tenure) positions with core duties to teach asynchronous undergraduate and graduate courses to adult learners; lead development of programs and courses and supervision/mentorship of associate faculty; and service to students and the institution to ensure its continued improvement toward its critical student success goals. At the heart of our institution is a deep commitment to a Culture of Care—an ethos that emphasizes proactive, compassionate, and responsive engagement to ensure every student feels supported and empowered to succeed. UAGC programs are intentionally designed to bridge academic learning and workforce relevance, equipping students with both practical skills and disciplinary expertise that prepare them for meaningful career advancement and lifelong learning.


Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.


Duties and Responsibilities:


Administrative Service


  • Collaboratively creates a vision and shared aims for the department.
  • Supports college leaders in developing relationships with external partnerships and relationships.
  • Reviews departmental success metrics through the lens of faculty outcomes and creates a strategy for continuous improvement.
  • Develops, organizes, and monitors outcomes of faculty success initiatives.
  • Mentors and supports faculty in helping them achieve their goals and desired career outcomes.
  • Engages in and organizes regular review of faculty teaching quality and development plans.
  • Supports and contributes to curriculum success initiatives and strategic plans at the divisional level.
  • Attends and actively participates in department, college, and university meetings.
  • Engages in shared governance activities and committees.
  • Work with faculty to create contracts and establish workload.
  • Oversees faculty scheduling in the department.
  • Leads search and hiring committees and makes departmental hiring decisions.
  • Works with college leadership to create and monitor the departmental budget.
  • Oversees program review, accreditation, and licensure efforts.

Learning Leadership


The UAGC online educational model is built around a "quality at scale" approach, in which a centralized, expertly designed curriculum ensures consistency, rigor, and excellence across all course sections. All faculty teach from a shared course shell, allowing them to focus on delivering high-impact instruction and individualized support.


  • Develop and improve courses and innovative teaching practices in collaboration with instructional designers, assessment specialists, and other experts.
  • Implement ideas and initiatives focused on enhancing student learning and success outcomes related to UAGC's institutional goals (retention completion, and value).
  • Develop and improve course materials including texts, media, assessment tools, and other innovative instructional modalities.
  • Review, support, and mentor instructional quality of associate faculty.
  • Leads continuous improvement of curriculum and instructional design, with a focus on relevance, rigor, and accessibility.
  • Leads and supports the department in coordinating efforts with student success, student affairs, library, writing center, access and wellness, academic advising, and career services to create, monitor, and improve initiatives for a holistic student support experience.
  • Monitors, organizes, and reports on initiatives related to students’ sense of connection to the university in an online environment.

Teaching


Department Heads demonstrate a passion for helping students achieve their goals, applying disciplinary and professional knowledge in effective practices in teaching, assessment, and student engagement for online, asynchronous courses.


  • Deliver high-quality, engaging online instruction.
  • Connect the learning experience to workforce skills and professional advancement.
  • Foster a supportive learning environment for adult learners.
  • Prioritize student learning, achievement, and timely feedback.
  • Maintain strong communication with students and respond promptly to inquiries.
  • Ensure academic integrity and uphold university policies.
  • Collaborate with academic support teams to enhance student experience.

Additional Information:


  • Distribution and expectations of duties, including teaching load, vary annually depending on department needs.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:


  • Ability to provide visionary and strategic leadership to guide academic programs and faculty toward institutional excellence
  • Skill in managing faculty workload planning, performance evaluation, and development within an online workforce academic environment
  • Ability to oversee complex academic operations, including course scheduling, faculty contracts, and resource allocation, with precision and fairness
  • Strong organizational and decision-making skills to support the efficient and responsive operation of academic departments
  • Ability to build and sustain collaborative relationships across faculty, program leadership, and administrative teams
  • Skill in resolving faculty concerns and promoting a healthy and productive academic environment.
  • Knowledge of best practices in teaching and learning, including curriculum development assessment strategies, especially in virtual environments.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a capacity to foster student engagement and clarity in a remote learning context.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines and balance competing responsibilities within a flexible, evolving work environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead programmatic initiatives, mentor faculty, and foster continuous improvement.
  • Knowledge of scaling innovative teaching practices and supporting holistic student development in online learning environments.

Minimum Qualifications:


  • Earned doctorate degree in a discipline aligned with the academic program.
  • Experience in academic leadership, including faculty development, curriculum oversight, or departmental operations.
  • Evidence of experience demonstrating adequate training, depth of knowledge in a particular specialty, and capacity to undertake high-quality teaching and service.
  • A collaborative and student-centered approach to leadership and instructional support.
  • Experience contributing to a strategic vision, increased student success, and growth preferred.
  • Experience contributing to or leading strategic planning and implementation in academic programs.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Applied professional experience in the field.
  • Experience teaching in on-ground and online higher education, including experience in faculty development, instructional design, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience working with adult, non-traditional, post-traditional learners.

jobs.title: Designer de Processos BPM (Camunda)
jobs.excerpt: Principais responsabilidades• Ser responsável pelo desenho de orquestração ponta a ponta para workflows complexos (fluxos principais + fluxos de exceção) utilizando BPMN.
jobs.description:
Principais responsabilidades

  • Ser responsável pelo desenho de orquestração ponta a ponta para workflows complexos (fluxos principais + fluxos de exceção) utilizando BPMN.
  • Traduzir intenções de negócio em desenhos de processos executáveis, considerando a realidade de sistemas distribuídos (timeouts, retries, idempotência, falhas parciais e consistência eventual).
  • Definir limites do processo, condições de início/fim, estados-chave e padrões de interação (mensagens, sinais, timers, escalonamentos e compensações).
  • Produzir e manter um pacote conciso de Design de Processo para cada iniciativa (narrativa do processo, diagramas BPMN, estratégia de exceções, modelo de variáveis e requisitos de observabilidade).
  • Facilitar workshops de desenho com stakeholders de negócio/operações e engenharia; questionar e esclarecer requisitos até que o fluxo esteja coerente e testável.
  • Estabelecer e garantir padrões e boas práticas de modelagem (convenções de nomenclatura, estrutura de subprocessos e templates reutilizáveis) em conjunto com o chapter de Camunda.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com engenheiros para garantir que o desenho seja implementado corretamente e permaneça legível e evolutivo.
  • Definir e validar a prontidão operacional: monitoramento/alertas, SLIs/SLOs quando aplicável, fluxos de tratamento de incidentes e KPIs do processo.

O que estamos buscando?

Qualificações obrigatórias

  • Experiência comprovada no desenho de workflows utilizando BPMN 2.0 (ou ferramentas equivalentes de orquestração/modelagem de processos) em ambientes reais de entrega.
  • Forte entendimento de orquestração em sistemas distribuídos: retries, timeouts, idempotência, tratamento de erros e padrões de compensação/saga.
  • Experiência colaborando com times multidisciplinares: produto, operações, arquitetura e engenharia de software.
  • Capacidade de comunicar desenhos de forma clara (diagramas + narrativa) e conduzir alinhamentos entre stakeholders.
  • Conforto para atuar em ambientes regulados, de alta disponibilidade, com forte governança e necessidades de auditoria.

Qualificações desejáveis

  • Experiência prática com Camunda 8 (Zeebe), incluindo modelagem voltada para execução e operação.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos, padrões de mensageria e desenho de integração via APIs.
  • Familiaridade com observabilidade e operação de workflows (ex.: triagem de incidentes, dashboards de monitoramento e KPIs de processo).
  • Experiência no setor bancário/financeiro ou outros domínios corporativos complexos.
  • Experiência definindo bibliotecas reutilizáveis de padrões de processo e orientando times sobre boas práticas de modelagem.
  • Inglês fluente, escrito e falado (mínimo C1).

Soft skills

  • Capacidade de lidar com mudanças e imprevisibilidade;
  • Espírito colaborativo;
  • Perfil energético, motivado e determinado;
  • Visão pragmática e orientada a resultados;
  • Adaptabilidade para diferentes responsabilidades técnicas;
  • Excelente capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;
  • Produtividade e boa gestão do tempo;
  • Forte comunicação verbal e escrita.

Como será medido o sucesso

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionSprout Social is looking to hire a Senior Financial Reporting Analyst to join the Finance team.
jobs.description:
Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire a Senior Financial Reporting Analyst to join the Finance team.

Why join Sprout’s Finance team?

As a member of Sprout’s finance team, you’ll help better position Sprout for future growth while maintaining compliance and integrity at the highest level. No matter your role, everyone on the team has the opportunity to be a part of creating best-in-class processes and practices that can scale with the organization. Our team is unique because we value transparency and direct ownership of responsibilities—meaning, you’ll always have our trust to help contribute to our overall goals and success as a department and organization.

What you’ll do

  • Assist in the preparation of Sprout’s SEC filings, such as 8-Ks, 10-Qs and 10-Ks, including the associated XBRL tagging requirements
  • Prepare financial statements, footnotes, MD&A, and other disclosures in accordance with U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements
  • Create underlying workpapers and analyses to support the company’s disclosures and prepare the disclosure checklist
  • Work cross-functionally with various stakeholders, including Legal, Investor Relations, Finance and Accounting, in order to complete Sprout’s SEC filings
  • Ensure SOX compliance throughout our financial reporting and related processes
  • Interface with external auditors and facilitate their procedures over Sprout’s SEC filings
  • Perform ad hoc disclosure benchmarking research of peer group companies
  • Prepare share-based compensation entries and reconciliation for month-end close and provide equity-related analysis
  • Utilize artificial intelligence to enhance Sprout’s financial reporting and technical accounting processes
  • Participate in other technical accounting and SEC reporting workstreams and ad hoc projects

What you’ll bring

We are looking for an individual who is self-motivated with strong attention to details, proven ability to work both independently and cross-functionally and drive to take on new challenges. If you have a background in financial reporting and are passionate about delivering quality results and driving continual improvement in a dynamic, high-growth environment, we’d love to talk to you!

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent business degree
  • 2-5+ years of relevant industry or public accounting experience

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • CPA license or actively working towards obtaining license
  • Understanding of U.S. GAAP and SEC disclosure and reporting requirements
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with an ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization
  • Experience with SEC reporting software a plus (e.g. Workiva)

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Experiencing Sprout’s in-depth onboarding, covering everything from our company mission and values, hearing directly from executives and founders, to deep training on our products and the value that Sprout delivers to our customers
  • Making a plan with your manager to set initial priorities, aligning on expectations for your role, planting goalposts for your career, and learning about Sprout’s approach to scaling key business operations to support a high-growth NASDAQ publicly traded company

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Being proficient in using Sprout’s accounting system (NetSuite) in order to retrieve data needed to prepare financial reporting
  • Becoming proficient in Workiva in order to prepare the required external filings, such as the 10-Q and 10-K.
  • Obtaining a broad understanding of Sprout’s financial reporting process and timelines
  • Preparing financial statements, footnotes and other disclosures for Sprout’s external filings
  • Building connections with business partners and finance teammates

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Taking on additional responsibility over the financial reporting process, including interfacing with the external auditors and preparing the quarterly close and reporting calendar
  • Work with key business partners, such as legal and investor relations, on filings and disclosure updates
  • Research and remain up-to-date on current accounting pronouncements that could affect the company and work with the team to ensure new items are incorporated correctly.
  • Having your first performance conversation with your manager, where you’ll discuss your accomplishments in your role and work together to build goals for your professional growth

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Being able drive the completion of Sprout’s 10-Q and 10-K filings and preparation of the underlying schedules and support for the company’s disclosures
  • Having a strong understanding over the company’s disclosures and reporting requirements
  • Working effectively with business partners on SEC filings and other initiatives
  • Making recommendations on process improvements
  • Assisting in other ad hoc projects on an as needed basis
  • Surprising us! You’ll use your unique ideas and abilities to change your team in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

However, we are not set up in all states, so please look at the drop-down box in our application to see whether your state is listed. Few roles require an office setting. About Rosie's People

We provide strategic People advisory, organisational consulting, operational HR & business support, leadership and management development, coaching, talent solutions and executive recruitment.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your CV/resume together with a cover letter explaining why you believe you would be a strong addition to the Rosie's People consultant network.

Within your cover letter, please answer the following six mandatory questions.

Applications that do not answer all six questions will not be considered.

1. Location, Right to Work & Delivery Availability
Where are you currently based, where do you have the right to work, and which locations could you reasonably support in person? Please also confirm whether you deliver in person, virtually or both.

2. Recent Training, L&D or Coaching Experience
Please describe up to three relevant projects or assignments you have worked on within the last three years. For each, briefly explain the client or organisation type, what you were engaged to do, your personal role in the project, the audience you supported and the outcome.

3. Programme Design & Delivery
Please give one example of a training, learning or development programme that you personally designed, co-designed and/or delivered from beginning to end. What did you personally create or deliver, how was the programme structured, and how did you or the client assess whether it had been successful?

4. Qualifications, Coaching & Industry Experience
Please list your relevant training, L&D, facilitation, organisational development and/or coaching qualifications and professional accreditations. If you provide professional coaching, please include your coaching qualification/accreditation and professional body. Please also list the industries or sectors in which you have delivered training, development or coaching professionally.

5. Consultancy Availability & Rates
What project capacity could you typically make available to Rosie's People, and how quickly could you mobilise for a new assignment? Please provide your expected hourly, half-day and full-day consultancy rates, excluding applicable taxes, and confirm whether reasonable preparation and customisation are included within those rates.

Applications stating market rate, negotiable, dependent on scope, what's the budget? or similar responses will not be considered.

6. AI, Learning Technology & Systems
Please list the AI tools, learning platforms, collaboration tools and productivity software you use professionally. Next to each, rate your competency as:

Beginner | Intermediate | Expert | Never Used

About the Opportunity

Successful applicants may be added to Rosie's People's approved consultant network and considered for client assignments as requirements arise.

Depending on the assignment, you may be asked to design, develop, facilitate and/or deliver learning and development interventions, provide individual or group coaching, support wider organisational-development projects, or contribute specialist expertise as part of a broader Rosie's People client engagement.

Some assignments may involve delivering an established programme or framework. Others may require you to work with the client and us to understand a particular organisational need and develop an appropriate intervention.

You may work independently on some assignments and alongside other Rosie's People consultants on others. In either case, we expect consultants to work within the agreed client scope, maintain appropriate communication, protect confidentiality and escalate issues appropriately.

  • Have demonstrable experience working with managers, leaders and/or professional populations.
  • Can evidence personally designing, developing and delivering high-quality learning or development interventions.

  • Are confident facilitating interactive sessions and responding appropriately to questions, challenge and discussion.

Important

Joining the Rosie's People consultant network does not constitute an offer or guarantee of work, minimum hours or a particular client assignment.

Consultants are considered for assignments according to the client's requirements, relevant expertise and industry experience, location, availability, delivery style, client/cultural fit and agreed commercial terms.

We are looking for a Head of Finance & Operations to lead the organizational backbone that enables OET to scale effectively and sustainably.

This is a role with broad accountability, not an expectation that one person does everything. While we expect a hands-on leader, you will lead a lean internal team and coordinate project leads, technical colleagues and external specialists across areas such as accounting, tax, legal, IT, information security and data protection.

You will have significant freedom to shape the team, systems and external-support model as OET grows. Important is that you enjoy building better organizations: creating clarity, improving systems, solving problems and helping colleagues make good decisions.

🛠️ What you will own

Finance & project control

  3. Ensure reliable accounting, payroll, banking, tax, statutory reporting and audits together with internal colleagues and external advisors.
  4. Partner with the CEO and project leads on proposal budgets, contracts, pricing, indirect-cost recovery and major financial decisions.
  5. Provide clear financial analysis that helps leadership and project teams make sound decisions.

Business operations & systems

  1. Own core business administration, including contracts, procurement, vendors, insurance, policies and recurring corporate obligations.
  2. Develop and improve OET's finance and business systems, including ERP, project accounting, reporting, workflows and automation.
  3. Establish a scalable internal IT support function covering employee support, access and account management, onboarding and offboarding, business software and vendor coordination.
  4. Ensure information security, data protection, organizational risk and business-continuity activities are appropriately managed together with specialist colleagues and external advisors.
  5. Identify operational bottlenecks and build pragmatic solutions that work for a growing, fully remote organization.

Team & organization

  • Lead and develop a lean team across Finance, People Operations and administration.
  • Set clear responsibilities and ensure important operational work is coordinated and completed.
  • Decide what should be handled internally, automated or supported by specialist external providers.
  • Work closely with the CEO and other leaders to continuously strengthen OET's operating model..

✅ What you bring

We are looking for someone with:

  • Significant experience in finance, accounting, controlling or finance-led business operations.
  • Strong experience with project accounting, restricted funds, grants or contract-funded work.
  • Broad business-administration experience beyond finance, for example across systems, vendors, contracts, organizational processes or people operations.
  • Experience building or substantially improving finance and operational systems in a growing organization.
  • Confidence working with accountants, auditors, banks, software providers and other professional advisors.
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn financial and operational information into clear decisions.
  • Experience leading people and creating effective teams.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, high integrity and comfort working in a remote, asynchronous organization.

You do not need to be an expert in every operational discipline. We value the ability to establish ownership, work effectively with specialists and ensure outcomes are delivered.

💎 Bonus Points For:

  • Knowledge of German accounting, tax or non-profit administration.

✨ Why OET

This role offers:

  1. Real influence: You will report directly to the CEO and play an important role in organizational and financial decisions.

jobs.description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2024, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good.

We operate scaling businesses the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our amazing team is based in Australia, the UK, the Philippines, China, and the US. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

As our AR & AP Lead, you’ll be the eyes and ears of our Number Scrunchers accounting function — driving accounts receivable and accounts payable operations day to day, in close partnership with your two direct reports (our AR Expert and AP Coordinator) and the wider Financial Operations team. You’ll keep our books accurate, our customers paying on time, and our suppliers paid on time, all so we can maximise the donations we’re able to make.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Pulled together the monthly AR ageing report for the CFO and exec team, with a clear plan to chase down aged amounts
  • Reviewed the weekly payments file (including the Tipalti funding summary) before it went out for approval
  • Flagged an “at risk” customer account early and looped in the customer-facing team for support
  • Helped close the books accurately and on time at month-end, escalating one risk early to the Head of Financial Operations
  • Worked with the AP Coordinator to tidy up a clunky step in the AP process

Let’s talk about you

Detail is your love language

You get real satisfaction from a reconciliation that ties out perfectly and a report that lands on the CFO’s desk without a single follow-up question. You’re equally comfortable rolling your sleeves up in the detail of a customer account and stepping back to build the KPIs and reporting that keep the whole team honest.

Calm under a closing calendar

Month-end doesn’t rattle you. You know how to keep AR and AP on track to a deadline, spot a risk early enough to actually do something about it, and communicate clearly with stakeholders when something needs to change.

A coach as much as a doer

You lead a small, tight-knit team and genuinely enjoy it — you give clear, kind feedback, help your people grow, and aren’t afraid of a difficult conversation when a process or a stakeholder relationship needs a repair job.

You give a crap. Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

Head of Products

About Us

Flui Technologies is a leading software solution provider to the energy and water sector, delivering innovative and scalable software infrastructure and services since 1990. Our solutions - MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter - support market competition, smart metering, network flexibility and supplier integration across Energy Retail, Energy Networks and Water Retail, and are used to manage messaging for more than 35 million electricity and gas meter points, with millions of records processed per day.

As the utility sector evolves to meet the challenges of Net Zero, Smart Metering, Energy Code reform, Market-wide Half-Hourly Settlement, Demand-side Response and Embedded Generation, we combine deep industry knowledge with technical innovation to deliver robust, business-focused solutions backed by dedicated people and exceptional support.

The Role

The Head of Products owns product strategy and roadmap execution across Flui's solution portfolio, leading a team of Product Owners and Product Managers. This role sits at the intersection of technology, customer need and commercial opportunity - shaping what Flui builds next, why, and how it is delivered.

You will drive the strategic roadmap across MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter, ensuring it reflects genuine customer value, technical feasibility and commercial potential. You will champion the adoption and exploitation of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) practices to increase product velocity and quality, working closely with the Technology Director and engineering leadership. You will also keep the business ahead of developments in the energy sector - regulatory, technological and competitive - translating change into commercial opportunity in partnership with the Commercial Director.

This is a role for someone equally comfortable in a commercial conversation, a customer discovery session, and a technical architecture discussion - genuinely bilingual between the business and the platform.

Job Responsibilities

The Head of Products will report to the Technology Director and will be responsible for:

  • Owning and driving the product strategy and multi-year roadmap across Flui's product portfolio, balancing customer needs, commercial opportunity and technical feasibility.
  • Leading, coaching and developing a team of Product Owners and Product Managers, setting clear priorities and raising the standard of product practice across the group.
  • Championing a genuinely customer-focused approach to product development - engaging directly with clients, gathering and prioritising feedback, and ensuring the roadmap reflects real customer value.
  • Staying current with developments in the energy sector - regulatory change such as Net Zero, Smart Metering, Market-wide Half-Hourly Settlement, grid flexibility, the Retail Energy Code (REC) and Embedded Generation - and translating them into product opportunities ahead of the market.
  • Identifying and shaping new commercial opportunities, working closely with the Commercial Director on pricing, packaging and go-to-market for new and existing product capability.
  • Championing the adoption and exploitation of AI-DLC across product and engineering, partnering with the Technology Director to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality and governance.
  • Owning product discovery and prioritisation, ensuring Product Owners translate strategy into well-defined, deliverable backlogs for engineering.
  • Representing product strategy at leadership team level, reporting on roadmap progress, adoption and commercial impact.
  • Partnering with the Technology Director on architecture and technical feasibility, ensuring product ambition is grounded in what the platform can realistically support.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with key customers, prospects and industry stakeholders to inform product direction and validate commercial opportunities.
  • Establishing product metrics and governance - adoption, customer satisfaction, roadmap delivery - to demonstrate product impact to the leadership team.
  • Championing knowledge sharing across the product and engineering community, ensuring product thinking and market insight are well understood beyond the product team itself.

Essential Competencies and Experience

Business Acumen

  • Demonstrable experience translating market and customer insight into commercially successful product strategy in a B2B software business.
  • Strong understanding of energy sector dynamics, with the ability to identify and act on emerging commercial opportunities.
  • Comfortable balancing customer and product ambition against commercial reality and delivery capacity.

Product & Technical Leadership

  • Proven track record leading and developing a team of Product Owners and/or Product Managers.
  • Technically credible - able to engage confidently with engineering and architecture discussions and make grounded trade-off decisions.
  • Experience adopting AI-assisted or AI-driven development practices (e.g. AI-DLC) to improve product and engineering velocity.
  • Strong grasp of product management best practice: discovery, prioritisation, roadmapping and outcome-based delivery.

General

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills across customers, engineering, commercial and leadership.
  • Strong analytical skills, comfortable using product and market data to inform decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to articulate product vision and rationale to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

Job Qualifications

  • A degree in a relevant discipline (business, computer science, engineering) is a bonus, or equivalent product leadership experience.
  • Experience in energy, utilities or another regulated, technical B2B software sector is highly desirable.

Your Personal Characteristics Will Include

  • Genuinely customer-obsessed, always looking to understand and solve real customer problems.
  • Equally comfortable in a commercial conversation and a technical or architecture discussion.
  • Curious and forward-looking, quick to spot and act on market and technology change, including AI.
  • A strong leader and coach, invested in developing the product team's capability.
  • Decisive, able to prioritise ruthlessly in a fast-moving market.
  • Collaborative, building strong working relationships across Sales, Engineering and Customer Success.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Experience applying human-centered design findings and user feedback to product decisions, process improvements, and implementation priorities.

jobs.excerpt: We're Sharp Performance Our mission is to extend the service-life and health span of those who run toward danger: law enforcement, firefighters, EMS, and the military community.
jobs.description:
We're Sharp Performance

Our mission is to extend the service-life and health span of those who run toward danger: law enforcement, firefighters, EMS, and the military community. The people who do this work pay a price for it. Agencies lose their best people to burnout and attrition, and the standard options were never built for the job.

Sharp Performance connects frontline professionals with 1:1 performance coaches through our mobile platform. Our coaches have lived the job. Our methods come from the cognitive performance world of U.S. Special Operations. We built this company from inside the community we serve.

We're backed by Andreessen Horowitz and growing fast, with new agency partnerships signing every month. The standard is high. The mission is clear. If you want your next chapter to serve the people you came from, we should talk.

The Opportunity

You're curious. You're analytical. You like figuring things out.

Sharp Performance is hiring a Growth & Lifecycle Marketer to help us build the marketing engine from the ground up. You'll be responsible for finding new ways to reach the right audiences, turn interest into action, and keep prospects and customers engaged.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a giant marketing machine and manage someone else's playbook.

You'll help build the playbook.

You'll experiment with acquisition channels, build campaigns, test messaging, create lifecycle programs, and use data to figure out what's working—and what's not.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to have an outsized impact early in your career and grow with a fast-moving Series A company.

What You'll Own

You'll help own the growth and lifecycle funnel for Sharp Performance.

Your job is simple: find opportunities to grow, build experiments, measure what happens, and make it better.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Product Analytics to turn ideas into experiments, experiments into learnings, and learnings into scalable growth.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Run Growth Experiments: Test new channels, campaigns, messaging, audiences, and ideas to find what drives growth.
  • Build Demand: Create campaigns that generate awareness, engagement, and qualified opportunities across our target markets.
  • Own Lifecycle Marketing: Build email campaigns, nurture sequences, onboarding programs, and re-engagement campaigns that move prospects and customers through the funnel.
  • Optimize Conversion: Look at every stage of the funnel and identify where we're losing people—and what we can do to improve it.
  • Get Your Hands Dirty: Build campaigns, workflows, automations, lists, and experiments directly in tools like HubSpot and Clay.
  • Partner With RevOps: Work closely with RevOps to improve segmentation, automation, lead routing, data quality, and the marketing-to-sales handoff.
  • Use Data to Make Decisions: Partner with Product Analytics to understand customer behavior, measure performance, and identify opportunities for growth.
  • Build, Measure, Iterate: Launch something, measure it, learn from it, and make it better. Then do it again.
  • Find the Next Thing: We're still building the playbook. You'll be expected to identify opportunities we haven't thought of yet.

Who We're Looking For

  • Hungry Tinkerer: You like figuring things out. Give you a problem and you'll find a way to solve it.
  • Startup Experience: 2–4 years of experience, ideally at a Seed, Series A, or Series B startup where you've had to wear a lot of hats.
  • Growth Mindset: You've actually run experiments and tested ideas—not just read about growth marketing.
  • Hands-On: You're a builder. You'd rather launch something yourself than spend three weeks writing a brief for someone else.
  • Analytical: You enjoy working with data, identifying patterns, forming hypotheses, and measuring results.
  • Technically Curious: Comfortable learning new tools and technology. Experience with HubSpot, Clay, or similar platforms is a plus.
  • Creative & Resourceful: You don't need a playbook to get started. You can come up with an idea, figure out how to execute it, and learn from the result.
  • Collaborative: You enjoy working across Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Product Analytics.
  • Competitive: You care about outcomes. You want to know whether your work actually moved the needle.

Why You'll Want to Be Here

  • Real Ownership: You won't be handed a narrow piece of the marketing machine. You'll have the opportunity to build meaningful parts of it.
  • High Growth Environment: Join a Series A company that's growing quickly and already working with 100+ public safety agencies.
  • Backed by a16z: We're backed by Andreessen Horowitz and investors behind some of the world's most successful technology companies.
  • Mission That Matters: You're helping improve the health, performance, and longevity of the people who run toward danger.
  • Career Growth: This is an opportunity to grow into a larger growth, demand generation, or lifecycle marketing role as the company scales.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision.
  • Flexible PTO: Recharge and stay sharp, no micromanagement.
  • 401(k) with Company Match: We invest in your future.
  • Performance Coaching: Access to the same elite performance coaches we offer our clients.
  • A Team Built Like You: We're operators, first responders, and high-performers who don't accept average.
